tei:div.tei:p: karma pa sku phreng gsum pa

rang byung rdo rje'i lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /grub chen karma pa nyid bsams bzhin du srid pa nye bar bzung nas/ sprul pa'i skur bzhengs pa sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje'i rnam thar pa ni/ thog mar rnam thar bar do ma nas 'di ltar 'byung ste/ grub thob chen po mya ngan las 'das tshul bstan pa'i rjes thog de nyid du rin po che'i khri mdzes shing yid dga' ba'i steng du bzhugs pa la/ de'i tshe tshangs pa dang*/ brgya byin dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams dang*/ lha'i bu dang bu mo mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang ldan pa rin po che'i rgyan cha du ma dang*/ 'jam zhing kha dog gsal ba'i lha'i gos rin thang med pa du mas mdzes par brgyan pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa rnams ni/ la la ni glu len/ la la ni gar byed/ la las ni gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ la las ni rol mo'i sgra snyan pa du mas mchod cing dga' ldan gyi gnas su gdan drangs so/ /de'i tshe kun tu bzang po'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba lta bu'i lha rdzas kyi mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'dod yon gyis mngon par mchod cing*/ dga' bde'i dpal la mngon par longs spyod cing bzhugs su zin kyang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po 'di ni rang bzhin gyis 'bad pa med par/ snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i stobs kyis nyam thag pa'i sems can rnams la ma bu gcig pa la brtse ba ltar bzod pa med pa'i gdung shugs kyis bskyod de/ slar 'dzam bu'i gling du byon no// de'i tshe de'i dus na/ grwa pa dang bu slob nye 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ chos rje'i spur zhus pa las byon pa'i sku gdung ring bsrel dang*/ lha sku'i tshogs rnams dang*/ gzhan yang dbu skra dang*/ dbu zhwa dang*/ na bza' bzhugs gdan dang bcas pa la mchod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pas mchod cing*/

so so nas dad pa dang*/ gus pa dang*/ yid gdung ba'i sgo nas gsol ba nyin mtshan khor yug tu 'debs shing snang ba gzigs so/ / de'i tshe stod lung 'phar tshang na rgan rgon gnyis kyi bar na khye'u lo lnga drug tsam lon pa zhig shi ba'i ro bzhag ste ngu zhing 'dug pa gzigs te/ ro de la rnam shes zhugs la sems can gyi don bya'o snyam ste/ ro de la zhugs te spyan hrig hrig mdzad pa dang*/ pha ma de gnyis kyis gshin mig gson la lta ba ltas ngan yin zer nas/ mig tu thal ba blug cing khab kyis gtsags so// yang de'i tshe dbang po med pa'i skyes bus sems can gyi don ga la nus bsam nas rnam par shes pa 'thon nas byon no/ /de'i tshe sems can rnams kyi bsod nams dman pa dang*/ chos kyi skal pa med pa rnams la dgongs nas/ kye ma kye ma 'di lta'i 'gro ba skal pa rab dman pa/ /log pa'i rgyun las zlog pa'i thabs ni cung zad med gyur par/ /thub pas dgongs te thugs rje'i lcags kyus ring du spangs gyur rnams/ /re zhig dus la bzhes par kho bos kyang ni da sdod rig /ces pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gsungs te/ nam mkha'i dbyings su byon nas 'od gsal chen po'i ngang la rtse gcig tu bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe mdun nas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis sems can gyi don mdzad par bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa 'di lta ste/ yid 'ong mdzes pa'i bud med nyi shu lnga// glu len gar byed 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan rnams// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag zhi la mi bzhugs par// brtse bas dag pa'i mi lus bzung du gsol// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bzung du gsol// nyam thag 'gro ba'i pha ma mdzad du gsol// ces pa'i tshig gis gsol ba 'debs shing snang ngo*// de'i tshe 'di ltar snang ba 'di dag 'khrul pa'i snang ba yin no bsam nas/ der 'dzin bshig kyang 'gror ma 'dod do/ /de'i tshe lan gnang ba ni/ dal 'byor mi lus rin chen len pa la//

ma dag 'khrul pas ma gos pha ma med// sangs rgyas bstan pa 'dzin pa'ang dus kyi dka'// nged kyis ma bzhin brtse ba'i sems 'chang yang*// rjes su 'dzin pa'i dpal dang skal yod nyung*// ma 'ongs byams pa'i dus su ngag bzhin bsgrub// zhes gsungs pa dang khong rnams na re// nged rnams mi yul mthil nas 'ongs// yin pa zhing skyong mkha' 'gro yin// khyed la bskul ma mi 'tshal te// sems can don la bskul du 'ongs// brtse ba'i yul la mi brtse na// thugs rje'i mnga' bdag ci ltar lags// zhes zer nas rang rang so so'i ming dang srog snying phul lo/ /de'ang 'di skad ces smra'o// gsang ba rdo rje thog 'bebs ma// gtsug na rdo rje dpal 'bar ma// mtha' na rdo rje stobs mo che// lag na rdo rje mthu rgyal ma// kha na rdo rje dung sgra ma// zhing skyong gtso mo lnga po lags// zer nas srog snying phul nas bka' bzhin du phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas so/ /yang*/ bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma// gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang*// dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje ya ma skyong*// 'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso// bdud 'dul gtso mo bzhi po lags// zer nas srog snying phul te phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas so/ /yang*/ gtad dkar rdo rje 'gro bzang ma// mi g.yo rdo rje klong bzang ma// bkra shis rdo rje tshe ring ma// stag gzig rdo rje khyung mgo ma// chos srung gtso mo bzhi po lags// zer nas srog gi snying po phul te phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas so/ /yang*/ gangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig ma// gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje rlung mo che// kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum*// rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje grags mo rgyal// bdud 'dul gtso mo chen mo bzhi po lags// zhes zer te srog snying phul nas phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas so/ /yang*/ sa trī rdo rje khri bzang ma//

dung gi rdo rje sgo mo che// chags po rdo rje stobs mo che// 'ag gha rdo rje ral gri ma// sgo bzhi srung ba'i gtso mo lags// zer nas srog gi snying phul te phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas so/ /yang*/ kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong*// btsan la la rog rdo rje sman gcig ma// mo btsun khug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil// g.yu yi skad snyan rdo rje si le ma// yid 'gyur gtso mo bzhi po lags// zer nas srog snying phul nas bka' bzhin du phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas so/ /yang bud med bzhi sleb byung ste/ nga ni rdo rje sa trī yin// li btsun rdo rje bu skyong ma// phu chu rdo rje sman gcig ma// de 'og rdo rje g.yu chung lags// sbas pa'i yul bzhi srung ba yin// zer cing mdun du bsgrigs te mgrin gcig tu bsdebs te 'di skad ces zer ro// 'gro drug sems can snying re rje// 'khor ba'i gnas na nyon re mongs// sems can 'gro don byed re ran// 'gro drug so so'i sdug bsngal 'di// cung zad bsam na mchi ma g.yo// bdag 'dras kyang ni mi phod na// brtse ldan khyod kyis phod dam ci// de phyir gsol ba 'debs su 'ong*// zhes zer ro/ /bag chags 'khrul pa yin snyam nas rnam rtog bshig kyang 'gro ru ma 'dod par/ kho bos kyang ni lan brjod pa ni/ bdag 'dzin rnam rtog brag bas sra// nga rgyal ri bo gnam las mtho// 'di la thos pa'i gzings btsugs te// bsgom pa'i sgyogs rdo 'phangs lags kyang*// 'jigs bas ser ka cung ma mthong*// 'gro drug sku khams ci bder bzhugs// zhing skyong ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// ces smras pa dang*/ bar snang gi lha bran man chad nas sa 'og klu dang lto 'phye yan chad 'tshogs nas thams cad kyis so so nas phyag phul nas 'di skad ces gsol bar byed do// gson dang rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku// lha rnams ltung ba'i sdug bsngal dang*//

lha min rtsod pa'i sdug bsngal dang*// mi rnams skye 'chi'i sdug bsngal dang*// byol song glen lkugs sdug bsngal dang*// yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal dang*// dmyal ba tsha grang sdug bsngal rnams// dran zhing bsam na glo snying 'dar// mi bzod tshor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis// shin tu nyam thag 'o 'dod 'bod// 'di 'dra su yis bzod par nus// sangs rgyas bstan pa su yis 'dzin// 'gro drug pha ma su yis byed// dkon mchog dbu 'phang su yis bstod// kyi hud kyi hud sdug re bsngal// zhes zer cing thams cad sdug bsngal byed par snang ngo*// de'i tshe khong rnams la kho bos lan 'jal ba ni/ spyir rgyal ba'i zhing khams bsam mi khyab// sgos khyad par 'dzam bu'i gling shed na// dge bshes grangs las 'das pa bdog/ chos mdzad bsam gyis mi khyab pas// lung bstan gyi rgyal tshab gzhan du tshol// 'gro drug pha ma de ru tshol// sangs rgyas bstan pa chos mdzad rnams kyis srung*// dkon mchog dbu 'phang zhing skyong rnams kyis bstod// 'gro drug pha ma dge bshes rnams kyis mdzod// khyed rang tsho ji ltar dgyes dgyes mdzod// ces smras pas/ yang zhing skyong rnams kyis gsol ba ni/ dge bshes rnams ni phrag dog che// chos pa rnams ni 'gran sems che// 'gro drug kun kyang rgyud ngan rings// de la phan thabs mi gda' bas// khyed la skul ma cis kyang 'debs// de skad ces smras so/ /yang sems dpa' chen pos gsung pa/ dal 'byor mi lus blang sa med// mtshan ldan bla ma rnyed par dka'// snyigs dus mngal de grib re che// 'das ma 'ongs kyi dran pa stor nas 'gro// sems can gyi 'gro don bya bar dka'// lar de skad zer ba'i rting shed la// rigs ldan gyi pha ma rnyed srid na// mtshan ldan gyi bla ma dang mjal lags na// zhing skyong kun chos skyong byed lags na// dbang dang bsre ba rdzogs par zhu// brda' dang byin rlabs rdzogs par zhu//

de skad ces gsungs pa dang*/ /khong zhing skyong ma rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma spyan drangs te/ bde mchog drug cu rtsa gnyis pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ lha dbang bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskur/ ā li kā li glegs bam mang du bkod nas/ rig pa ye shes lnga'i dbang yin skad/ dbang po lnga la ngo sprad nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i don dbang yin skad/ skye med don gyi dbang 'di ni// tshig tu bskur du tshig lam chad// brda' yis mtshon du brda' lam chad// dpe yis mtshon du dpe lam chad// 'khrul pas mtshon du 'khrul lam chad// dbang 'di sus kyang bskur mi 'dod// nged kyis zhal ce mtshon ma btub// rang la lhang nge lham mer 'char// sa le seng nge hrig ger 'char// wa le khyug ge lam mer 'char// 'khor 'das kyi snang ba ma nub kyang*// sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rdzogs par 'byung*// sems can gyi 'gro don de ru 'grub// ces gsungs shing*/ zhing skyong gi gtso mo rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mang du brjod cing*/ sman mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ sgo ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ gzhan rnams kyis me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dkrol bar byed do/ /de nas yang khong rnams 'di skad ces zer ro// re yang re ste byung yang byung*// rin chen 'ja' yi lam sna bdog/ dal 'byor mi lus blang sa bdog/ mang yul bkra shis gung thang na// jo mo bkra shis g.yu chung ma// zhur mo gangs kyi mdun shed na// 'am lung bkra shis mkhan thang du// pha thig le 'od gsal khang pa bdog/ rtsa phu rin chen che ba'i gangs// phu gsum 'dzom pa'i klung shod na// rtsa lung mi la'i 'khrungs sa bdog/ lho ri dmar smug mdangs gsal la// byang ri dkar ba'i 'od ldan na// ma dgos 'dod lus kyi sgrom bu bdog/ de skad ces zer ba'i glu len cing 'dug pa na/ bar snang na phar la 'ja' tshon kha dog du ma dang ldan pa/

gsal zhing mdzes pa zhig nar gyis byung ba dang*/ khong rnams de'i steng nas phar 'gro yin 'dug par mthong ngo*/ /der ltas mo che ba snyam byed nas/ sems dpa' chen pos kyang rting na phar byon pas shel gyi khang pa gnam sgo yod pa/ phyogs bzhi'i steng dkar la dngas pa 'og smug nag du yod pa/ phyogs mtshams thams cad 'ja' tshon du shig ge yod pa de 'dra ba'i khang pa'i nang du byon no/ /de'i tshe 'dod chags khrag gi rba rlabs byung zer nas khong rnams 'bros kyi 'dug pa mthong ngo*/ /der gnam khung dgu la skas dgu btsugs nas 'dug pa'i gcig la 'dzegs nas phyin pas gnam khung chung nas phar ma thar nas/ las kyi rnam smin thar lam dka' zer ba'i sgra zhig byung ba dang*/ nag mun song ste cung zad gcig brgyal/ dran pa mdo long mdo long byung ba dang*/ nag pa mun pa/ lci zhir 'thibs pa/ khams cung 'tshubs pa zhig byung ngo*// de nas dran pa gsal bar gyur ba dang*// res dga' chu yis rba rlabs skyod pa 'dra// res 'ga' ri yis mnan pa 'dra// res 'ga' tsha zhing sreg 'dra ba// res 'ga' grang zhing 'khyag pa 'dra// rang rig thon pa'i rlung yang med// nyon mongs kyi gdug rtsub de na che// dus da lta dran yang snying rlung ldangs// zhes gsungs la dag pa'i gdul bya kha cig la ni/ ma'i mngal de shel gyi khang pa bde ba'i rang bzhin can du snang zhing*/ der yang sems can mang po'i don byas so zhes gsungs so// de nas sku dngos kyi mdzad pa ji ltar bstan pa'i tshul ni/ bshad ma thag pa lta bu'i yul du yab sngon bkas gnang ba'i ston pa chos dpal de nyid la/ yum jo mo g.yang 'dren gyi lhums su zhugs shing de srid du yum gyis kyang sngon ma myang ba'i bde bas nyin mtshan 'da' zhing dag snang rgya mtsho la spyod do// de nas yab yum de dag ding ri glang 'khor dang ches nye ba'i sar byon nas/ sru mo zhig gi khyim du bzhugs pa na shing pho spre'u'i lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad kyi phyi dro khang steng zhig tu yum la ma gnod par bltams ma thag tsog tsog pur bzhugs/

zhal phyag gis phyis te zla ba la gzigs nas tshes brgyad kyi zla bar 'dug ang gsungs/ de sru mo des ma bzod nas skyes ma thag nas smra ba 'di mi rung bas med par gyis zer bas/ yab yum gyis de 'dra gar 'ong gsungs nas gnas gzhan du bskyal/ snyigs ma'i sems can blun po'i rang bzhin mkhyen pas de nas re zhig gsung 'byon pa dang bzhengs pa sogs nus bzhin du ma mdzad/ 'di'i zla ba snga ma la grub thob o rgyan pa snye mo ca ba lung na bzhugs pa'i tshe sprul pa'i sku myur du 'byon pa'i ltas kyis bskul bar mdzad/ bskal pa rgya mtshor bzod pa dang byams pa la goms pa'i phyir dang*/ tshogs gnyis bsag tshul su dang yang mi mtshungs pa'i phyir/ khye'u de sus mthong yang ngo mtshar gyi mig bgrad ste/ e ma 'di rmi lam min na rung ste/ zhes sems pa dang mchod pa'i tshogs chas sna tshogs kyis mchod cing snyen par grags so// re zhig btang snyoms pa ltar mdzad nas dgung lo gsum pa la phying pa nag po la zhwa nag 'di 'dra ba bzos shig gsungs ste/ zhwa nag chung ngu zhig mnabs te rdo'i khri thog nas byis pa mang po la sku gsum ngo sprod gsungs shing sngon gyi de ma brjed par snang gsungs/ sna tshogs rol pa'i snang ba 'di dag kun//

sgyu ma smig rgyu 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du// snang yang bden pas stong par kho bos rtogs// ma rtogs byis pa khyod rnams snying re rje// zhes gsungs pa 'di tshigs bcad gsung pa'i thog mar grags/ mngon mkhyen gyi thog ma yum gyi dar kha 'ga' zhig brlag pas sdug bsngal ba na/ khyod de tsam du dar la dad na nga la mtshur phu+u na dar shing sgrom chen po du ma yod pa sbyin chog gsungs/ yab lug khyu la brnab sems skyes pa na mdo khams na rta khyu yang 'di bas che ba du ma nga la yod pas sbyin chog gsungs/ bdag gi sems mkhyen pa cug lags zhus pas/ nga ni rin po che karma pa'o gsungs/ sngon gnang sbyin dang bka' lung gnang ba dran te mchi ma phyungs shing zhabs la gtugs/ de phyin yab yum gnyis kyang grub thob chen po dngos kyis mos gus yod kyang bkas bcings te gzhan la mi sgrag /nam zhig yab zas skom gyi rtog pa 'gyus tshe zhal nas de lta na grang pha gir 'gro bar bya'o zhes gsungs te byon pa na yab yum bzhed pa'i longs spyod byung*/ yab dga' ches pa dang chang gis bzi bas rin po che karma pa byon pa yin byas pas khrom thams cad 'ur te 'bul ba ri ltar spungs pa byung*/ kun gyis chos dang byin rlabs zhus/ de dus la stod kyi bshes gnyen gcig pu pa sems dpa' chen po mkhas btsun gser khang pas ma la zhing khong gis dris par rnam thar bar do ma gsungs/ de nub rnal lam du shel gyi khri rgyab yol can la bzhugs te 'od zer 'gyed bzhin pas nam mkha' la bya ltar rgyu zhing lha mi thams cad 'dud pa sogs gzigs/ glang 'khor spyi mchod kyi dus sku gdung ka ru la ngo mtshar gyi gzigs snang du ma dang*/ nam mkha' la dam pa rin po che bzhugs pa'i 'od zer rang nyid la thim par gzigs shing yab las zhi byed so lugs dang rgyud phyi gsan/ yang sngags 'chang ngos nag pa dang dbu rtse ba gnyis la yang dag dang phur pa'i bka' gsan/

kyi rong gi 'phags pa wa ti mjal tshe spyan ras gzigs dngos su gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs/ dgung lo lnga pa la grub chen o rgyan pa mjal bzhed pas rim pas byon/ grub chen pa la 'od gsal gyi ngang du rin po che karma pa byon nas sang nga 'ong pa shes par gyis shig gsungs/ phyir nang 'khor rnams la de ring 'dir rin po che karma pa'i rnam 'phrul zhig 'ong bar 'dug pas bsu ba gyis gsungs/ 'on kyang brtag dgos snyam pa thugs la byung ste/ khong rang gi gong du stan mthon po zhig bshams te/ gal te nga'i bla ma yin na nga'i gong gi stan 'di la sdod nus la/ ma yin na sdod mi nus dgongs/ de'i tshe 'tshogs pas rol mo'i tshogs kyis spyan drangs te byon pa na grub chen pas nyam sad pa'i phyir gsang bdag gi ting nge 'dzin mdzad pas zil gyis ma non/ grub chen pa la phyag mi mdzad par phyag gis dril gdangs dkrol bas grub thob pa'i gsung nas bu chung thu mo zhig 'dug snyan grags chen po 'ong bar 'dug gsungs/ khri chen po de la shad kyis byon nas bzhugs/ khyod su yin gsungs pas phyag nam mkha' la brkyang ste/ nga ni ming yongs su grags pa karma pa'o gsungs/ sngon gyi mjal lugs shod cig gsungs pas/ la stod kyi jo btsun o rgyan pa// kho bo'i mdun du 'ongs nas kyang*// rgya gar shar nub kyi gleng mo gtong*// rdo rje gdan gyi bkod pa byin// mkhyen pa dam chos kyi gleng mo 'chad// ces sogs gsungs/ slar khri las babs nas sngar nga bla ma yin yang da khyed kyis bskyang du gsol gsungs nas phyag mdzad/ khyod nga'i bla ma yin na klog shes te 'ong bas thon gsung nas dpe cha gtad pas la la na thogs med du sha ra ra byung*/ la lar tshag sdud ma byang ba/ la lar sbyar klog sna tshogs byung bas 'di bas dgod bro ba'i klog mthong ma myong gsungs nas bzhad/ dgung lo dris nas nga'i bla ma lug lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum la gshegs pa yin/

khyod sprel lo zla ba dang po'i tshes brgyad la skyes na bar na zla ba lnga las mi 'dug /nga'i bla ma'i sku skye min par 'dug gsungs pas/ ngas mngal gyi lus chags nas zla ba bzhi lon pa zhig la rnam shes zhugs pa yin/ snga gzhis gangs zhur mdun du song tshar zhes yang yang bzlas pa ma gsan nam gsungs/ 'di ltar na snga ma zla ba bzhi ni kun gzhi'i cha gcig zhugs pas mngon byang lnga las gzugs su dod pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs dang*/ phyi ma ni kun gzhi'i rnam shes rdzogs par zhugs pa las lhan cig skyes pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa la zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis glus bskul nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sems dpa' gsum rdzogs su bzhengs par snang ngo*// gzhan ci dran gsungs pas/ 'phar tshang gi grong 'jug gi tshul gsungs/ bden rdzun lta gsungs nas 'phral du mi btang bas nges pa 'drongs/ gzhan khyod kyis ci dran gsung pas/ mngal du phyi rol gyi yul ma bsgribs par gzigs pa dang*/ yum gyis 'di skad cig yang mi sdod par 'dug pas bu mor 'ong*/ yab kyi rmi lam las bur 'ong zer ba gsan gsungs pas/ grub chen pa'i zhal nas 'di brdzun rgyal zhig 'dug gsungs te/ yab yum bos gdong 'dzom mdzad pas kun yid ches te/ rgya gar du sangs rgyas shākya thub pa dang*/ bod yul du khyod ma gtogs pa mngal gyis dri mas gtan ma gos pa gzhan 'byung ba med gsung nas bstod bsngags cher mdzad/ nga'i bla ma'i gsang mtshan rang byung rdo rje yin pas de ka 'dogs so gsungs nas rang byung rdo rjer mtshan gsol/ /dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang sems bskyed gnang*/ nged la rin po che ba'i gsung gis ma 'ongs pa na khyod kyis 'go 'don dgos pa gcig 'ong gis 'go thon gsungs pa zhig yod de khyod yin par 'dug /de la gtod gsung pa'i zhwa nag dang sku gsum ngo sprod cig nged la bcol yod pa 'di yin no gsungs nas phyag tu gtad do//

de nas grub chen pa'i drung du dril bu lugs kyi bde mchog gi dbang dang*/ phur pa dang*/ ma mo'i dbang gsan/ dgyes rdor dang*/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang*/ dus 'khor dang*/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud rnams gsan/ ro snyoms sgang dril dang*/ sku gsum ngo sprod dang*/ bsre 'pho dang*/ khrid chen brgyad dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ do ha dang*/ lhan cig skyes sbyor dang*/ bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung dang*/ phra man brgyad dang*/ bsrung bzlog dang*/ rdzas sgrub la sogs kyi chos phran kyang mang du gsan no// dgung lo bdun pa'i tshe khro phu ba kun ldan shes rab kyis mkhan po de'i dbu che zhig gis slob dpon mdzad ste rab byung dang dge tshul du bsgrubs/ 'dul ba ci rigs gsan/ mtshan snga ma las ma spos pa 'dra/ de'i tshe mtshur phu na grub chen gnyan ras bzhugs pa la thugs rje chen po'i zhal gzigs nas nyi ma nub kyi phyogs na spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i sku nyi ma shar ba lta bu yod kyi spyan 'dren pa'i dus la bab bo zhes bskul ba byung*/ snyan grags kyis kyang sa chen po khyab ste bstod pa dang 'bul ba bskur bas sleb/ la stod stod lung du grub thob chen pos dbang bskur mdzad pa bla ma bde mchog dngos su gzigs/ dben gnas bde chen du rgod tshang pas lhan cig skyes sbyor gsungs pa'i snang ba byung ste bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs par dgongs/ de dus phyi'i yul snang thams cad sgrib pa med par gsal ba zhig dus rtag tu byung zhing*/ res shig gsal snang du kha khyu'i la la byon par chas pa'i tshe la gong na phub chung ba nyi shu rtsa grangs shig 'dug pa gzigs te/ nang par bla ma la 'di bzhin gda' zhus pas/ 'o na tsha mda' ba 'o cag bsgugs pa yin yong rang re yang dmag sogs gsungs nas phub chung ba bcu gsum tsam dang bcas te dpon g.yog mang pos byon nas la sked tsam la sleb pa dang*/ la gong gi phub can rnams gzigs pas 'gro ma nus pas bzhugs so//

der pho nya ba btang ste tsha mda' ba e yin ltos shig yin na thar tshad bros la shog ma yin na g.yab mo thang nged yong ba yin gsung ngo*/ /der la gong nas g.yab mo byung ba dang byon no/ /la phar skog du dro mdzad dus/ da phyis gzhan la mngon shes ma smra bar chad 'ong ngo gsungs nas bla ma'i bkas bsdams so/ /grub chen pa'i chags phyir byon pa'i skabs rnams su dag snang mang du byung zhing*/ khyad par mi ma yin mang pos 'dud pa dang*/ phrin las bsgrub par khas len pa mang du byung gsungs/ spud trar tho rangs zhig mgon po ber nag can dang sngags bdag gnyis byung nas mtshur phur myur du byon zhes bskul te phebs/ grong 'jug mdzad pa'i byis pa'i ma de bos nas mdzo mo zhig gnang khyod kyis nga'i mig la ci byas gsungs/ sa zhig btab lags zer/ mtshur phur bla ma gnyan ras kyis mjal ba'i tshe sa ra ha la bka' brgyud kyi grub thob dpag med kyis bskor ba yun ring du gzigs/ de'i tshe slob ma dam pa rnams the tshom zad pa'i nges shes thob na'ang skal dman nga rgyal can kha cig gis ma dad pa cher byas pan brag gdong skam po zhig tu nga karma pak+shi yin na 'dir chu mig 'byung bar gyur cig gsungs ma thag tu chu mig che ba zhig byung*/ yog pa phyed tshig pa zhig de nyid du btsugs te nga karma pak+shi yin na 'dir da lta skye la min na mi skye bar gyur cig gsungs pas skad cig de nyid du skyes te sgrub chu dang sgrub shing du grags te da lta'ang yod/ bkra shis gsar mer dge bshes dar ma sgang pas byin rlabs zhus pa na bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi zhal gzigs/ slob ma mos gus che ba'i rgyu mtshan du go gsungs so/ /yang de'i tshe dpal rta mchog zhal gzigs/ de'i 'khor du dpal ma mgon lcam dral yang zhal gzigs de dus kyi ma mgon gyi bstod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa yang mdzad/ dge bshes 'ga' zhig la gnod sbyin shing rta can gyi rjes gnang byin pa na lcang lo can gyi bkod pa gzigs/

rta lo la sa g.yos byung ba'i tshe sku'i rtsa mdud phyogs med du grol zhing chos thams cad rang sems su mkhyen pa la brtan pa thob/ lha mo dung skyong ma dang re ma ti 'khor bcas kyis bskul nas chos khrims gsar du mdzad/ rnal lam du lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bor sa ra ha dang mjal te do ha'i don rtogs/ slob dpon shes rab dpal la rgyud 'grel gnyis ka dang bshad sbyar gsan/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od la dgyes rdor dang spyod 'jug gsan/ khyung rdzong du bzhugs tshe rin po che'i ri bo'i ngogs su spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ṇi bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyis mdun du gnas pa'i ngan 'gro rnams 'dren par byed pa gzigs shing de'i tshigs bcad kyang mdzad/ grub chen gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum las/ chos drug dang bsre ba skor gsum dang*/ chos drug ka dpe dang*/ tshigs bcad ma dang*/ tshigs lhug ma dang*/ zhal gdams ma dang*/ lhan cig skyes ma dang*/ ku ru kul+le dang*/ man ngag tshigs bsdus dang*/ gaṅgā ma dang*/ lta ba mdor bsdus dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thog bab dang*/ rde'u skor dang*/ blo sbyong dang*/ lam rim dang*/ chos bzhi dang*/ nad 'don gsum pa dang*/ khams gsum ma dang*/ phag mo'i phran 'ga' ste/ de rnams gtso bor mi la'i gdams ngag dpal dwags po nas brgyud pa dang*/ rje ras chung pa nas brgyud pa'i gdams pa/ do ha skor gsum bsam gtan thun 'jog gi sham bu can dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ mkha' 'gro thugs sgrub dang*/ phyag rdor gtum po rnam gsum khyung gi sham bu can dang*/ phag mo bde mchog rig 'dzin gyi sham bu can dang*/ mtha' bzhi chos 'khor chos drug gi sham bu can dang*/ bsre ba dgu skor ro snyom gyi sham bu can dang*/ sde brgyad gnad 'khor log tri'i sham bu can dang*/ tshe sgrub rnam gsum dang*/ tshar gsum khug pa dang*/ bsnyen sgrub dang*/ phyag rgya rnam gsum dang*/ don khrid dang*/ gzer lnga dang*/ gegs sel dang*/

lus med chos skor dgu la sogs pa dang*/ yang mi tra dzo ki nas brgyud pa'i/ thugs rje chen po dbang dang bcas pa dang*/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rnam bzhi rgyud 'grel dang*/ 'brel ba gsum ldan dang*/ phag mo zhal bzhi ma dang*/ snying 'phrog ma dang*/ khros ma nag mo dang*/ phag mo rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang*/ yang dpyal dang gnur las brgyud pa'i phag mo'i gzhung drug dang 'od kyi phreng ba cha lag dang bcas pa dang*/ yang thugs rje chen po'i rgyud drug dang*/ sgrub thabs 'ga' dang*/ thugs rje chen po'i gsung sgrub dang*/ 'khor ba dong sprug ma dang*/ snang ba lam khyer dang*/ lha sa ma dang*/ dpal mo yid bzhin 'khor lo rnams dang*/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes nas brgyud pa'i phyag na rdo rje dang lha mo dang*/ gshin rje gshed dang*/ srung ma lnga dang*/ gdams phran mang po dang*/ a tsa ra dmar po zhabs kyi rtsa ba dang*/ don zhags dang*/ pad+ma cod paṇa la sogs du ma dang*/ bde mchog dang khros ma'i rgyud gnyis dang sgrub thabs rnam pa gsum dang*/ drag po gsum skor dang*/ gsang rgyud rnams dang*/ 'jam dpal dkar po dmar po ser po gsum dang*/ sgrol ma brgya rtsa dang*/ seng ldeng nags sgrol dang*/ ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa sgrub skor dang bcas pa dang*/ bla ma mar do dang pu rangs pa nas brgyud pa'i sgrol ma dkar mo'i tshe sgrub dang*/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig ma dang*/ bde mchog lu hi pa'i lugs dang*/ dril bu pa'i lugs lha bcu gsum ma dang*/ la ba pa'i lugs kyi lha bcu gsum ma dang*/ ra li'i rgyud nyi shu rtsa brgyad man ngag dang bcas pa dang*/ phag mo sha ba ri pa la brgyud pa drug dang*/ byang chub shing lo ma dang*/ mkha' spyod dkar dmar gnyis dang*/ sum pa lo tsā ba'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rin chen rnam pa bdun dang*/ nges brjod bong zhal can dang*/ gzhan yang lha lnga ma dang lha gsum ma dang*/ yig bdun rigs gsum dang*/

lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs gnyis dang*/ nag po pa'i gzhung drug dang*/ nag chung phran drug dang*/ dgyes rdor dpa' bo gcig pa dang*/ dgyes rdor lha lnga ma dang*/ lha drug cu rtsa bzhi ma dang*/ rigs bsdus kyi sgrub thabs rdzogs rim dang bcas pa dang*/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis dang kun spyod sogs dang*/ yang myang ral pa can dang*/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin thugs dril gyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs dang*/ rta mgrin lha lnga ma dang*/ dpa' bo gcig pa me lce'i phreng ba can dang*/ pad+ma dbang chen gyi rtsa ba la sogs pa'i gter ma rnams dang*/ yang kaḥthog pa las brgyud pa'i yang dag dang*/ phur pa rtsa thung dang*/ khyu 'byug rol pa'i rgyud dang*/ phur pa rtsa ba'i rgyud dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le'i rgyud drug dang*/ dgongs 'dus dang*/ kun byed rgyal po dang*/ bram skor rgyud bdun dang*/ snga 'gyur lnga dang*/ phyi 'gyur bcu gsum dang*/ rin chen spung pa dang*/ klong dang*/ gu ru bzhi pa dang*/ yang nyang nas brgyud pa'i snying thig gi zab pa'i po ti bzhi khrid rim dang bcas pa dang*/ 'gro mgon gyis blo ldan mchog sred nas brgyud pa'i sdud pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ rga lo nas brgyud pa'i mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs bcu gsum tsam dang*/ gnubs kyi mgon po stag zhon gyi rgyud gsum sgrub thabs ma lus pa

dang*/ mtsho skyes dang*/ bse gdong can dang*/ trag shad dang*/ beng dang*/ ber nag can gyi sgrub skor ma lus pa dang*/ lha mo'i rgyud bcu dang sgrub thabs rnams dang*/ bong zhon ma dpon g.yog gsum ma dang*/ gnubs dang*/ gu ru pad+ma'i re ma ti'i sgrub thabs cha lag dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ drag sngags sgrub phran mang po dang*/ dbang dang byin rlabs bka' dang bcas pa rnams gsan no// bla ma gnam mtsho ba las/ bstan pa rgya mtsho'i rtsa bshad bar gcig pa dang*/ zhus len mun sel dang*/ dgongs pa lung ston dang*/ a ma lab sgron gyi dka' tshom dang*/ le lag la sogs rnams dang*/ zab gdams skor lnga la sogs chos rje'i chos chung rnams dang*/ zhi byed don rgyud dang*/ phag mo'i gzhung drug dang*/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho skor gsum dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thog babs dang*/ rdzogs pa chen po'i dbang gi chu bo dang*/ gzhan yang gdams phran bka' lung dang bcas pa mang du gsan no*// rdzogs pa chen po snying thig gsan pa'i tshe mngon sum tshad phebs kyi rtags gzigs shing man ngag gi gnad kyang shin tu zab par dgongs/ gzhan la phan par 'gyur ba'i ltas kyang gzigs/ jo mo gangs su zla ba gcig bzhugs pa'i tshe de'i gdan sa pa la gdams phran 'ga' gsungs pas/ khong dad pa brtan cing dpal ldan lha mos kyang phrin las sgrub par gziḍa/ rdzogs chen gsang skor gyi ngo sprod kyi dus su stong gzugs rdo rje 'chang du shar/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa bshol dang mngal zla brtsis pa'i nyi shu tshang ba na dge 'dun sgang pa'i 'dren pa 'phags pa'i gnas brtan gzhon nu byang chub pas mkhan po/ mkhas pa dge 'dun rin chen gyis las slob mdzad de dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs/ spyir dge slong gi bslab pa la ming brje ba med mod na'ang 'dir mkhan pos rang gi mtshan las gras nas ched du tshul khrims gzhon nu zhes gsol ba 'dra ste gnas sgor o rgyan pa mnal lam du byon pa'i skabs las/

tshul khrims gzhon nu zhes bya ba'i rnal 'byor bdag /ces 'byung bas so// mkhan chen pa la/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi dang*/ mdo rtsa dang bam po lnga bcu pa dang*/ sum brgya pa dang*/ karma sha taṃ dang*/ lo'i dri ba gnyis dang*/ so sor thar pa'i 'grel pa rnam gsum dang*/ mdo chung bzhi dang*/ blo sbyong dang*/ gdams ngag dang*/ sman lha'i mdo sgrub dang*/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs gnyis dang*/ gzhan yang gdams phran mang du gsan no/ / gsang phu'i gdan sa pa slob dpon chen po shāka gzhon pa la byams pa'i chos lnga 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dbu ma rtsa shes 'grel pa ga la 'jigs med dang*/ rang rgyud shar gsum dang*/ de rnams kyi 'grel pa lnga dang*/ dgongs 'grel dang*/ sā lu ljang pa'i mdo 'grel dang*/ rnam par mi rtog pa la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa dang*/ dbu ma sgom rim rnam pa gsum dang*/ jo bo'i chos 'byung brgya rtsa dang*/ mngon pa gong 'og gnyis 'grel bshad dang bcas pa dang*/ bslab btus dang*/ mdo sde kun las btus dang*/ tshad ma kun las btus rtsa 'grel dang bcas pa dang*/ rig pa'i sgo dang rtog ge sde bdun dang*/ dmigs pa brtag pa dang*/ 'dul ba 'od ldan dang*/ chos mchog chung ngu dang*/ nyi khri snang ba dang*/ sher snying 'grel pa dang bcas pa de rnams gsan no// de nas dpal karma pa'i gdan sa chen por phebs par chas pa'i tshe chos skyong dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams na bza' dang rgyan mdzes pas bklubs te glu len pa gzigs pas gzhan phan 'byung bar dgongs te karmar phebs/ karma'i yang dgon du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig nam langs tsam la 'od kyi dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i nang du bi ma la gsal bar gzigs pa rang gi mdzod spur thim pa byung*/ de nas brtsams te rdzogs pa chen po'i tshig don thams cad gsal bar mkhyen nas snying thig gi yig cha mdzad/ chu yos lor sa skya'i 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan gong du phebs pa dang mjal zhing chos kyi gsung gleng mdzad pa'i tshe/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' du ma gzigs pa'i dag snang 'phel ba dang*/ sku tshe dang phrin las ci 'byung gi ltas gsal bar gzigs/ nub gcig rnal lam du nub phyogs kyi zhing khams sa'i mthil mnyam zhing rin po che'i mchod rten mang pos bskor ba zhig tu phebs pa'i tshe 'di ni bde ba can no zhes grags pa byung*/ yang ri bo mdzes pa zhig gi steng du phebs pas shākya'i rgyal po la 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba gzigs nas chos kyi dri lan mdzad/ de nyid yi ger bkod pa rnal lam gyi mdo sde'i bstan bcos bya ba de yin/ ri rab kyi rtser khang pa brtsegs pa'i drung du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gsum gyis byams chos mgrin gcig tu gsan pas byams chos mtha' dag gi don thugs su sngar bas kyang gsal bar byung*/ khang brtsegs de'i 'og gser ri'i steng nas thugs rje chen po'i phyag nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'bab pa shel gyi snod du gsol zhing gzhan la bkye bar snang bas snyigs dus kyi gdul bya'i tsha gdung sel nus par dgongs/ kun spyod kyi 'grel pa mdzad tshe mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rin po che du ma stsol bar gzigs/ rgyud don zab mo rnams rin po che bzhin du dgos 'dod 'byung bar dgongs/ lha steng gi khor yug nags tshal chen po yod pa la glo bur du me shor nas thams cad ci bya'i brtol dang bral te mkhas btsun gzhon nu 'bum gyis me'i 'jigs pa las bskyab tu gsol zhes zhus pas/ bdag ni lhag bsam rnam dag dang ldan te// sngon tshe rgyal ba rnams la tshogs bsags shing*// da ltar sa bcu'i dbang phyug yin gyur na// bden pa 'di yi bden tshig brjod pa'i mthus// me chen 'bar ba'i tshogs 'di zhi gyur cig/ ces se gol mdzad pa'i mod la du ba kham nag nam mkhar khyab pa me lce dang 'dres mar 'khrigs pa las 'brug sgra dang char rgyun chen po byung nas me thams cad skad cig gis zhi zhing 'phags ma sgrol ma gsal bar gzigs/

yang 'khor dang snyan grags ma bzod pa'i skye bo phrag dog gi khyad nor can kha cig gis mthu byed par brtsams te/ mi brgyad kyis phug par gshin rje drag tu bsgrubs nas rbad pa de'i tshe/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed dgra nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa me dpung gi nang na khros pas sngags sgra sgrogs shing des rigs sngags bzlog par gzigs pa na/ phug pa dib ste de dag pha rol tu song zhing*/ gzhan yang cho 'phrul mi 'tsham pa du ma byung bas de dag 'khor bcas skrag ste 'bul bshags rgya cher byas/ de nas tsha ba'i co brag ri khar byon pa'i tshe/ kha ba dkar po'i dge bsnyen drag 'dul mi dkar rta dkar dar dkar po thogs nas shar phyogs dge bsnyen rang gi lha'i khang pa gsal bar bstan/ kha ba dkar por pheb nas de'i gnas yig kyang mdzad/ rje 'dis/ bai ro tsa na spyugs pa'i yul rgyal mo tsha ba rong yang 'di yin zhes gsungs/ de nas kaṃ po gnas nang du byon pa'i tshe dge bsnyen rdo rje dpal brtsegs te rta dkar rngog dmar zhon zhing dar mdung thogs nas dga' bzhin du bsu ba byed pa gzigs/ shar kol te'i 'khrug chen sus kyang ma bzlum par yun ring ba de lha 'dre 'khrugs par mkhyen nas ting nge 'dzin gyis lha 'dre rnams bkug ste zil gyis mnan pas bka' bsgrub par dam bcas te de nyid du rang zhir song*/ gnas sgor tho rangs kyi rnal lam zhig la grub chen o rgyan pa phyag tu rma bya'i sgro bsnams pas gdams ngag gi gnad thams cad rdzogs par gnang ba 'byung*/ de'i nang par 'dus pa rnams la sngon du grub chen o rgyan pas khyod shangs kyi tsha rir shog gdams ngag ma lus sbyin no gsungs pa'i yi ge pho nya dang bcas pa byung bas bka' bzhin sgrub par spro mod kyi mngon sum du mjal mi thub par 'dug /'on kyang dag pa'i snang bar gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs pa yin gsungs de ma thag grub chen rin po che yang gshegs par snang*/

slar dbus su byon pa na gnyan chen thang lha sogs kyis bsu bar dpon slob du mas gzigs/ gzhan dag gis na bun gyi phreng bar mthong*/ mtshur phur phebs pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams dgyes pa'i gar gyis rol pa gzigs/ 'gro la cung zad phan pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ lha sar jo bo'i dbu thog tu gser gyi gdugs ngo mtshar can phul tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas par mchod sprin byung bar gzigs/ dgyes rdor brtag gnyis kyi 'grel ba mdzad pa na byang chub sems 'grel mtha' dag thugs la ma bsgrib par gsal/ grub thob chen po'i dgongs pa yongs su bskang ba'i phyir/ snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa dang*/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs kyi lugs dang*/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang*/ 'byung po 'dul byed dang*/ 'khor lo chen po dang*/ sdom 'byung rgyud 'grel dang bcas pa dang*/ gshed dmar dang*/ dgra nag dang*/ gdong drug dang*/ 'jigs byed rnams kyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs rnams dang*/ rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ mngon 'byung gi dbang sgrub thabs bcas dang*/ gdan bzhi dang*/ gur dang*/ sam+bu ṭi dang rgyud de gsum gyi 'grel pa dang*/ gsang snying dang*/ yang dag gi rgyud zhi khro'i skor rnams dang*/ 'jam dpal sku sgrub dang*/ pad+ma gsung sgrub dang*/ phur pa dbang rdzogs la sogs sgrub pa bka' brgyad dang*/ de nyid 'dus pa dang*/ dpal mchog rigs 'dus dang*/ rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud dang*/ ngan song sbyong rgyud dang*/ de'i dkyil 'khor cho ga sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ gtsug dgu dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang dang*/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba dbang dang bcas pa dang*/ rdo rje bdud rtsi dang*/ sangs rgyas thod pa dang*/ gsang ldan dang*/ dpa' bo gcig sgrub dang*/ spyi rgyud dang*/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud dang*/ zhi byed rgyud pa phyi ma'i lugs rnams dang kaṃ lugs dang*/

so lugs dang*/ lam 'bras zhwa lugs dang sa lugs dang*/ dmar zhabs dang*/ sbyor drug gi rigs brgyad dang*/ gzhan yang gdams phran mang po dang*/ sa sde lnga dang*/ mngon pa gong ma kun las btus dang*/ mdzod rang 'grel dang bcas pa dang*/ phung po lnga'i rab tu byed pa dang*/ theg bsdus skor gsum dang*/ sum cu pa dang*/ yum rgyas 'bring rnam pa gsum dang de dag gi 'grel ba 'ga' zhig dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i mdo sde lnga bcu dang*/ mdo pad+ma dkar po dang*/ snying rje chen po pad+ma dkar po dang*/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po dang*/ gzungs 'dus rgyas pa dang*/ snyan ngag me long dang*/ grub mtha' rnam 'byed dang*/ bsdus pa'i skor sogs mang po gsan par mdzad/ dus 'khor gsan pa'i tshe bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang mkha' 'gror bcas pa'i snang ba shar zhing 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang phyag na pad+ma'i byin rlabs kyis phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi gnad rnams gsal par dgongs/ 'byung 'dul gsan pa'i tshe khro bo 'khor bcas mnal lam du gzigs shing sngags sgra 'brug ltar grags pa gsan/ de'i tshe ko ber bas bar chad byas pa drung nyid mgon po ber nag can tu mdzad nas btul ba rtogs ldan grags seng pas rnal lam du gzigs/ dpon slob bdun gyis dpa' bo'i ston mo zhig mdzad tshe o rgyan gyi mkha' 'gro ma gsum nam mkha' la 'ongs te glu gar gyi mchod pa byas/ re zhig khyung rdzong du dben sa mdzad cing*/ de'i tshe grub chen o rgyan pa mnal lam du byon te bsnyen sgrub kyi gnad rnams gsal bar bstan/ yan lag brgyad pa la sogs pa gso ba'i gzhung dang gdams ngag mang po lha rje sna ras la sogs mkhas pa 'ga' la gsan no/ /slob dpon tshul khrims rin chen pa la/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang de'i 'grel pa dang*/ bshad rgyud bzhi dang*/ 'phags skor cha lag ma lus pa dang*/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dang*/ ma hā mā ya dang*/ rdo rje gur dang*/ gdan bzhi'i phran dang*/

mes rngog nas brgyud pa'i dgyes rdor gyi rgya gzhung rnams dang*/ gshin rje kha thun gyi skor dang*/ gnam lcags ur mo dang*/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'grel ba gru rdzing dang*/ rin chen rnam bdun dang*/ bde mchog snyan brgyud la sogs bla ma mar pa'i gdams ngag dang bka' lung rnams gsan no/ /slob dpon gzhon nu 'bum la/ 'jam dpal khro bo 'dus pa dang*/ ur mo pa tra'i rgyud dang sgrub thabs dang*/ bstan srung kyi rgyud dang sgrub thabs brgya phrag bcu gcig lhag tsam dang*/ ro snyoms dang thub pa lnga la sogs gsan/ 'di dag gi skabs su dag snang mang po yod de ma bris gsungs mod/ spyir 'phags pa'i sa la gnas pa 'di lta bu'i mnyam bzhag thun gcig gi gzigs snang yang so so skye bo rnams kyis lo brgyar brjod par ga la nus/ 'onakyang 'di ltar bstan pa ni tshur mthong gi ngo tsam du dgongs par bas so// slob dpon dzñān shrī la 'grel pa mtha' drug chen mo dang*/ gsung gi 'od zer la sogs pa'i 'grel ba 'ga' dang*/ 'chi med chen po la sogs pa mang du gsan/ rdzogs chen gsang bskor gyi rgyud dang 'grel pa dang*/ gdams phran dang*/ 'chi med dang ni gu'i chos drug dang*/ phyag rgya chen po ga'u ma dang*/ de rnams ri khrod ras pa las gsan/ gsang skor dang snying thig gi rgyud 'grel 'ga' dang*/ phran 'ga' bla ma ku ma rā dza la gsan/ mdor na bod kyi yul du bka' bstan man ngag 'gyur ro cog thams cad gsan par mdzad ste dam pa'i chos la gus pa dang*/ bla ma med par rang bzos mi 'jug pa'i gdams ngag mig ltos su ston par mdzad/ de thams cad kyang tshar re gsan pa tsam gyis tshig gdon tha dag skad cig res thugs su chud kyang ched chung dang brnyas thabs mi mdzad par nan chags su mdzad/ sa ris kho na mdzad pas lcags smyug bdun zad par grags/ gsan yig gi chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ming kho na'ang deng sang gi skye bo'i spyod yul du mi chud/

lcags khyi lor mtshal dpon dga' bde gshegs dus skyi shod kyi dge 'dun rnams kyi gral dbu la chen po smon lam rdo rje bas gung thang du spyan drangs/ g.yag sde pan chen gyis mtshal ba'i sar bzhugs tshe mjal du byon/ phyag ma phul bar bdag dad na dge ba'i bshes gnyen du bsten pa lags pas zhag 'ga' zhabs phyir bsdad ste brtag par zhus pas mnyes bzhin gnang*/ nyin par dge bshes mtha' yas pa la mdo sngags kyi bshad chen rgya mtsho lta bu mang du mdzad/ mtshan mo dbang rjes gnang zab khrid dpag med gnang*/ bar rnams su skye bo dpag med la mjal kha gser yig pa dpag med la zhal bkod/ tshal pa'i sku gsung thugs rten mang po dang khyad par bka' bstan 'gyur gyi zhal bskos sogs rlabs chen gyi mdzad pa rgya mtsho rnams gcig go gcig gis mi 'gag cing sku gsung thugs dal zhing lhod chags pa las mi g.yo bar gzigs/ chos kyi dka' ba'i gnas rnams dris pa de tsam ni dka' ba ma yin te de las gzhan 'di dang 'di lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa na sngon rnal lam du yang ma gsan pa kho na gsan/ nyin re re bzhin mkhas pa dang grub pa'i mtha' je mi dpogs su song*/ blo'i ra ba las brgal te zhabs la spyi bos gtugs nas sprul pa'i sku rin po che zhes rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog tu 'dzin/ 'pho ba zhus pas rnam shes tshangs bug nas 'pho ba yin gsungs/ gzer lnga zhus pas gzer lnga mi dgos gcig gis sdom ste mchi gsung pas de kho na ltar 'dug ces lhag par dad/ jo mo gangs su dben pa bsten pa'i tshe/ kong po'i yul mi kun chos la mos pa dang*/ der gzhan la phan par 'gyur ba'i ltar gzigs/

dwags la sgam po'i zang lung ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bla ma lha rje zla 'od gzhon nu dang mngon sum du mjal/ phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pas gzhan don 'byung ba'i rten 'brel shar gsungs/ kong por phebs nas yul de'i mi ma yin pa rnams kyis chos la gus shing bka' bzhin bsgrub bo zhes zer ba gsan zhing*/ der lo gsum bar du bzhugs shing bka' la nyan pa'i ltas ngo mtshar du ma gzigs/ gnas chen tsā ri trar phebs ba'i tshe g.yu mtsho mkha' 'gro'i pho phrang dngos su gzigs/ yul smad du phebs par dgongs te yul stod kyi chos khri bar du byon/ rten 'brel cung ma 'grig kyang phag mo'i phyag dpe lung nang de phyogs su rlung gis khyer te ma 'dus pa'i nga'i chos kyi bstan pa 'byung gsungs te/ phyis phag mo kar lugs gnas der dar/ rang byung gi dur khrod chen por byon pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis dngos grub 'bul ba dang*/ bar gcod zhi ba'i snang ba byung gsungs bkra shis ljongs su gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs rnams kyis mkha' la gar byed cing glu dbyangs len pa gzigs/ gnas der dag pa'i snang ba mang du byung zhes yang yang gsungs/ de dag gi tshe gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par rtogs shing rlung sems la dbang thob pa'i sgom chen rnal 'byor pa du ma smin par mdzad/ chu mo glang gi lo la gu ru las 'brel rtsal gyis/ lho brag tu rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gter nas bton pa'i shog ser phyag tu phul/ tsa ri'i bon lung du zla ba gsum der bzhugs nas gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ o rgyan rin po che dang dngos su mjal nas dbang lung rnams rdzogs par gnang*/ de nas dbus su pheb pa'i sham po gangs kyi mdun du phyi'i yul snang dang nang gi rtsa rlung rnams kyi rten 'brel ma lus pa'i gnas gsal bar mkhyen/ sku'i bar chad rnams zhi zhing gzhan la phan pa'i yi dam yang mdzad/

jo mo gangs la dben pa bsten nas yun ring du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ o rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma 'byung gnas nam mkhar gsal bar snang zhing rang la thim pa'i snang ba yun ring du byung gsungs/ mtshur phu spungs kyi ri khrod du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ phyi nang gi gza' skar dus sbyor thams cad ji lta ba gzigs te rtsis kun bsdus pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/ gsang ba 'dus pa mar lugs gsan pa'i dus su nyid kyi sku la gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rdzogs par snang zhing*/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa phyi rol tu ma lus par dag pa'i sems kyi ngo bor rtogs pa'i nges shes 'khrungs/ yang gnas der 'di nas 'jig rten dpag med 'das pa'i zhing khams zhig na rgyal ba spos kyi glang po dang*/ de'i gsung rab po ti mang po gzigs/ yang der cho ga mang du mdzad pa'i tshe rgyal ba thams cad dgongs pa gcig pa dang*/ yi dam rang rig gi rtsal du mkhyen/ yang 'jig rten gyi khams mang po 'das pa'i byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten na 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa da ltar sangs rgyas pa'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i ston 'khor zhing khams thams cad du yun ring du gsal bar gzigs/ yang mgon po byams pa rgyal sras 'bum phrag du ma'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i mthar byon pa na byams pa nyid kyi drung du gshegs par spro yang 'khor gyi khrod du ma thar bas steng gi nam mkha' nas byon kyang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun mang po'i steng du 'gro ba ni bdag gi cha ma yin dgongs te sa 'og nas mgon po'i drung du 'thon par mdzad cing*/ pad+ma'i sdong po sprul pa'i steng nas mjal zhing gzhan phan la bskul ba'i gsol ba btab/ yang gangs dkar chos 'byung phug par bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bskor ba gzigs pas bstod pa yang mdzad/ ba tshwa phug nag tu bzhugs pa'i tshe mi ma yin rnams kyis phyag 'tshal zhing bskor ba byed pa byung bas thugs gegs las grol/

chos rje'i bzhugs gnas gra ma gru bzhi'i dgon par phur pa'i dbang rdzogs la sogs bka' lung rnams gsan pa'i tshe/ rje de nyid kyi snang ba shar/ der snyigs ma'i dus kyi rang gzhan gyi rgyud la phan par 'gyur ba'i ltas gzigs nas mtshur bde chen stengs kyi ri khrod 'debs par mdzad/ de'i tshe rnal lam du rgyal ba'i mchod rten dang ring bsrel dbyibs legs 'od zer 'phro ba mang du rnyed pa byung bas bka' brgyud kyi gral thub pa'i sgom chen mang du 'byung bar mkhyen/ shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing du bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyal sras spos kyi glang po'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gzigs/ bde chen ltag gi chu mig brgya rtsa'i ri khrod du gcod dang 'od gsal la sogs pa gzhan la bstan pas/ rje nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi nyin mtshan 'dres pa'i tshul du snang zhing*/ slob ma'ang de lta bu mang du byung*/ de dus dpon slob rnams la 'tsho ba lha 'dres sbyar bas mi'i zas la cher ma brten/ kha rag shar gyi ri khrod du ston zla 'bring po'i nya la slob dpon pad+ma'i dag snang shar/ snying khu pad+ma'i phug par mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa'i dag snang shar bas rdo rje'i glu mang po len par mdzad/ yang bde chen du dben pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang por rgyal sras rnams kyi byang chub kyi spyod pa rgya chen po gzigs pas de dag gi rjes su lhag par yi dam mdzad/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho nas gsungs pa'i rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi gnad ma lus pa ji lta ba mkhyen nas phyi nang gzhan gsum gcig tu grub pa'i bstan bcos mdzad/ ngag rlung yi ge'i rten 'brel nam mkha' gser gyi yi ge'i phreng bar snang zhing*/ sku'i spu khung du thim zhing 'phro bar gzigs/ ma mgon lcam dral dang rdo rje legs pas bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan rnams snyan du gsol/ phung khams ngo bo nyid kyis 'dus pa'i lha tshogs su rtogs nas rdo rje phreng ba nas gsungs pa bzhin du phyi nang sbyar ba'i 'dus pa'i grub thabs mdzad/

rdor sems he ru kas byin gyis rlob pa dang phyi rol du'ang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i 'ja' 'od kyis nam mkhar khyab par gzigs te dam tshig rgya mtsho rtsa 'grel mdzad/ bde chen steng du lcags pho spre'u'i lo la/ g.yung ston/ sman lung sprul sku shāka gzhon/ slob dpon rgyal mtshan/ rtogs ldan ye rgyal/ slob dpon ye shes rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dpal brtson 'grus seng ge drug la/ dbang khrid rnams rdzogs par gnang nas/ chos thon pa'i skabs su/ pad+ma nas brgyud pa'i snying thig skor cig yod thang pa la snyam rung nga bar ma byung*/ da res 'di byung ba legs/ da nub pa 'phangs pas/ rang re rnam pa lnga pos/ gtsang dbus ru mtshams khams rgya nag tu dar bar mdzad do// 'jam dpal brtson 'grus seng ge rang gis nyams su longs gsungs nas gnang*/ rnal lam du ku ru kul+le 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba zhig gis 'byung po'i gnod pa zhi bar mdzad pa gzigs/ sa ra ha dang chos kyi grags pa la sogs pa'i ye shes kyi sku dang dngos su 'gro ba mdzad pas gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu rnams rtsol med du mkhyen/ jo mo gangs dkar gyi phug par slob dpon pad+ma'i sku bzhengs pa'i tshe de'i phrin las kyi lhag mas rje nyid kyis phyogs thams cad du phrin las 'grub pa'i ltas gzigs/ g.yas ru shangs la byon te so nam kho mo'i 'brong la byed zer zhing 'brong nas bya byi yan gsod pas 'tsho ba'i lung nas de'i skye bo rnams btul te srog gcod spang ba la ring du bkod/ de'i tshe shākya'i rgyal pos thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis sems can rnams kyi sgrib pa sel bar gzigs/ yul de'i mi ma yin pa rnams kyang btul nas sha khrag gi sred pa las bzlog ste rang gzhan la phan par byed pa dam bcas shing bstan la gus par gyur/ dpal ldan sa skyar phebs pa'i tshe dge 'dun gyi sde/ dgon gnas/ lha khang thams cad du yo byad thams cad chags med du bkye/

yul khams de thams cad kyi mi ma yin pa mchog dman thams cad kyis ris med du bkur zhing 'bul nod ni de bas kyang rgya che/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang zab mo'i chos kyi 'di la mchid mdzad/ kun mkhyen dol po pa chen pos kyang 'di skabs mjal bar 'dug cing khyed kyis da lta'i 'di ma yin pa'i lta ba khyad 'phags zhig rtogs par 'dug gsungs pa/ khong de skabs dbu ma rang stong gi grub mtha' dgyes kyang*/ mi ring bar gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i gnad ji bzhin tu mkhyen pa la dgongs par 'dug /o rgyan pa'i sku'i skye ba gtso bor gyur pa'i skal ldan mtha' yas pa rjes su bzung*/ de nas rim par dbus su phebs rtsis btsan brag dgon par phebs pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la gtor ma gnang bas dpal mgon po yun ring du gsal bar gzigs/ rgyal mkhar dbu ri'i dgon par 'dus pa mang po la sems bskyed sogs chos gsung pa'i tshe/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlob pa gzigs/ kun gyi mthun snang du nyi ma sngar las nyis 'gyur gyis ring ba byung*/ de nas 'dol chung ldan yul ri khrod/ bla yig lha sa gong*/ phung phung*/ gnas sar/ rma bya/ dkar lung la sogs pa'i yul phyogs rnams su phebs shing byin gyis brlabs/ gar byon du dam pa'i chos kyis smin grol du mdzad pa bgrang gis mi langs/ nyang stod nas yar 'brog la 'byon pa'i tshe/ kha ro'i la rgyab tu ha bo gangs bzang sad grang mo ma gtong zhig /zhes lan gnyis gsung ba mdzad/ kha ro'i la rgyab tshe/ hor zla bcu gnyis pa yin kyang shin tu dro ba sos ka'i tshad pa lta bu byung*/ rje nyid kyi rnam par rol pas gdul bya mang por dag pa'i snang ba du ma shar zhing*/ khyad par rtogs ldan grags seng gis rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa du ma gzigs/ spyan ras gzigs kyis snyigs ma'i dus la brten pas phyi nang gi bar chad 'byung srid pas zlog pa'i thabs la brtson par gyis shig ces gsung ba gsan/

mtshur lha lung du sku 'bum la zhig gso dang gser gsol ba'i tshe/ ma 'ongs pa na dge slong dung du gyur pas rgyal ba byams pa'i mchod rten byed par mkhyen/ bar chad zhi ba dang gzhan phan mtha' yas 'byung bar mkhyen/ dkon brtsegs kyi bsdus don mdzad cing gzhan la gsung pa'i tshe/ gsung rab kyi yi ge'i tshogs kyis zhing kun khyab pa'i stong gzugs shar/ 'brong bu'i gtsug lag khang du dag pa'i snang bar byams pa 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs rnams kyi drung du mchod pa 'bul bar mdzad/ bde chen steng gi dben par sgrub pa rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i skabs zhig rnal lam du skyes bu gcig gis/ dwags kong phyogs kyi gdul bya rnams la spyan ras gzigs kyi 'od zer 'gyed pa yin pas/ dpal karma pa'i lung bstan bzhin du 'dul ba'i dus la bab po zhes zer ba gsan/ yul phyogs de'i mi dang mi ma yin pa du ma gdan 'dren du byung ba'i stabs kyis/ shing byi lo zla ba drug pa'i dkar tshes la bde chen nas chags bteg /rgyal brgyud nas rim gyis nyang por phebs/ khams dang kong po'i mtshams su ri khrod 'debs pa'i gnas mi'i bdag tu ma bzung bar yod par mkhyen nas/ nags mda'i grong nas de'i lung pa'i phur gshegs par brtsams pa la gsungs pa na su yang 'gro bar ma spro/ yul mis kyang mi thar ba'i tshul zhus pas do nub rmi lam blta'o gsungs nas/ sang nyin ri dang lam sogs bkod pa 'di ltar 'dug zhib par gsungs pas yul mi rnams dad pa thob ste der theg nas sgrub sde btab/ gnas de shin tu grang na'ang sgrub pa po rnams kyi chu sgor la dgun sgang chen yang wa chu sogs mi 'khyags pa dang*/ dkon mchog gi mchod pa byed gsungs nas sgrub sde'i gdong thad kyi bal sur dang stag ma rnams dgu 'dren dus me tog 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs te/ da lta 'ang de bzhin yod/ gnas der ting nge 'dzin shin tu 'phel zhing gzhan la phan pa'i ltas kyang mang du byung gsungs/

gzhan yang lo gcig gi nang du skug sde dgon gnas mang du 'debs par mdzad cing*/ mtha' 'khob kyi skye 'gro thams cad skyabs 'gro dang byang chub sems la bkod/ lta bar gyi yul du byon pa'i tshe yul de'i zhing dang tshal thams cad gtsang pos non pa la/ gtsang 'gram du chos khri brtsigs nas/ bdag gi lhag bsam dag pa'i bden tshig gis/ /chu bo khyod ni phar la ldog par gyis/ /zhes gsung ste phyag nas mdzad pas de ma thag tu chung bar gyur/ mtsho'i shul sas gang ba la slar zhing dang tshal byas te deng sang du'ang yul du yod/ khyad par slob dpon chen po'i sgrub gnas lkog phreng du mdzad cing dben pa bstan pa'i tshe/ ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab lhag par gsal bar gyur nas zab mo nang don gyi rnam bshad mdzad/ shar phyogs rgya la las gshin gyi gnas su gzigs te ngan 'gro dpag med drangs/ rnam thos tshal du byon te kong lung ral gsum gyi skye bo thams cad la chos rgya dkar po mdzad de gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la bzhag /phrag ru gtsug lag bzhengs shing rab gnas mdzad tshe/ sa g.yo ba dang me tog gi char kun gyis bzung du yod pa byung*/ shing ram spang du phebs tshe tshad ma paṇa chen bas chibs rags kyi khrod du gnas chen tsā ri'i mkhris su sleb nas ma mjal zhus pas/ tsā ri'i gnas dgun gyi kha bas non pas ngas bstan mi thub/ tsā ri'i mkha' 'gro dgos na bstan gyis gsungs/ ston par zhu zhus pas rlung bus lta stangs mdzad de chibs sngon la shar gyis bzhud/ cung zad na na bun dang 'ja' tshon 'dris ma nar byung ba'i khrod nas bu mo lo bco brgyad snyan pa'i glu len zhing byung*/ chibs 'then te phyag dbang dang dar mdud re gnang nas da song shig gsung ste pha tshad du yal/ sku 'khor rnams la'ang phyag mdud re gnang nas khyed rnams de'i rjes su yid ma 'phro cig snga res nga'i 'khor mang po 'di tshos khyer/ da res karma pa nang so'i chibs pa de khyer song bas thub ste 'ong gsungs/

de nas yar phebs tshe so chag 'phrang gi brag 'og mtsho chen por yod cing ri rtse bskor dgos pa la de'i tshe bye ma'i sgang lam chen po byung ste de la theg 'di lta bu sngon ma byung bar gleng*/ phebs nas zhag gnyis gsum na lam de mi snang bar sngar bzhin mtshor gyur/ dwags lha sgam por bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi gsal snang du ma gzigs/ de'i tshe me tog gi char bab yul phyogs de thams cad du chos khri g.yo ba la sogs pa'i ltas dang*/ las bzhi'i phrin las du ma bstan pa ni smos kyis mi langs/ me stag zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes la lha sar phebs/ shākya'i rgyal po phrin las 'byung ba'i ltas du ma phyags phyi'i dge bshes rnams kyis so sor mthong*/ sngon stod lung nyen gyi phur sman chu gsol ba'i tshe ljags la reg ma thag 'di la chu phal pa sum gnyis/ sman gyi chu sum cha gcig tu snang ste/ lce'i dbang pos shes so gsung chu mig tu phyag bcug ste/ shar nas skye ba'i dron mo shed med 'di chu phal pa ste/ sum gnyis snang nub nas skye ba'i grang mo shed can 'di sman gyi chu ste sum cha gcig snang ngo gsungs/ mkhas pa shes rin pa de la yid ches ma skyes/ de nas byin rlabs kyis chu phal pa skye ba nub nas sman chu de cher 'phel bas yul mi rnams sngon chu 'di'i sum cha tsam las mi yong*/ rje phebs nas sum 'gyur du 'phel sngar bas ches grang zhing nus pa che bar 'dug zer ba gsan/ zhal nas ngas de skad byas te/ dge bshes 'di nga'i tshig la yid mi ches bar 'dug gsungs bas zhum zhing dad de/

shin tu lkog gyur thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul// mngon sum nyid du mjal ba'i blo ldan la// byol song phyugs kyi phyugs dang rab mtshungs pa// bdag blos nongs par gyur pa mthol zhing bshags// slan chad khyod kyi rnam shes tshogs drug 'di// bya ba grub dang so sor rtogs pa yi// ye shes dag pa dri med yin min gyi// the tshom gcod mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes ched du brjod par byas/ 'di res rnam thos tshal du rgyal ba'i tshems bstan pa'i tshe lo tsā sgyur zhig gsungs/ khong gis skad 'gags nas mi thon mchi zhus pas khyod rang sgyur zhig skad nga nyid kyis shes gsungs*/ de'i tshe skad che zhing snyan pa byung*/ de tshar nas yang sngon bzhin du thal bas/ tshangs pa dang ni dri za'i rgyal po la'ang*// gzhan gyi ngag la dbang sgyur 'di med na// bdag gi ngag la dbang sgyur chos kyi rje// mtshungs med ngag gi dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/ khong pas tsā ri'i zhol du 'dir lo gsum sgrub pa byed pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhus pas/ bar gcod 'ong de dus gtsang du'ang 'khrug pa chen po 'ong*/ nga'i phyags phyir khams su 'deng gsungs/ de nas de ma thag tshal khams gnyis 'khrug /'di lags sam zhus pas 'di ni 'go 'dzugs kyi chung ngu ste rim par 'ong gsung ste gzhi thog dang dpon chen nang zhig sogs dbus gtsang kun ma bde/ hor dmag mang du 'grims pa sogs gsung ji lta ba bzhin byung bas/ dus gsum la ni sgrib pa mi mnga' ba'i// kun mkhyen sgrib med de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod snang ngo*// gzhan yang thos pas dregs pa mang pos mjal ba na/ kho rang gi nga rgyal dang bstun pa'i ming nas 'bod/ bsngags pa mdzad/ kho rang gi sngon gyi byed spyod dang zhar la phyis 'byung sogs yi ger bkod de gnang bas nga rgyal zhi ste snod ldan du gyur pa mang du byung*/ lha sar mtshal pa dang khams pa'i 'khrug pa sdum par mdzad/

de nas mdo khams su byon/ dpal ldan karma'i gtsug lag khang gog pa rnams gso bar mdzad cing gdul bya rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ zhi lhag zung du chud pa'i bsam gtan pa brgya phrag du ma byung*/ chos sku'i gnas lugs klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa ji bzhin du mkhyen nas chos dbyings bstod pa'i 'grel pa mdzad/ sa 'brug lo zla ba dang po shar ba'i tshe thugs dam gsal snang du ma shar zhing chos skyong rnams kyis bskul bas dge bsnyen rdo rje rgyal po'i gnas sog chu la zam pa mdzad pa'i phyir byon/ klu rgyal 'khor bcas kyis phrin las bsgrubs nas rdzu 'phrul gyis lcags zam btsug /der spyan ras gzigs kyis/ 'jig rten zang zing byed na bar chad 'byung*// dben gnas gzhan du phyin yang chos mi 'phel// don med phrag dog byed pa mang du 'byung*// de bas dpal ldan nags phu'i ri khrod song*// zhes bskul bas nags phur phebs/ der thugs dam shin tu 'phel zhing dag snang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ nub cig rnal lam du 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis lo gsum nas tong kun rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs dgos par lung bstan/ rgyu mtshan des gdul bya thams cad nyams len la lhag par bskul bar mdzad/ sa sbrul dbyar nyi ldog pa'i dus su rgyud kyi rgyal po 'bum pa nas bshad pa'i rtsa rlung byang chub sems kyi gnad rnams mkha' 'gros brdas bstan nas legs par mkhyen te/ rnal 'byor gsum snying gi 'grel pa mdzad/ nor bzang gis bla ma bsten pa'i tshul yang yang dran pas kun bzang gi spyod pa'i smon lam mdzad/ tsā rir byon pa'i tshe spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ dben pa bsten na ting 'dzin yon tan 'phel// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la 'gro ba yang*// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis gsal dang 'grib pa yod// mkha' la rgyu skar rnam par bkra ba yang*// nyi zla'i rkyen gyis gsal dang mi gsal yod//

rang gzhan don la legs par brtag par gyis// zhes gsungs te/ mi snang bar gyur cing mkha' 'gro'i ltas du ma gzigs pas sku skye ba phyi ma'i bzhugs gnas su dgos par mkhyen nas skyen du dgon sar lhun grub steng btab/ 'di la brtags na sems dpa' chen po'i spyod pa bdag las gzhan gces kyi thugs bskyed pas rgya yul du 'byon dgos pa'i rten 'brel 'grig nas sku tshe mthar mi phyin par phrin las kyi lhag mar kong po dang nye bar skye ba bzhes dgos pa mkhyen par 'dug /sgom chen rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ theg pa chen po'i rnam thar spel phyir phal chen zhing bkod kyi bstan bcos mdzad/ de'i tshe hor rgyal po'i gdan 'dren byung*/ de'ang se chen gyi rgyal sa lo so lnga/ the mur ol ja dus lo bcu gnyis/ hwa shan ol ja dus lo lnga/ du yan du rgyal pos lo bcu gnyis/ go gan rgyal pos lo brgyad/ ra khyi phag gis zhag bzhi bcu/ gu thug rgyal pos zla ba gcig rnams rgyal sa rim par byas shing 'das/ thog the mur 'ja' yan du rgyal pos sa mo sbrul lo la rgyal sar thon nas lo gsum pa lcags lug lor gser yig pa ky-in cang hu'i zhing gi mi dpon mgon po tshim ching gis gtso byas mi dpon du ma lcags mo lug gi lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga la dbus su sleb/ chos rje pa kong po nas gdan 'dren la sgom pa btang pas lhun grub steng nas zla ba bdun pa la bteg nas gung thang du phebs/ sa skya nas chang gu'i gung kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa gong du 'byon pa dang lhan du 'dzom/ dus der chos rje pa gdan 'dren gyi 'jā' sa sgrags/ 'jā' sa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis bsod nams chen po'i dpal la brten nas rgyal po nged kyi lung rang byung rdo rje la gsol ba/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa byang phyogs kyi rgyal po rnams la dar bar 'gyur bar lung bstan pa'i stobs kyis/

sangs rgyas kyi chos lugs kyang ci rigs pa rtogs par yod 'dug /de rjes nas se chen rgyal pos kyang*/ bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rab tu mang po bsten zhing bkur bas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sa cha 'dir dar bar byas 'dug pa kun la gsal mod/ nged kyis kyang bstan pa'i skyong phran legs par byed 'dod pa dang*/ khyed thos pa mang po dang*/ yon tan khyad par du 'phags shing bzang po du ma dang yang ldan zer ba thos pas/ mgon po la sogs pa'i gser yig pa rnams khyed len du btang ba yin/ gal te khyed snyad gzhan byas nas mi yong bar gyur na/ dad pa can gyi sems sun 'byin pa'i nyes pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi yul spong ma thub pa'i bag chags sa bon dri nga ba dang*/ gzhan don phyogs med du byed par 'dod pa'i lhag bsam 'jig par 'gyur pa'i skyon dang*/ bstan pa la ma bsams par 'gyur ba'i sdig pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi dka' thub sdug bsngal la ji mi snyam pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ nged kyi khrims lugs chen po'i 'jā' sa la log pa byas pa'i sgo nas/ nged kyi sems ma rangs par byas pa'i stobs kyis bstan pa byin po la gnod pa byas par mi 'gyur ba e yin/ de bas na nged kyis mgo byas sems can thams cad kyi don la bsams nas mgyogs par byon/ 'dir phebs nas bstan pa'i bya ba khyed kyi 'dod pa dang mthun par sgrub pa yin/ lug lo dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes bcu gsum la ta'i tun yod du bris/ zer ba dang*/ 'jā' sa'i rten la karma pak+shi mong gor rgyal pos phul ba'i gser gyi dam kas gtso byas mchod pa'i chas du ma dang bcas pa phebs/ bla ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan la zā+on we sa pa 'bri phag mtshal gsum rnams la/ chos rje pa gong du gdan 'dren do dam pa sā+on chen dpan gyi mi dpon rnams kyi bka' shog ni/ rgyal po'i lung*/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bde rgyal 'od du dben sha /ye shes dpal kun dga' rdo rje/

byang chub rgyal mtshan rnams la/ rgyal bo'i lung gis/ bla ma karma pa gdan 'dren pa la/ mgon po la sogs pa 'di nas bsngags pa'i gser yig pa rnams dang lhan cig tu gyis la/ rin po che karma pa gar bzhugs pa song na'ang*/ khyed rnams kyis grogs dan gyis la gong du mgyogs pa yong du chug /le lo dang 'dzol ba byung bar song na/ nyes pa khyed rnams la len te 'ong*/ lug lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes dgu la/ zhes pa 'dug pas/ chang gu'i gung kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas/ chos rje pa gong du phebs pa'i zhu ba mdzad pa la zhal gyis bzhes/ chang gu'i gung pa sngon la gong du bzhud/ chos rjes pa 'dam du byon pas/ rgyal gyi zla ba la 'brug gi sgra chen po byung zhing*/ nyi ma gzas bzung*/ kha ba chen po byung bas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ rgyal po chen po'i sku tshe la bar chad 'ong*/ rang re der mi slebs pa 'dug gsungs nas tshur log /dgun mtshur phur bzhugs/ de bar gser yig pa tsho dbus kyi khri skor la bgos skabs der/ dbang dang dger ge shus/ bde rgyal 'od du dben sha la stag mgo 'phrog rtsis byas pa la bsten/ phan tshun dmag bsags lag thug par byung ba/ chos rje'i zhal ta 'byon pas 'jags/ du dben sha dang dger ge shu+u la dbang bskur mdzad/ gong du 'byon pa la 'u lag stong tsho tsam dgos par 'dug kyang*/ 'ja' mo dang mi sde la gzan par dgongs/ sos ka rang rta dang rang mdzo mdzad nas/ spre'u lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la mtshur phu nas bteg nas byon mdo khams su phebs tshe/ gong nas bsu ba la/ ra dza ta tshen dben dang*/ zam bha'o gnyis sleb/ 'jā' sa ni/ rgyal po'i lung gis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rang byung rdo rje la gsol ba/ nged kyis mgon po mngags nas/ khyed len du btang ba yin pa la/ nged kyi lung la log pa ma byas par yong gi yod zer ba thos pa'i don la/ ra dza ta tshen dben dang*/ zam bha'o gnyis mngags nas/ yi ge rten dang bcas pa bkur yod/

shin kun du ma bzhugs par zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes nyi shu'i khongs su pho brang du sleb par byon/ spre'u lo zla ba dang po'i tshes gnyis kyi nyin ta'i tun yod dus bris/ zhes mchod pa dang bcas pa byung*/ lam bar la zhabs tog gi don la zhing gi mi chen rnams kyi bka' shog rgyal po'i lung gi /cung zhu zhing*/ ci'i shun/ lo gsum pa zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum/ ye kha khe shig gi nyi ma gnyis pa la/ khu'i gang ga'o na gong ma bzhugs pa'i dus/ zur gur che/ ca'u cung ching*/ ming lig bho kha/ bha 'or/ che khe lu/ ul dhu che/ ga ra ba dur rnams yod pa'i dus su/ sa teg yi 'u ching la/ rgyal po'i lung byon nas/ karma pak+shi rang rta la 'byon gyin yod zer nas gser yig yong 'dug pas/ khyed zhing pas sngon la bsu ba thong*/ kho rang gi rang rta rang mdzo la rtsā chas byin/ rang rta gang chad sar rang rta'i lugs bzhin 'u lag byin/ bla ma chen po 'byon pa'i lugs bzhin mi dpon rnams kyis bsu ba gyis/ nyin par 'ja' sa phan gyi za ma dang*/ zhag sar mchod pa'i lugs bzhin du sprod du chug /gong ma'i lung bzhin du/ nged zhing gi mi dpon rnams kyis yi ge 'grims pa yin/ zhes pa sleb/ da dung mjal thub na rgyal po'i sku tshe la cung zad phan par dgongs nas mgyogs par byon/ mdo smad nas bzung*/ bsu ba dang*/ bkur sti chen po rim par byung*/ rgya bod kyi lam du 'gro don chen po'ang thogs med du mdzad/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu gnyis las g.yo ba dang bar gcod kyi ltas gzigs pas/ rgyal po gnam du gshegs pa mkhyen nas/ kyin jāng hur sgrib sbyong gi cho ga mdzad/ rgyal bu rat+na shris rtsa ba'i bla mar khur nas kyin cang hu'i kar sde btsug /de dus mnal lam du sngon gyi gdul bya rnams kyi don du ni/ phyin nas sems can rnams la phan par byas// bar du gcod pa gang yang mi 'byung zhing*// khyod kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur//

zhes chos skyong rnams kyis bsgrags pa gsan/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bco brgyad la pho brang chen por phebs/ de'i nyin el the mur tha'i shrī dang*/ ba yan tha'i shrī ba'o gnyis kyis shel gyi tho log thogs nas byon lam phye/ mi dpon thams cad kyis mu tig gi 'jigs su gon nas bsu ba dang*/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i bkod pa du mas mdun bsu byas/ rgyal po rin chen dpal blon po dang bcas pas bkur sti chen pos mchod/ rgyal po btsun mor bcas pa rnams la dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ gnas snang thams cad gsal bar mkhyen pa gzhan la'ang cung zad gsungs/ pho brang chen por cho ga mdzad pa'i tshe mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul gzigs pas/ rin chen dpal rgyal po'ang bar chad 'byung bar 'dug ces blon po rnams la gsungs/ me tog ldum rar ti shrī chen po kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas gdan drangs/ bzhugs gdan chos rje pa gong du bkur/ zla gcig nas gong ma gnam du gshegs te sgrib sbyong mdzad/ de'i gcen tho gan thi mur sman tse'i yul te/ rgya nag chen po na bzhugs pa rgyal sar bsko ba la/ rtsis pa rnams kyis zla ba drug 'then nas bskos na se chen dang mnyam pa 'ong zer/ chos rje kyang lung bstan te/ de'i ring e le the mur gyis srid skyong*/ bya lo zla ba dang po'i nya la rgyal po chen po tho gan the mur sman tse'i yul nas ta'i tu'i pho brang chen por gdan phebs pa bsu ba la/ skye bo bye ba phrag du ma 'tshogs pa'i nang du/ khrom la sus kyang lam mi phyed pa la/ chos rje thugs rje'i bdag nyid de nyid zhwa nag gsol/ /ma ṇi'i dbyangs mdzad gin byon pas/ khrom thams cad kyis go skabs phye/ sprel dkar gzim gur chen mo'i mdun du/ mi'i dbang po rgyal po chen po nyid byon nas/ chos rje pa nyid bsu zhed gus pa chen pos zhabs la gtugs/ mos gus dang 'bul ba bsam gyis mi khyab/ gong ma tha'i hu'i rgyal brgyud dang*/

el thi mur tha'i shrī la sogs mi dpon kun gyis dbang bskur dang chos zhus/ mdor na/ mi'i dbang po brgyud pa blon po btsun mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa chos lugs su dbang bskur dang sgom zhus/ 'jig rten lugs kyi gros dris/ chos dang 'jig rten gyi ltos sa thams cad chos rje pa la byas 'bul ba dang*/ bkur sti bsam gyis mi khyab nye gnas grags brtson tha'i hi dben gyi chen dben la bskos/ mi dpon mang pos/ tha'i shrī la ngan brtsams nas 'khrug pa chen po yong bar byung ba/ chos rje pas nged rang 'dod kyi bya ba ci yang ma khur bar/ khyed rgyal blon la bsams nas yongs pa la/ nged la bsam na phan tshun 'khrug pa bshol/ mthun par gyis/ zhes sogs zhal ta byon nas bde 'jam la bkod/ lo de'i zla ba drug pa'i tshes brgyad la pho brang shong tor rgyal po chen po'i go sar dbang bskur te shis brjod mdzad/ de dus 'jig rten skyong ba mang po 'dus nas dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mdzad pa gzigs pas/ rgyal khams bde ba'i ltas su mkhyen te/ chos rje nyid bzhugs ring rgyal khams bde ba'i khag khur mdzad/ mdo dbus kun tu 'bul ba skyel bar dpon po grags brtson brdzangs/ skabs shig pho brang chen por yon mchod chen po gnyis chos dang 'jig rten tshul gyi 'phros pa mang du byung ba la/ rgya gar du sangs rgyas byon tshul/ bka' bsdu rim par byung ba/ paṇa grub byung tshul/ bod du chos rgyal mes dpon rnams kyis bstan pa btsugs lugs/ dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa/ phyis bstan pa dar tshul/ da lta gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde/ chos la gus pa'i mi dpon 'di dang 'di lta bu'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i skabs su/ tshal pa si tu dge sbyong chen po'i sku che ba'i yon tan rnams kyang gsungs pas/ gong ma mnyes/ gu shrī'i ming dang*/ shel gyi tham ga phul/ shing khyi lo zla ba dang po'i tshe mnal lam du nags tshal dang bcas pa'i ri'i ngos su spyan ras gzigs la 'gro ba rnams kyis mchod pa byed pa gzigs/

de'i zhal nas 'dir ma 'dug par gangs can gyi khrod du song dang*/ rang gzhan kun la phan par 'gyur ro gsungs pa gsan/ thang lha dang brtan ma bcu gnyis sogs kyis kyang bskul/ rgyu des bod la 'byon pa'i zhu ba mdzad pas/ byon chog pa'i lung byung ba la/ rgyal po'i 'o na tshe chu 'don du byon nas/ lo gnyis na phyir pheb par zhus gsungs pa la zhal gyis bzhes/

bod tsā ri gsar rnying du gser bre'i gnang sbyin nyid kyi zhal slob mdo khams kyi bla ma ting 'dzin bzang po dang*/ mtshal pa si tu dge sbyong chen po la si tu'i dam ka sogs skyos ma'i gnang sbyin rgyu dang*/ mtshur phur 'ja' yan du rgyal po'i dus mchod dang yin thang 'dzugs rgyu sogs bskur/ mtshur lung pa sogs karma pa la gtogs pa'i lha sde mi sde kun dar rgan du phul/ bod spyir skyos ma la bod chol kha gsum la/ dkar thog me tog 'chag pa'i 'jā' sa gcig /ngo log rnams ngo blta ru 'jug pa'i 'ja' sa gcig /bod la phan pa'i khrims sdom pa'i 'ja'ā sa gcig rnams phul/ bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa'i rgyu dngos kyis gnang sbyin sogs gzhan yang 'bul rdzongs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byas/ gong du yon mchod rten 'brel 'grig cing sku khams bzang la 'gro don che/ bod spyi la dar rgan/ mtshal pa la gnang sbyin sogs dang bcas yar 'byon gyin yod ces pa'i gtam snyan skyel bar chos rje'i yig mkhan lha sa ba kun dga' dpal sngon la brdzangs/ khyi lo zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga la bteg /rgyal po chen po blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pas skyel thung mdzad/ skyel ma la mkhan po ti shi'i dbon po dang*/ rin chen dpal thung chen po btang*/ yar lam ri bo rtse lngar phebs/ 'jam dpal la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi phrin las kyi bkod pa gzigs/ mi nyag mgor pheb pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro'i cho 'phrul gyi nyams dpag med shar zhing gdul bya rnams la chos mang du gsungs/ sngon gyi lha khang dang gdan sa rnams gsos/ gdan sa pa bskos/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gcig la spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rjes gzhan rgyud byin gyis rlob pa'i rtags su bar snang 'ja' 'od du 'khyil ba dang*/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i gzigs snang yun ring du byung zhing kun du phebs pa'i tshe/ bon po rnams kyang lhag par gus/ de rnams kyis sa cha phul bas lha khang chen po bzhengs/

tsha 'phrang la sogs pa ngo ltas/ de nas mi nyag ring mor byon/ mi skya phal pa gcig gis gos ky-i mthu ba nas bton nas gser srang nyis brgya tsam phul zhabs tog dang 'gro don dpag tu med/ mdo khams su sngar gan ja ba dang*/ mi nyag ma 'cham pa'i don la dbus gtsang gi ja pa mdzo mgo sum stong tsam bskyil nas mi nor thams cad bsdams yod pa/ chos rje pas gsung byon pas tshong pa kun gyi srog nor thams cad thon/ yar phyag phyi la khrid/ rong po dang mi nyag gi kha mchu yang 'dun ma byed pa'i mi bskos/ gnang sbyin bzhag /de la sogs pa 'khrug pa thams cad bsdums nas byang chub kyi sems la bkod/ rgyal bu chos dpal gyis gtso mdzad/ mdo stod smad kyi mi dpon kun gyis 'bul ba dang bkur sti byas/ smar khams su chos skyong la gtor ma btang ba'i tshe/ phrin las 'grub pa'i ltas kyi khyad par gzigs/ de nas karmar phebs/ gdan sar phan par dgongs nas karma ri 'debs pa'i zhal bkod mdzad/ de nas dbus phyogs su pheb pa'i bar du 'gro phan mang po mdzad/ tshes gsum mchod pa zhig gi tshe thang lha dang gangs dkar la sogs gzhi bdag rnams na bun bzhin du snang zhing*/ da dung res gcig shar phyogs kyi gdul bya rnams la phan par 'gyur zhes zer ba gsan/ shing phag zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer lnga la 'dam du phebs/ zā+on wu'i gsi dang dbus pa kun 'dzom sar 'ja' sa bsgrags zhag gsum bzhugs/ gzan cha chung zhing sku skyos che bas thams cad mos/ zla ba dgu pa la mtshur phur phebs/ skabs der slar gong du gdan 'dren la/ gong ma tha'i hu'i gser yig pa ba'o dang*/ rdo rje brtan gnyis kyis zhu yig e ci dang*/ gser bre gcig gi 'bul ba dang mchod pa khyer byung*/ bla ma'i dbon chos dbang dang*/ chos rje pa rang gi mi dbon po grags brtson yang gong nas mtshur phur sleb/ chos rje pa rang gis bsnams byon pa'i tshal pa'i 'jā' sa dang*/ slar gong du gdan 'dren gyi e ci 'tshal pa'i gser yig pas khyer 'ong ba'i 'jā' sa rnams/

dpon chen dbang phyug dpal pas gtso byas mi dpon kun 'dzoms sar bsgrags chos rje pa'i thugs dam bstan 'gyur gser dngul las grub pa/ po ti brgya drug cu gung thang du si tu dge sbyong chen po la cha rkyen gnang nas bzhengs bcug/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu la lha sar phebs/ skabs der yang gdan 'dren gser yig pa/ nang ther gle'u she 'us/ 'ja' sa dang*/ gser bre gcig gis mgo byas mchod pa khyer nas sleb/ sngar gong na bzhugs dus bsnams byon pa'i phing gcig pa'i si tu'i thaṃ ka bang rim gsum pa dngul srang brgyad cu rtsa lnga las brdungs pa/ chos rje'i phyag nas chen po ba la gnang*/ de'i skabs su dben gyi mi dpon thung tsen dang*/ nag ther gle'u she'u la sogs pa mi dpon kun gyis pus mo btsugs nas li shang byas/ de'i nyin chos rje pa gdan 'dren gyi 'jā' sa bsgrags/ de nas gung thang du chos rje pa'i bzhugs khri'i rtsar chen po pa bzhugs stan sum brtsegs la bzhugs chog par byung ba la/ rgyal po'i mag pa rin chen dpal thung tson la sogs kyis pus mo btsugs shing*/ dpon chen dang du dben sha kun kyang de dang 'dra ba'i bkur sti byas/ chos rje pa la rgyal pos bskur ba'i mchod pa drangs/ sku skyos la gung thang du mang ja dang 'bul chen mdzad/ dge 'dun spyi la gser bre gcig phul/ 'gro mgon rin po che'i sku 'dra'i drung du dngul gyi kong bu btsug /tshal pas kyang zhabs tog gzabs shing*/ dbus pa spyi 'degs byas/ de nas bsam yas mchims phur phebs/ sa phyogs 'ga' zhig tu tshe chu brus pa la snyigs dus skye bo'i chags sdang dang bar chad byung dogs nas ma thon pa'i tshul du mdzad cing*/ tshe chu dngos rdza mo hūm̐ 'dra'i gsham nas yin yang zer/ gang ltar bsam yas phu nas thon pa sus kyang ma tshor bar phyag tu bzhes/ dgun dpyid zla ba drug gi ring mchims phu nyid du dben pa bstan par mdzad/

thugs dam 'phel zhing slob dpon pad+ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi dag snang mang du byung ba mkhas btsun du ma la phan pa'i brdar gzigs/ bar du gcod pa'i cho 'phrul ting nge 'dzin gyis zhi bar mdzad/ bstan 'gyur bzhengs grub la sogs glegs bam rnams la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ rten la sangs rgyas byang sems dpag med thim zhing chos sgra sgrogs pa gzigs/ me pho byi ba'i lo sar mchims phur mdzad/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po gong du 'byon khar chos rje pa mjal/ bar chad med pa'i smon lam dang chos 'brel zhus/ rin po che pa mchims phu nas phyir lam bye la skor nas skyi smad la byon/ yang skabs der/ gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa mtshal pa'i sde dpon slob dpon don rin/ mi chen nam mkha' dpal thung ji'i nu bo gcig dang bcas pas gong ma tha'i hu'i zhu yig e ci/ gser yig sgor mo dang*/ gser bren ma bza' dang bcas pa khyer nas yongs pa zla ba drug pa la/ stod lung mdar chos rje dang mjal/ zhu yig 'bul bcas rnams phul/ mtshal pa si tu chen po la gos dar dgu tshan gnyis kyi gnang sbyin bskur nas/ chos rje pa gdan 'dren pa'i grogs dan gyis gsung pa'i lung phebs/ yang rgyal bus gdan 'dren la tshang ju chul zhu yig 'bul ba dang bcas te sleb/ yang mgon po g.yi'u ching la/ 'jā' sa 'bul chas bskur nas sleb/ 'ja' sa'i tshig ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs la brten nas/ tha'i hong tha'i hu nged kyi e ji/ chos rje rin po che karma pa'i drung du/ na ning bla ma yar 'byon dus thugs dgongs bzang po'i sgo nas/ rang re la phan pa'i bya ba bzang po bsgrubs nas/ myur du phyir 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ bla ma byon nas lo gnyis song ba la/ bla mas gsungs pa'i chos dran cing*/ bla ma la mos gus dang dad pa yod pa'i don la/ sngar yang gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa btang na'ang*/ da bar du 'dir nam chags phebs kyi tshig kha gsal ma thos pa'i don la/

yang bla ma gdan 'dren pa la/ dge bshes don rin gyis mgo byas gser yig pa rnams btang bdog pas/ rang re la bsams nas/ bstan pa'i zhabs thog la dgongs nas myur du 'byon pa bla ma mkhyen/ gal te myur du ma byon par gsung thog tu ma phebs na/ dad pa dang ldan pa'i bu slob rnams kyi yi chad pa dang*/ gzhan yang chos las log pa rnams kyis thos nas/ khong lta bu gsung thog tu ma phebs na/ gzhan rnams gang na bden zer cing*/ bstan pa la gnod pas gser yig 'di rnams sleb pa dang*/ nged la bsams nas bstan pa'i zhabs thog dang*/ sems can gyi don la dgongs nas myur du 'byon pa bla ma mkhyen/ yi ge gzigs pa'i rten du na bza' tshang ma gcig / gser bre chen gcig dang*/ mchod pa'i chas bskur bdog /byi ba lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu'i nyin par ta'i tu nas bris zhes pa 'dug /'jā' sa/ i ji gun jis snga rting du byung ba rnams bstod bkur bsngags gsum khyad par 'phags par 'dug kyang kun brir ma langs/ de nas gong du thegs pa'i grab yul mdzad pa la mtshur phur byon/ bod na yod pa'i hor bod kyi mi dpon kun gyis zhabs tog dang bkur sti/ bla ma kun las lhag par byas/ yu gur rgyal po'i brgyud geb chag ste/ phing chang gis mtshur phu nas gdan drangs/ byi ba lo zla ba brgyad pa la byon nas 'dam du phebs/ phing chang dang mgon po g.yi'u ching la sogs pa'i gser yig pa/ slob dpon don rin/ si tu kun dga' rdo rje/ si tu dbang brtson sogs lhan cig tu dbang bskur zhus/ phing chang dang*/ si tu dpon chen gdug rtsub nan ltar che na'ang*/ chos rje pa'i zhal mthong ba tsam gyis gdug pa zhi zhing ci gsung sgrub par gyur/ ti shi chen po'i lugs bzhin skyel bsu dang rdzong ba gyis gsung pa'i 'jā' sa phebs kyang*/ gser yig pa'i cha rkyen ma gtogs gzan cha ci yang med pas mdo dbus kyi mi dpon 'jā' mo ba dang bcas pa kun lhag par dad de/

'bul ba chen po thams cad kyis byas/ tshes bco lnga la 'das nas gong du theg /sgor mo dang 'u lag phyi 'gro la slob dpon shes rab ral gri bzhud/ sha phor phebs tshe/ gong ma tha'i hu'i zhu yig i ci dang*/ gser bren bza' gsol chas dang bcas pa khyer nas/ jo dan seng ge rgyal mtshan dang*/ bkra shis dpal ba rnams sleb nas phyag tu phul/ gong ma'i 'bul ba dang*/ 'ja' sa/ 'u lag / chos rje pa rang gis tshad kyis la gang dgos zhon pa myur por byon/ 'dir nyi ma snga phyi la'ang bla ma pheb pa la khyad che ba yin/ zer ba'i lan khyer nas/ dben pa'i zwon shri kha rong du sleb/ shing kun du phyags pheb pa nas bzung khrims ra thams cad nas bsu ba dang*/ ja 'dren dpag med rim par byung*/ khyad par mkhar dkar po nas glang po che'i ma ha sra bsu/ ju ju mgon khang du/ mi'i dbang po'i blon po tha'i shri bsu ba la sleb/ de nub dbang bskur zhus/ de nas pho brang gi khrims ra thams cad kyi mi dpon/ ta'i dben gu shri/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po sogs bla dpon/ mi dpon thams cad bsu ba la sleb/ mdun bsu'i bkod pa dpag tu med pas bsu zhing*/ mthong dang bkur cha sngar bas kyang che/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gcig la pho brang chen por phebs/ de'i nyin rang pho brang nang ma'i sgo mdun du rgyal po chen po bsu ba la byon/ gus pa chen pos phyag dang zhal mjal gyi 'bul ba byas/ gong ma'i pho brang du zhag bcu gcig /tha'i tsi'i pho brang du zhag bcu gcig / tha shri'i par zhag bcu bzhi rnams bzhugs nas so sor dbang bskur mdzad/ de rjes pho brang gi gser khang nang du rgyal po chen po dang*/ blon po tha'i shri/ chos rje ba ste yon mchod gsum ma gtogs gzhan su yang med pa'i sar yon mchod chen pos bstan pa'i skyong bran dang*/ rgyal khams bde thabs kyi bka' gros mdzad/ de'i nyin rgyal po chen po la tshe chu drangs pas hor gyi rgyal sa mnan pa la sku tshe ring shos su byung*/
