gser bre bzhi sogs 'bul ba chen po mdzad/ gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa mgon po g.yi'u ching la go chod pa'i mtshan mar/ kyin cang hu'i zhing gi gtso bo phing chang la bskos/ gser yig pa kun la las ka spar ba sogs gnang sbyin chen po byas/ dbyar de than pa chen po byung ba la/ gong mas char 'bebs dgos pa'i zhu ba mdzad pas/ de'i nyin rang nas char chen po bab ste yid ches pas 'bul ba chen po byas/ rgyal po chen po/ rgyal bu/ dpon mo/ mi dpon thams cad kyis phyogs su ma chad par gus pas bkur/ gan pas cha'o bre stong tsho gnyis/ gan chung bas nas bre stong tsho gcig gnang nas/ ta'i tur zhi ra mun gyi khang skor la karma pa'i sde gsar bzhengs mdzad/ de'i dkyil khang du rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs/ g.yas g.yon du bka' brgyud bla ma'i sku dang*/ bde mchog lha lnga'i blos bslang chos skyong dang bcas pa bzhengs/ shing kun du'ang kar sde btsug /mtshur phu'i mgo byas dbus gtsang gi 'brel yod rnams la bka' shog rten dang 'bul ba skyel bar bsod yes mgo byas brdzangs*/ de rjes 'bri ru ba'i si tu grub pa bzang po/ mkhyen yon dge bshes tshul bzung rnams dbus gtsang gi dgon sde thams cad du yi ge rten dang 'bul ba ltos chen bskur nas brdzangs/ chos rje pa'i sku drin las/ 'bri phag gi rin po che la shel gyi sbel kha/ mtshur phu gdan sa ba la karma pak+shi'i gser gyi dam ga gnang*/ shang tor bar chad kyi ltas chen po zhig byung ba spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab pas mi dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig gis/ gong ma dang chos mdzad rnams la gnod pa mi 'byung gsung ba gsan/ glang lo zla ba brgyad pa la gim mi shan zhes par sa g.yos chen po yong ba mkhyen nas/ chos rje pa khang pa nas phyir byon nas thang la gzim gur mdzad de/ gong ma'ang gsung la brten nas gur mdzad/ de'i tshe tshes bcu bzhi la sa g.yos nas gong rnams zhig pas rgya thams cad bros nas/

chos rje pa la skyabs zhur 'ongs pa tsho dang*/ dpon slob mchod yon rnams la gnod pa gang yang med/ rgyal blon rnams la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ rin po che du mas brgyan pa'i khang bzang gi dbus su rigs lnga'i sku dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma du mas gar bsgyur ba yun ring gzigs/ de nyid mi dbang 'khor dang bcas pa la phan pa'i rgyu mtshan du dgongs/ skabs der/ rgya dang mdo smad pa'i ban de ngan pa 'ga'i spyod pa la bsten nas/ chos la mi dga' ba'i mi dpon rnams kyis gros byas nas/ bod ma gtogs pa phyogs kun tu lha khang du ma bshig /ban de mi gtsang ba rnams mi skyar 'jug cing khral dmag 'gel bar lung bsgrags pa la/ ti shri gu shri gzhan thams cad kyis zhus pas grub par/ pho brang gi khrims ra chen po 'u mon gdong du bla ma mi dpon kun 'tshogs pa'i sar/ chos rje bas rting la byon nas/ smad phyogs der khri'u btsug nas bzhugs pas blon po chen po ba yan tha'i shris mgo byas blon po thams cad/ dang po ti shri bzhugs sar kha ltas yod pa la/ slar phyir 'gyur nas chos rje pa bzhugs sar 'tshogs pa la/ chos rje pa'i zhal nas/ khyed rgyal blon rnams ti shris gtso mdzad/ nged chos pa rnams dbang med du bos nas/ 'dir bstan pa'i bya ba mi sgrub pa'i khar/ bstan pa bsnubs lugs 'di 'dra byed pa ci yin/ nged tsho tshe 'di'i lto gos ma phyid par khyed tsho la zhur yong snyam mam/ sngon gyi se chen rgyal po la sogs gong ma tshos bya ba nor nas/ da khyed tshos 'chos pa yin nam/ rgyal po'i sku tshe dang*/ rgyal khams kyi khag /khyed blon po re re tsam gyis theg pa yin na khur/ nged thams cad bod du 'gro ba yin gsungs pa la sogs bka' bkyon mang po byon pas kun skrag nas/ de ma thag lha khang rnams gan pas gso zhing*/ ban de gtsang mi gtsang sogs gnam mchod pa thams cad dar rgan 'don pa'i 'jā' sa phyogs thams cad du bsgrags pas re zhig de ltar 'jags/

bod chol ga gsum la dkar thog me tog lo gsum phyed 'jag gi 'jā' sa dang*/ de'i rgyab skyor chos rje ba'i bka' shog dang bcas pa bsgrags/ gong ma'i gsung gis gzhan bla mchod thams cad la sbyin bdag dang sa cha'i zhal ta zhu rgyu 'dug /nyid la de lta bu med pa lags sam zhus pas/ kho bo la yang shar phyogs kong po'i rgyal khams bya ba mi khyim 'bum phrag gcig tsam yod gsungs/ 'o na de'i mi dpon la nged kyis gnang sbyin dang las ka chen po byed zhus pas/ de nged rang gis thugs rje chen po la gsol ba btab nas chos kyis 'dul ba yin/ yul khams de'i mi dpon gyis 'dul mi nus gsungs/ slar yang hā ching sang zer ba nag phyogs kyi blon pos ngan byas nas gnam mchod pa rnams la gtser bya byung bas rkyen byas/ chos rje pa'ang cung zad thugs chad pa'i rnam par gyur/ spyir nyid kyi gsung dang*/ rgya'i rtsis mkhan mkhas pa'i rtsis yig la/ sku tshe ring ba'i ltas yod cing*/ tshe la dbang ba'i gang zag yin pa la/ 'on kyang thugs 'byung des dga' ldan du gshegs par bzhed de/ stag lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la rgyal blon kun 'dzom sar/ rnal 'byor nga ni nam mkha'i sprin dang 'dra gar 'gro mi shes pas/ rgyal pos gtso mdzad khyed rang rang gi chos kyi don sgrub par 'dod pa rnams myur du sgrubs shig gsung ba byung yang*/ sngar bod du 'byon gsung pa'i 'phro yin snyam pa ma gtogs/ sku 'da' ba'i gsung du ma go /sa mo yos lo zla ba lnga par than pa chen po byung ba la kun gyis gsol ba btab pas char chen po 'bebs par mdzad/ de tshe tshes lnga'i tho rangs la mnal lam gyi tshul du zhing khams brag dkar po 'dra ba tshad med pa'i rtser/ rigs gsum mgon po yin dgongs pa'i mi dkar chen po gsum gyis snyan pa'i gsung gis bos pa'i mod la/ rje nyid kyi sku mkha' lding dbang po ltar gyen du bskyod nas zhing khams dpag tu med par bgrod pa'i ltas gzigs shing de'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/

de'i skabs mnal ma sad par 'od gsal gyi ngang nas/ lta ba mkha' ltar dag pa la// rnam rtog mtshan ma med pa yin// sgom pa gsal stong 'dzin med pa// mkha' la bya ltar rgyu ba yin// spyod pa spang blang bral ba la// blang dang dor ba med pa yin// e ma skal ldan skyes bu rnams// nyams su blangs na de ltar 'byung*// zhes rdo rje'i mgur bzhengs pa/ gsol ja ba shākra seng sogs kyis gsal bor thos/ de ma thag nam mkha' las chos kyi rje rin po che khams gsum gyi mgon po mya ngan las 'das zer ba'i sgra chen po dang*/ sa g.yos chen po byung*/ zla ba lnga pa'i bcu bzhi la ta'i tu'i pho brang nas phyags bteg /chu tshan khar sku khrus mdzad/ khu ba rnams 'khor slob skyel bsu ba dang bcas pas btung ba'i tshe/ nyams rtogs bzang po dang*/ byin rlabs chen po rang dbang med par byung*/ de'i nyin nas/ pho brang shar dor ma phebs kyi bar gyi lam la/ 'ja' tshon sna tshogs dang*/ 'od dang*/ me tog gi char rgyun ma chad pa byung*/ 'khor rnams kyis ltas 'di dag ci yin zhus pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gcig gshegs 'dod par yong gsungs/ bsil sa dbyar bzhugs gnang ba'i pho brang chen po shang tor phebs nyin/ god mtha'i hu blon por bcas pa thams cad ky-is mdun bsu'i bkod pa tshad med pas/ pho brang nang du spyan drangs/ gong ma/ dpon mo/ rgyal brgyud blon po'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad/ de nas tshes bcu nas sku khams cung zad bri/ skabs zhig chos rje'i mdun du/ rgyal blon bu slob dang bcas pas bskor nas yod sar/ blon po chen po ba yan tha'i shris phyag 'tshal zhing ngus nas/ chos rje sku mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs par zhu/ zhes zhus pas/ sems dpa' chen po'i zhal nas nga bod du 'gro nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan pa byed snyam pa yin te/ khyed rgyal blon gyi bsod nams la ma grub/ nga'i bka' las kyang cung zad 'das/

da snga 'phar song zin/ da 'di tsam du song nas bcos su med pas zhing gzhan du 'gro/ khyed rgyal blon rnams sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ rgyal khrims chos bzhin skyong gsungs/ ta'i dben gu shri dkon mchog rin chen gyis/ chos rje gshegs na bdag cag rnams kyis bstan pa ji ltar bskyang zhus pas/ stag lo zla ba gsum pa la smras pa bzhin mdzod gsungs/ yang ta'i dben gu shris/ chos rje rin po che sku skye ba phyi ma gang du 'byon/ bdag kyang zhabs drung du skye ba'i smon lam 'debs pa yin zhus pas/ nged shar phyogs kong po'i rgyal khams khad nye sa shig tu yong*/ khyed rang der 'dun pa gtod gsungs/ slob ma chos gsol ba btab zhal ta gnang ba zhus byas pas/ chos la brtson par gyis/ bod kyi gdul bya kun la'ang*/ sngar phag lo nas byi ba lo'i bar kha ta byas char/ dpon slob myur du+u 'phrad par bya'o gyis/ zhes gsungs/ drung 'khor tshos yi ger btab/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyi ma phyed yol bde mchog gi blos bslang gi drung du phebs nas phyag bskor mdzad/ de nas gdan la bzhugs te nam mkhar gzigs nas phyag thal mo sbyor bar mdzad/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa 'tshogs 'dug pas/ mchod pa rgya chen po bshams la phul/ zhes slob dpon 'dul 'dzin la gsung byon/ rje nyid kyis bde mchog gi bdag 'jug mdzad nas bdud rtsi phyag mchod gnang*/ bdud rtsi de kun la drongs zhes gsung nas thams cad la dgyes par mdzad/ bde mchog gi rtsa sngags gsung bzhin pas ḍā ma ru dkrol te/ go shri'i dbu mdzad drung du 'dug pa rnams la/ rnal 'byor nga zhing khams gzhan du 'gro bas khyed rnams chos la brtson par mdzod/ ces gsungs nas de nyid du mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan/ sang bco lnga'i nub mo zla ba shar ba'i tshe/ gong ma'i pho phrang nang ma'i sgo srung ba'i res pa brje ba las res dpon du ran the mur gyis zla ba'i steng du/

chos rje rin po che mchod rten nang na sku dngos su bzhugs par mthong ste/ grogs la sbran pas res pa bco brgyad kyis mthong*/ gnyis kyis ma mthong*/ res dpon gyis gong ma la zhu ba thengs bas/ gong ma dpon blon phal cher gyis gzigs/ gong mas de'i yin thang gnyis bzhengs te sku 'dra zla zhal ma zhes sku dngos dang byin rlabs mtshungs par byed/ de dang mtshungs par sngon nyid kyis srog bskyabs pa'i sog po dpon g.yog gsum gyis chu dong 'ja' mor byon pa mthong ste bod du 'gro gsung pa dang*/ zi ra'u rdor sku 'khor mang po can mdo li la chibs nas gong ma tha'i hu'i sar bzhud pa hong hu dpon g.yog gis mthong*/ slob ma zhig na ba'i sar bya tang gi tshul gyis byon pa 'dul ba 'dzin pas kyang gzigs/ rtse lnga'i kar sder slob dpon seng ge la sogs pa bsam gtan pa nyi shus snang ba mthun par mjal te dga' ldan du 'gro gsungs/ bod du rtogs ldan grags seng bas chos rje zla ba'i steng na na bza' ser po bzhes nas phar bzhud tshur bzhud mdzad pa dag snang du gzigs shing zhal ta zhus pas/ dga' ldan du 'gro gsungs pa dang*/ seng ge bcibs nas mkha' la bzhud par gzigs pa sogs dag snang gi ngo mtshar du ma bstan/ gdung zhag bcu bzhir rgyal po'i 'byor ba chen pos mchod de go shri dang mi chen thams cad kyis rkang thang du mdo li la spyan drangs te nyer lnga la tsan+dan dang a ga ru nag pos sangs rgyas dang 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi gdung ltar sbyangs/ 'ja' tshon sna tshogs pas nam mkha' khyab pa'i gseb nas drung gi sku mang du snang ba phal cher gyis mthong*/ nam mkha' la ā li kā li sgra grag nyer drug gi nyin gdung zhal phyabs nub byang nas ut+pal spungs pa 'dra ba'i sprin 'ja' tshon gyis bskor ba'i dbus su chos rje rin po che bzhugs pa mang pos mthong zhing slar nub phyogs su bzhud par mthong*/

tshangs bug tu bde mchog lhan skyes/ smin mtshams su chos 'byung bsnol ma yi ge lnga dang bcas pa/ srin mdzub kyi rkang gi nang du thugs rje chen po/ gzhan yang lha sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan du ma yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel kha dog lnga ldan dpag tu med pa sogs ngo mtshar gyi rten mtha' yas pa bzhag ste/ rgya hor bod mi nyag gi yul thams cad du mchod pa'i zhing gcig pu par gyur to// rje 'di'i 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i rnam par thar pa'i tshul sa bon tsam du 'di ltar gsungs pa yod de/ rnam thar zhal gsung ma las/ re zhig bar skabs tshigs su bcad pa ni/ chung ngu'i dus na 'das pa'i rmi lam ltar/ /cung zad gsal bar ngag tu brjod gyur pa/ / gzhan gyis gtam du brjod pa lta bur gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi/ / slob ma pradzña a laṅka zhes pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la zhugs shing rab byung nas/ /ngo bo gnyis med smra la dad par gyur/ /grub thob chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje yi/ /rjes su 'jug pa ka ma la dhe nu/ /de yi gzhung lugs mthong bar gyur pa na/ /de ni kho bos sngon tshe byas snyam byed/ / 'dzam gling lho nub phyogs char byung ba yi/ /dhar ma bo dhi zhes bya'i thugs rje yis/ /mnga' bdag spyanaras gzigs kyis byin brlabs pa/ /de 'drar gyur to snyam du yang yang dran/ /zhi ba 'tsho dang slob dpon pad+ma yi/ /slob ma btsun pa rgyal ba mchog dbyangs ni/ /pad+ma dbang chen mngon du grub gyur pa/ /de ni rmi lam bzhin du dran par gyur/ /de yi 'og tu nub phyogs grong khyer spyod/ /yang ni dbus kyi sa char byung gyur ba'i/ /sne zur ba dang kha rag sgom chung gi /chos 'brel ldan snyam da ltar don kun shes/ /rin chen gsal zhes bya bar gyur ba snyam/ /chung ngu'i dus su de skad smras pa yin/ /rgyal ba'i sras po ma pham sras gyur pa/ /seng ge'i rnam 'phrul dharma kīr+t+ti ste/

/dus gsum mkhyen zhes 'jig rten snyan pas khyab/ /de yis byin rlabs rnam 'phrul sprul pa bzhin/ /de nas byang phyogs so ma mtha' ru spyod/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ /bdag nyid chen po dpal ldan karma pa/ /de yi byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs pa las/ /deng sang karma pa yi mtshan sgrogs shing*/ /zhwa nag cod pan 'dzin pa gsum par gyur/ /zhes dang*/ rang byung ming can yid kyi kun rtog la/ /'di nas ma 'ongs phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /byang chub sems dpa' seng ge'i rnam thar bzhin/ /ma pham chos kyi bla ma bzhugs pa'i tshe/ /sna tshogs bkod pa ldan pa'i gnas gzhan du/ /'dun pas 'phangs te skye bar byed pa snyam/ / dpal ldan karma pa yi lung bstan du/ /ma 'ongs 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dung*/ /bdag nyid chen po byams pa'i chos 'dzin pa/ /brgyud pa 'di la 'byung zhes gang gsungs pa/ /de dang phyogs mthun bdag kyang sbyong 'gyur zhing*/ /rgyal sras rnams kyi mdzad dang mthun par spyod/ /de nas re zhig 'od dpag med pa yi/ /rgyal ba de yi thugs rjes bskul ba dang*/ / spyan ras gzigs dbang mthu chen thob la sogs/ /rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i rnam thar lta byed cing*/ /de dag mdzad pa mthun par 'jug pa snyam/ /bskal pa bzang por rgyal ba rab 'byung ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge nas bzung ste/ /tha ma snang bar mdzad pa'i bar dag tu/ /chos bzhin zhing khams sbyaung bar smon lam btab/ /thams cad yid kyi gzugs brnyan yin pa'i phyir/ /de dag rnams kyang 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /rgyal ba'i sras po mthu chen ma smad pa/ /'jam dpal gyi ni zhing gi smon lam bzhin/ /rjes su mthun pa yongs su sgrub byed cing*/ /kun tu gzigs pa'i rgyal ba'ang mthong bar 'dod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho sbyong zhing lta ba dang*/ /rnam thar rgya mtsho'i mdzad pa ji bzhin du/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs par*/

/ sgrub par byed pa'i smon lam rab ldan zhing*/ /dus ring bya dka' sems la med pa dang*/ / the tshom yid gnyis blo dang rab bral te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dang mthun par 'jug / 'di ltar ma 'ongs tshul lugs brjod pa 'di/ /sems kyi kun rtog myu gu'i rgyu las ni/ / rnam dag 'bras bu 'grub phyir bris pa yin/ /skal pa dman cing brtson 'grus zhan pa dang*/ /blo chung rnams kyis thos na the tshom skye/ /blo ldan rgyal ba'i snying po la mos pa/ /theg chen chos tshul rtogs par 'gyur ba rnams/ /du ba'i rtags las me bzhin nges shes skye/ / 'di ni rang byung ma 'ongs spyod pa yin/ /zhes so// de ltar chos rje rin po che rang byung rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ rje nyid sku na phra mo'i dus kyi gsung*/ mkhas btsun gser khang pas zin bris su btab pa'i rnam thar bar dor mar grags pa dang*/ dgung lo bzhi bcu yan gyi rnam thar rje nyid kyis bde chen du mdzad pa dang*/ de nas mya ngan 'da' ka tshun gyi rnam thar pho brang chen po ta'i tur mdzad pa dang*/ mdzad pa tha ma'i rnam thar mkhan chen kun dga' 'od zer gyis mdzad pa dang*/ rgya yul du phebs ka yan gyi rnam thar mkhas pa shes rab rin chen gyis lha steng du mdzad pa dang*/ yang mdzad po ma nges pa'i rnam thar zhib mo zhig dang*/ mkha' spyod dbang po dang*/ gtsug lag phreng bas mdzad pa rnams la gzhi byas/ tshal pa'i deb ther sogs yig cha khungs btsun gzhan nas kyang kha bskong ste/ cung zad rgyas pa'i khul du sbyar ba'o// ༈ zhal slob ni nyid kyi bla ma kun gyis kyang tshur chos gsan te gus pa tshad med par mdzad/ gsang phu ne'u thog gung thang chos 'khor gling bde sbyor zul gsum la sogs pa'i gdan sa ba snga phyi dang*/ slob dpon mtha' dag /oḍ+yan pa'i sprul sku/ bram ze mgon po/ rmi lam 'od gsal gyi rtsal mnyam pa rtogs ldan grags seng*/ rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs pa rtogs ldan bsam rin/

nus pa mthar phyin pa g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ sbas pa'-i brtul zhugs mthar phyin pa rgyal ba ri khrod pa/ brgyud pa'i gdams pa la mnga' brnyes pa rtogs ldan mgon rgyal/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo kha bye ba rtogs ldan kun gzhon/ phug po che ba/ lha rje rnam gnyis/ chu sgom pa/ kho ye dge slong*/ khu yor rtogs ldan/ rtogs ldan khrag skyug rtogs ldan tre ho ba/ rtogs ldan kre bo/ hor rtogs ldan/ rdza ras gnyis/ ye rgyal ba/ lha phu ba kun ye/ bla ma dar zhwa/ rtogs ldan dbang phyug bzang po/ rtogs ldan mgon ye/ nye gnas ci rong pa dge 'dun dpal/ nye gnas ye shes rgyal mtshan/ stag zhig ras pa/ nags mgo rin 'byung ba/ dgas po shig nad pa/ rtogs ldan lha ras pa/ gtsang pa tshul mgon/ shākya rdo rje/ a brag chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ tshong dpon yon rgyal ba/ mkhar thog pa gzhon nu 'bum/ shes rab rin chen/ rdzogs chen pa tshul blo/ bla ma he ru ka pa/ ldong ston gzhon nu 'bum/ spyan snga rdor rin pa/ zha lu ba che ba dharma pa/ bla ma dar 'byung*/ mkhan dza par pa/ mkhan chen gro mo pa/ bla ma shes rab don grub/ rgyal sras kun dga' byams pa/ slob dpon 'jam nyag /klog skya bka' bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mngon pa ba/ sman lung pa/ mtshur phu'i gdan sa pa go shrī dharma rā dza/ rta rna'i gdan sa pa bsod rin/ go'i shrī kun dga' rgyal po/ ta'i dben go'i shrī/ mtshal si tu dge sbyong chen po/ gling drung pa ting 'dzin bzang po/ rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus/ ne ring rin po che shākya mgon po/ g.yag sde pan chen/ dge 'dun sgang ba'i mkhan po mkhas btsun pa sogs mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa dang*/ chos kyi rnga chen sgrogs pa dang*/ lugs gnyis ka'i sgo nas chen po'i go sar bzhugs pa dang*/ rgya dbus khams kong gi gdan sa skyong ba mang po dang*/ kun mkhyen dol po ba chen po/ snye thang dus 'khor ba grags seng*/

stag lung kun spang rin po che/ rin po che g.ya' bzang ba/ bla ma rngog seng ge sgra sogs ni dad thob chos kyis 'brel ba'i skyes chen te/ gzhan yang dgas kong gtsang dbus mdo khams sogs yul gru mtha' yas pa'i ri khrod dben sa dag na 'dir rje rang byung bas lo gsum dang bcu gnyis sogs bzhugs zer ba yul gru re re na mtha' yas par snang bas thun mong gi sku tshe'i mthong ba dang shin tu ma mtshungs pas/ sku'i bkod pa kho na mtha' yas pa zhig bstan par snang la/ sgrub brgyud kyi slob ma la bltas na khrid kho na bskyangs pa 'dra ba/ mkhas pa thon pa la bltas na bshad pa kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba/ sgrub gnas tsho la bltas na sgrub pa kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba/ bstan bcos tsho la bltas na thugs rtsom kho na mdzad pa 'dra ba blos gzhal bar mi nus pa zhig kho na snang bas/ spyir slob ma'i grangs ni su zhig gis dpog par nus la/ khyad par lkog gyur du smin par mdzad pa'i slob ma'i tshogs kyang dpag tu med par yod par mngon no//

༈ de la slob ma rnams kyi thu bo ches mchog tu gyur pa zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa'i rabs kyi phreng ba rnams las thog mar gyur pa rje grags pa seng ge ni/ mdo khams sgang smad dge bsnyen rdo rje dpal brtsegs gnas pa'i shar phyogs dge 'dun gyi sde chen po kol ti'i gtsug lag khang dang nye ba'i spom 'bor sgang chen phyā yi yul shol lung shol chu'i 'gram grong pa zhes bya bar g.yag ru ras pa nyid/ slar yang bsams bzhin srid pa nye bar bzhes pa'i tshul du sku 'khrungs te/ gdung rus ni sbas dbrang 'gu/ dbrang 'gu stag chung yab yum la sras ming sring bzhi yod pa'i nang nas rin po che pa nyid che 'og ma yin par 'dug /yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i dus su/ yum la rmi ltas bzang po dang*/ sku bltams pa'i tshe na'ang*/ lte ba bcad pa dang*/ khar mar bcug pa tshun chad dran pa la sogs gzhan yang ltas khyad par can byung ba yin par 'dug /dgung lo gnyis gsum nas mnal 'od gsal du 'gro ba byung ste ngo ma shes/ de'i dus su rgyal sras spom brag pa'i bu chen bla ma seng ras dang mjal nas byin rlabs zhus pas/ khong gi gsung nas byis pa rang khyad par du 'phags pa zhig 'dug gsungs/ de dus skabs skabs su g.yag ru ras pa/ ban rgan se bo de yin snyam pa byung*/ dgung lo bzhi lon tsa na nyi ma snga dro'i cha la mdun gyi nam mkha' la bde gshegs stag lung thang pa dang*/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma gnyis byon nas phyag tu bum pa thogs nas dbang bskur ba'i snang ba byung*/ gzhan rnams kyis gnyid yur ba mthong 'dug gsungs/ dgung lo lnga drug gi dus su rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar ljang gnyis kyis gtso byas pa'i yi dam gyi lha mang du zhal mthong nas/ byis pa zla bo rnams la bstan pas khong rnams kyis ma mthong bar dbrang 'gu lha mthong 'dre mthong du btags/ yab yum na re bus 'dre mthong 'dug pas rim gro zhig byed pa dang*/

bla ma blo gros grags pa la zhu dgos zer nas khong la zhus pas/ khong gi gsung nas 'dre mthong bar mi 'dug 'di la btsun pa byas na chos pa bzang po zhig yong bar 'dug pas nga la phul gsungs pa la/ byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas khong gi drung du bzhag /khong la rta mgrin jo bo'i lugs lha lnga zhus nas bsnyen pa byas/ dbu'i steng na rta skad 'tsher ba lan mang du thos/ skabs skabs su rta mgrin dngos yin snyam pa byung gsungs/ de dus spyi khang dgon par lo bcu gsum la/ slob dpon blo gros grags dang*/ slob dpon rgya rje ston pa gnyis la mkhan slob zhus nas rab byung byas/ mtshan grags pa seng ge zhes bya bar grags/ nyin cig gi dus su slob dpon blo gros grags pa'i gsung nas/ nga shing thog 'di la dga' bas grags pa seng ge song la shing thog cig thus la shog gsungs der ri la phyin nas bde gshegs stag lung thang pa dang*/ khong gi slob ma sbas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs gin phyin pa'i dus su/ char zim zim zhig byung nas brag phug cig tu bsdad tsa na/ bde gshegs rin po che dang*/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar ljang gnyis zhal mthong ting nge 'dzin bzang po'ang byung*/ gzhan yang de'i dus su slob dpon pas mi'i sri'u gso ba rnams sos mi sos mkhyen pa byung*/ lan cig khong la rgyags len du song gsungs pa la/ la de'i rgyab na mas rtsam pa dang chu rdor khyer nas phrad du 'ong ba sgrib pa med par shes par byung nas/ slob dpon pa la zhus pas khong mnyes shing gzhan rnams ya mtshan du gyur/ lar de dus rje btsun sgrol ma dang*/ yi dam gyi lha mang du zhal gzigs te slob dpon pa la zhus pas/ nga la sbas rin po che'i gsung nas/ pha yul dang gzhan du ma 'gro bar khyod lo gsum bsgrub pa'i dam bca' gyis gsung ba la/ gsung bcag nas pha yul du 'gro dgos pa zhig byung bas de mkhyen nas ma 'gro byas pa yin te/

da khyod la slob ma mang po mi yong*/ bzang po zhig yong pa des kyang khyod kyi brgyud pa mi 'dzin par 'dug gsungs/ slob ma bzang po zhig yong gsungs de khyod yin par 'dug gsungs/ de'i dus su yul pa rnams na re/ dbrang 'gu lha mthong 'dre mthong 'di ye shes pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin na/ bsod nams 'di las che ba yong thang*/ 'jig rten pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin zer nas the tshom byed pa byung bas/ slob dpon pa'i gsung nas/ khyod ye shes pas byin gyis brlabs pa yin cing*/ chos pa bzang po sems can la phan thogs pa zhig yong pa ngas kyang shes te/ drung rin po che ye shes seng ge grub thob rtsod med yin pas/ khong gi drung du song la yi dam lha zhal gzigs lugs 'di rnams zhus gsungs/ lar bla ma blo gros grags pa'i drung du lo brgyad bzhugs nas/ lo bcu bdun la pha dang g.yog gcig la khres po bskur nas/ yon por phyin pa'i lam khar khong gnyis na re/ drung rin po che de dbu zhwa dang na bza' ci 'dra gsol/ mjal kha e 'ong rang re rnams la za ma ji 'drar ster bar 'dug 'drir byung ba la/ drung rin po che dbu zhwa nag po gsol/ na bza' ber thul gcig gi steng na ras phyam gcig gsol 'dug mjal kha yong bar 'dug za ma ja thud zan zhig ster ba 'dug byas nas phyin pas/ ngas ji skad byas pa bzhin du byung bas khong gnyis nga la bltas nas dgod kyin 'dug /de nas bla ma rin po che la yi dam lha zhal gzigs lugs dang rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas/ drung gi gsung nas rje btsun ma zhi bar 'dug gam khro mor 'dug zhi khro gang yin mi shes lags zhus pas/ spyan gsum 'dug gam gnyis 'dug gsungs pa la gnyis 'dug zhus pas/ 'o na zhi bar 'dug /do nub khyed rang rnams nag tshang du sdod nged kyis rmi lam brtag nas nangs par gsal gsung ba la/ tsha ba'i dus su mjal khyod yi dam lhas byin gyis brlabs 'dug

/grub thob sum phul tsam zhig yong bar 'dug /da nga'i rtsar sdod la sgrub pa gyis gsung nas/ rje btsun ma bam skyed ma dang*/ rdzogs rim la chos drug gnang nas bsgoms pas drod bzang po byung nas ras bud byas pas ras pa thams cad las dbrang 'gu ras pa bzang bar 'dug gsungs nas ming yang dbrang 'gu ras par btags gsungs/ de dus chos skyong ber nag spyan gyi rje gnang gnang*/ yon po dang bsnyug lung gnyis su sgrubs pa byed kyin bsdad/ skabs su lung rtser yang thog rer bsdad/ btsun chung brgyad cu tsam re yod pa'i gral mgor bzhag nas dbrang 'gu ras pa grub thob yin gsungs nas gsol ras gnang zhing thugs rtsis che bar mdzad do// drung rin po che'i dbon po bla ma ston byang pa yab yum gyi sar gdan drangs nas rje btsun ma'i dbang bskur dang*/ snam sras kyi rjes gnang zhus/ de nas khong gi pha khu dang mi gzhan 'gras pas/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes nas brgyud pa'i gshin rje kha thun bu mo lugs la nus pa thon pa'i sngags pa bdud mi zan phyi rong tshab btsun sgom bya ba la brgya 'bul zhig byas nas/ gshin rje'i sgrub skor sba tra dang bcas pa zhus nas sgrub pas rtags dang nus pa thon/ dgra rnams la shi chad dang*/ bkra mi shis pa'i ltas sna tshogs byung*/ nus pa shin tu che bar grags/ yang de dus yum gyi rkang pa zhwa nas ci byas kyang ma phan pa la/ rta mgrin gyi drag sngags brgyab cing byin brlabs byas/ phyag nas 'then pas langs nas 'gro shes pa byung*/ gzhan yang yul de na rdo lug mgo zer ba'i klu bdud gzhi bdag gnyan po zhig gnas pa nyin par yang mis 'gro mi nus pa zhig yod pa'i sar/ rje nyid dang sngags pa nus pa can du grags pa zhig yod pa gnyis kyis phyin nas btul bas klu bdud kyi gnod pa rang zhi la song*/ yul pa rnams na re de 'dra 'dul nus pa ya mtshan che zer nas thams cad dga' bar gyur/

lar de dus nus pa che ba dang sgom bzang bar grags kyang dbus la phyin pa'i btsun pa rnams la rtsis che ba la brten dbus gtsang la 'gro bsam nas yab yum la zhus pas/ yab na re nga na so rgas pa dang*/ nad bu dam pas khyed dbus gtsang la byon pas mi yong zer nas 'gror ma ster/ de'i nub mo chos skyong la gtor mchod cig phul nas gsol ba btab pas/ rmi lam na chos skyong ber nag can/ bla ma dbang phyug dpal gyi chas su byas pa zhig byung nas/ da res khyod dbus gtsang la song*/ ngas yar skyal ba yin/ dbus gtsang la lo bzhi bcu sdod/ da bzod ngas bsu ba yin zer/ der gnyid sad pa dang blo bde nas chos skyong la gtor mchod bzang po phul/ nangs par pha rgan la nged da res dbus gtsang la cis kyang 'gro bas bka' gnang dgos zhus pas/ da gros byed dgos lo gcig tsam sdod/ rgyags chu se nyag 'dra bsgrubs nas de nas 'gro ba yin mod zer/ da res zla bo'i stabs dang byas pas ma thon na/ de nas i thon mi shes pas/ da lo rang 'gro zhus pas/ de nas yab yum gyis rgyags thes la rta bzang gnyis/ gla rtsi rgya chag gcig gser dngul dam dum yod pa kun bskur nas/ slob dpon rgya rje ston pa drung chos rje'i bsu ba la byon pa'i phyags phyi la yong*/ karma lha steng du drung chos rje rang byung ba dang mjal/ de dus chos kyi 'brel pa tsam zhus/ drung chos rje'i gsung nas khyed rnams sngon la dbus gtsang la song*/ nged rting la sleb pa yin gsungs/ de dus stod hor yong zer ba'i skad karma skor pa rnams kyis thos nas 'ur chen po 'dug pas/ zla bo rigs gcig yul la log rigs gcig yar la 'gro ba e 'thad yin zer nas sems ma bde bas/ nub cig tho rangs kha tsam na mi nag po dar gyi gos gon pa zhig na re/ da res stod hor mi yong*/ dbus gtsang la 'ded/ lam la bar chad med par ngas byed pa yin zer/ de'i nang par zla bo gcig gnyis la/

nged la rmi lam 'di 'dra ba zhig byung byas pas/ zla bo kun na re khyed kyi de chos skyong gi ltas su 'dug /sngar yang khyed kyis gang gsungs pa de bden pa zhig yod pas/ nged kyang khyed kyi zla la yar 'gro zer nas 'ong bas lam la bar chad med par dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gsum la stod lung mtshur phur phyags phebs so// dbus su phyags phebs pa'i dus su chos nyan bshad gar dar dris pas gsang phu dar zer nas gsang phu ne'u thog tu byon te/ slob dpon 'jam dbyangs shākya gzhon nu dang*/ slob dpon blo gros mtshungs med la pha rol du phyin pa dang*/ tshad ma la sogs pa la slob gnyer lo drug gi bar du mdzad/ dbus gtsang gnyis su grā bskor byas pas phar phyin gyi ston pa bzang ba'i thog chod/ da lta'i slob gnyer byed pa rnams kyis nga'i slob gnyer byed pa de'i phyed kyi dka' las kyang mi nus gsungs/ lan gcig stag lung la grā bskor la phyin dus/ bla ma rtogs ldan mes gzhon pa 'phan yul na bzhugs pa dang mjal/ zhi byed ngo sprod gcig zhus pas zhag bdun tsam gyi bar du mi 'chor ba'i ting nge 'dzin bzang po byung nas/ slob dpon blo gros mtshungs med la zhus pas/ khyod la bsgom chen byas na/ rdzun ma chen po zhig 'ong bar 'dug /rdzun gyi gtong lugs 'di rang gis chog gsungs nas bzhad gad mdzad/ yang snying po slar 'jam dbyangs kyi blo 'phel bsgrubs pas/ 'jam dbyangs seng ge dkar mo dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa zhig la chibs nas mkha' la byon pa bde chen gyi rgyab ri la bab pa zhig byung*/ de phyis bde chen du sgrub pa byed pa'i brdar 'dug /yang de dus rje btsun ma sgrol ma dang*/ chos skyong ber nag can gyis bar chad bsal ba'i ltas mang du byung*/ pha 'ong khar phar phyin gyi gzhung la blo bshar brgya tshar byas dus rje btsun ma zhal yang yang gzigs gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan phyis gnas nang gi gzims khang 'og mar lan cig dar rgyal ba la slob dpon dge slong*/

da mi rgas pas yi dam lhas zhal mi ston par 'dug /sngar bsgom byed khar rje btsun ma rgyun du zhal mthong*/ de yi dam lhas bsgom la bskul ba yin par 'dug gsungs/ lar de dus bsgom zhig mdzad dgongs pa yang yang byung*/ sngar khams nas khyer 'ongs pa'i dngos po rnams kyang slob gnyer byed pa'i bar la zad nas sgom rgyags kyang cher med/ mtshur phur bla ma bkra shis 'bum dang*/ sa smad pa rnams ma 'cham pa'i bar byas pas chos rje'i gsung nas khyod mi bsams pa yod pa zhig 'dug gsungs nas mnyes par byung*/ mi tsho'i byed spyod la yang skyo shas skyes jo mo nang du bsgom la 'gro dgos snyam pa byung gsungs/ de'i dus chos rje rin po che'i gsungs nas/ dge bshes grags seng rang bde chen du byon nas bsgom byas pas drag gsungs/ bsgom byed pa'i chos rgyags che bar med zhus pas/ rgyags 'thud nged kyis ster ba yin gsungs/ rgyags 'thud pa pas ye med zhus pas/ chos rgyags nged kyis byed pa yin gsungs nas lto gos chos gsum gyis bskyangs/ dgung lo sum cu la bde chen du byon te chos drug gi khrid zhus nas/ seng ge lung du dbyar zhig bsgom pa'i dus su/ yig brgya'i khrid nyan dus rmi lam zin pa byung*/ snang ba thams cad rgya mtsho'i dkyil lta bu la/ yi dam gyi lha dang chos skyong gi stong gzugs mang du shar/ de'i dus su go ba rtsa rlung thig le bsgom pa 'di bas/ pha rol du phyin pa nas bshad pa'i gcig dang du ma'i ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'i don la mnyam par bzhag na dga' bar 'dug snyam par byung nas/ chos rje la zhus pas/ rtsa rlung thig le rgyud thams cad nas zab par bshad pa dang*/ thabs la gnad du bsnun na shes rab myur du rtogs pa'i tshul dang*/ rtsa rlung gi yon tan mang po gsungs pas/ nges shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes/ rtsa rlung bsgom pa la brod par byung nas zhag re la lus sbyong so bdun ma sum brgya re'i dam bca' byas/

rgyags dang ltos gos nang so nas zad len gyis gsungs byung na'ang*/ bla ma'i phyag rdzas de 'ju dka' snyam nas phal cher dka' thub la brten te byas/ nyin zhag gsum gsum tsam la za ma thengs re las med pa'ang byung bas/ lus sbyong byed dus glo snying zags nas 'gro ba 'dra ba 'byung ste/ rlung rtsol la thong lhod med par byas/ de'i nub gcig gi rm-i lam na bud med gcig gis sha gzugs gcig sbyin nas lan gcig 'di zo/ da bzod za mi thub pa yong ba yin zer/ nang par bsnyen gnas sangs rgyas dar gyis sha gzugs gcig khyer byung nas 'di gsol zer/ phyis sngar gyi rmi lam bzhin du byung gsungs/ yang nub gcig rmi lam na spang shong legs po gcig nang 'dug pa la/ spang shong de la lung pa thams cad kyi chu 'bab kyin 'dug /chu'i sgra de rnams thams cad ḍā ma ru'i sgrar song nas mnal sad 'brog la sngar gyi spang shong de mtsho'i rnam par 'dug pa'i steng na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs 'dug pa mthong*/ de'i dus su snang ba thams cad bden med du song nas thugs dam la bogs shin tu che bar gyur/ de dus bde chen byang gling na yod pa la tha mal gyi shes pa 'di ma bsgoms na bzang bar 'dug /bsgoms par gyod byas 'dug snyam nas bde chen pa byin po la yang*/ da thams cad ma bsgom par zhog zer dgos snyam nas/ spyil po'i sgo rtsar lan gsum phyin nas 'bod pa btang dgos snyam pa la dran pas zin te/ gzhan rnams kyis khams 'dus byung 'dug zer gyi dogs nas nang du yong*/ sang nyin chos rje'i drung du phyin nas zhus pas/ tha mal gyi shes pa 'char lugs legs te/ da rung drod nyams kyi 'dres dum pa yod gsungs/ nga rang gi rtogs pa la 'dres rang med pa la drung nas kyang ma dgongs sam snyam pa byung*/ phyis gsungs pa med par 'dug nyams de la yal rgyu dum pa byung*/

de dus chos rje rin po che bla ma snye mdo ba la mtshur phur dus 'khor gyi dbang zhur byon pa'i dus su/ nub gcig rmi lam bzung nas dbang ltas la phyin pas/ mtshur phu'i gzhi bdag des dbang zhu ba rnams la bar chad byed pa'i phyir mar me gsum gsad byung ba la/ bla ma snye mdo bas ma mkhyen drung chos rjes mkhyen nas/ dam tshig rdo rje phyag tu bsnams nas sum bha ni gsungs pa dang*/ bar chad byed pa de bros nas song*/ gzhan yang dkyil 'khor gyi bca' ga dang*/ dbang zhu ba du 'dug rnams legs par shes pa byung*/ phyis chos rje dang mjal dus de rnams zhus pas khyed kyis gzigs pa de ka bzhin byung*/ da gsum tsam la bar chad cig yong bar 'dug /lar khyed kyi rmi lam gyi rtsal 'di grub thob skyer sgang pa dang mnyam par 'dug gsungs nas shin tu mnyes pa byung*/ yang nub gcig rmi lam na chos rje'i gzim chung na tshe dpag med kyi sku gcig bzhugs 'dug pa la ser drag cig phog nas sku de zhig la khad pa cig rmis pa/ drung chos rje la zhus pas/ 'dang zhag tshe sgrub cig byas pa yin te/ mkhan po chu mig pa la dbang bskur zhig byas pas bsgrub pa de'i bar chad cig byung ba de khyed kyi rmi lam du byung 'dug gsungs/ yang mtha' brag gi srin mos sgom chen pa rnams la bar chad byed gyin 'dug pas/ rmi lam bzung nas yi dam lha'i ting nge 'dzin gyis btul bas/ mo na re/ nga la dus rtag tu gnod sems kyang yod pa yin te/ drung chos rje dang khyed rnam gnyis kyi zhal mthong tsa na gnod sems de zhi bar 'dug zer nas dam la btag/ yang lan gcig rmi lam na la stod kyi rgyab gangs ri zhig gi rtsa na rgya mi mang po 'dug pa mthong nas drung du zhus pas/ stod hor gyi skad yod par 'dug da rung ltos gsungs pa la/ rmi lam bzung nas bltas pas/ phyir log nas khong rang gi pho brang du song*/ de dus rgyal bu chos dpal stod hor la 'thab du song bas 'thab ma dgos par log byung*/

gzhan bde chen du bsgom dus nyams kyi 'char tshul gzhan gyi sems shes pa dang*/ rmi lam 'od gsal gyi gzigs tshul mang du gsungs te mdor bsdus tsam bkod pa yin zhes 'byung*/ de dus nyams dang rmi lam du u rgyan dang rdzong drug la phyin pa yang yang byung nas gnas de rnams su phyin na thugs dam gyi bogs che bar dgongs nas/ chos rje'i drung du u rgyan dang rdzong drug la 'gro bar zhus pas/ u rgyan du 'gro ba la rdzu 'phrul thob dgos gsung nas/ rje btsun tai lo pa'i gtam rgyud kyang gsungs/ de dus thugs dam ni chos drug dang rje btsun ma rkyang pa la gcig dril du byas pa yin te/ rgyu mtshan yang*/ mgur las/ sgom chen grags ba seng ge ngas// gdams ngag nā ro'i chos drug zhus// gtum mo'i bde drod nang nas 'bar// rnam rtog bde stong ngang du thim// zhes gsungs/ phyis kyang chos rje'i drung du u rgyan dang la stod la 'gro ba'i zhu ba drag po byas pas/ u rgyan du byon pa mi dga'/ rdzong drug la gnas skor zhig gyis/ yar lam bla ma byang sems pa la sbyor drug cig zhus gsungs nas bka' gnang*/ de nas drung chos rje ru mtshams su byon pa'i phyags phyi la phyin pas/ snye mor phyags phyi ba rnams kyis skyel chang la chang ban chung ngu drug cu bdun cu zhig bteg pa 'thungs pas gzi ba'i skyon med pa/ nyams shin tu 'ur ba byung nas/ ḍā ma ru dkrol gyin byon pas drung nas dpon slob rnams kyang thugs g.yo ba tsam byung gsungs/ de nas jo mo nang du sang sleb pa'i sa zhig tu gzims pa'i rmi lam na/ jo mo nags rgyal gyi gling gseb de mjo snum ral sig ge ba mang pos gang ba zhig rmis/ jo mo nags rgyal gyi gnas de mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa yin par 'dug snyam pa byung*/ de nas bla ma byang chub sems dpa' dang mjal dus/ mi gzhan la dris pa skad gsungs nas sngar khams su bla ma bsten tshul dang*/

dag snang shar lugs lam du chos rje dang mjal lugs mtshur phur sleb dus rta shi ba dang*/ ne'u thog tu slob gnyer byas lugs/ bde chen du bsgom byas lugs rnams zhu+u ma dgos par tshur gsungs/ rang re'i rtog pa la sgom yun 'di tsam mdzad pa la/ mngon shes 'di tsam yong thang*/ ngas lo gsum bsgoms pa la yang gsal snang 'di tsam byung*/ byang chub kyi sems 'di 'dra ba rang thugs la 'khrungs pa ngo mtshar re che snyam pa byung*/ de nas bla ma byang sems chen pos pha bu 'phrad pa bzhin du thugs la btags/ lto gos chos gsum gyis bskyangs/ sngar gyi nyams myong rnams zhus pas shin tu mnyes nas byung*/ khyed rjes dran la sleb 'dug ste/ da bzod slob ma gzhan la ston pa'i dus su thams cad mkhyen dgos pas rim can du bsgoms gsungs nas dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi dbang dang*/ sbyor drug gi khrid gnang nas bsgom bla ma'i gsungs nas 'khrul 'khor ma byed par dben gsum gyis gsung na'ang*/ sngar nas chos drug gi 'khrul 'khor byed pa'i dam bca' yod pas/ lkog tu 'khrul 'khor ma chag par byas/ bla ma'i gsungs nas 'khrul 'khor byas pas stong gzugs la gnod par 'dug gam mi 'dug gsungs/ mi gnod par me la sbud pa rgyab pa bzhin du stong gzugs lhag par cher 'bar bar 'dug zhus pas/ da rjes dran la sleb 'dug pas rlung rtsol dang sres pas chog gsung nas shin tu mnyes te/ ming yang slob dpon phya ston pa zhes bya bar btags/ yang bla ma'i drung du bde mchog dril bu pas lugs kyi dbang bskur zhus pa'i nub mo/ bla ma bde mchog dngos su mthong*/ de la brten nas nyams rtogs pa'i bogs shin tu che bar byung*/ yang de dus sbyor drug bsgom zhing mnyam bzhag byas pa'i dus su/ lus kyi rtsa thams cad dkar shad kyi mthong ba cig byung*/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang nas srin bu mgo chu srin 'dra ba la rgyab phyogs nas ze ba yod pa 'dra ba zhig sna sgo nas thon la khad byung ba la skyug log pa cig byung nas/

nang par bla ma la zhus pas de srog gi srin bu bya ba yin/ sngar chos rje kun spangs chen po'i dus su srog gi srin bu thon pa zhig byung*/ da lan khyed la byung srin bu 'di 'don nus na phyi nang gi srin bu thams cad chad/ bcud len kyang 'grub pa yin gsungs/ yang nub gcig rmi lam na gangs ri chen po zhig gi rtse mo la phyin pas/ der drung chos rje bzhugs 'dug /gangs ri de'i rtse mo nas lhung la khad 'dug pa la gnyid sad pa dang snying rtsa 'dar ba zhig byung nas/ de bla ma'i drung du zhus pas/ spyi gtsug haṃ gi yi ge ru rlung sems kyi dngas ma 'dus pa yin/ drung chos rje gzigs pa de mos gus kyi byed pa yin/ lhung la khad pa de rtsa dbu ma'i yar snar rlung sems 'dus pa'i stobs yin 'dar ba de rlung gi byed pa yin pas da lta stangs dma' bar gyis la/ 'og gi bde ba la shes pa gtod gsungs/ de ltar byas pas shin tu phan par byung*/ de nas bla ma byang sems chen po la sngar chos rje'i drung du yang zhus yod pas/ u rgyan dang rdzong drug la 'gro bar zhus pas/ u rgyan mi dga' rdzong drug yang sa rdo yin 'di kar bsgom gsungs/ cis kyang 'gro bar zhu byas pas/ sang nyin tshogs su byin po la gsung ba skad mdzad nas bka' bkyon mdzad de/ gdams ngag thams cad nas/ bca' ba lus kyi gnad zer ba ma gtogs pa/ 'gro ba rkang pa'i gnad zer ba mi 'dug /da lta'i sgom chen gtsang na yod pa rnams ni dbus su rgyug jo bo la mjal 'gro zer bar 'dug /dbus na yod pa rnams la stod la rgyug rdzong drug bltar 'gro zer bar 'dug /shol btab kyang mi nyan par ske chad kyang 'gro zer bar 'dug gsungs/ de'i nub mo thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ nga la ni bla ma 'di la 'bul rgyu a ru+u ra zhig las med/ lto gos chos gsum gyis bskyangs nas thugs la 'di 'dra ba btags pa la da gang gsung byed dgos snyam pa byung*/

nangs par bla ma la zhus/ da lan rdzong drug la phyin nas de nas 'dir sdod par zhu zhus pas da bzod cir 'gro mi shes/ da lo rang sdod gsungs nas sbyor drug gi gdams pa bod du 'gyur tshad chos rje kun spangs chen po la bzhugs/ de tsho rang re la yod pas khyed sgom chen pa kha yar la ston pa yin gsungs nas brag pha bong du byon te/ gdams ngag rnams yongs su rdzogs par gnang*/ bla ma gsum gyi rnam thar kyang mthar thon pa yin gsungs nas sku mtshams mdzad/ slob dpon phya ston pa yang rdzong drug gzigs la/ bla ma rang byung pa ji skad gsung ba'i bka' la nyon/ da bzod slob ma la sbyor drug gi khrid kyang skyong gsung nas zhal ta mang du mdzad/ de'i dus su nub cig rmi lam du u rgyan du byon pa dang*/ rje btsun ma mjal lugs mgur du gsungs pa ni/ nub cig rmi lam snang ba la// u rgyan gnas su phyin pa rmis// mi ro rta ro'i khri stengs su// yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// skyil krungs phyed pas bzhugs pa mthong*// zhes gsungs/ de nas la stod la byon te/ yar lam ding ri glang gor du rin po che karma pa'i slob ma 'dam pa zhig po dang mjal chos gsung gleng mang du byas/ ngo mtshar can zhig 'dug snyam pa byung*/ de nas yar byon pa'i lam du sha dug gi bsnyung gzhi dam po zhig byung ba la bla ma la gsol ba gtab pas tho rangs kyi rmi lam du chos rje rnam gsum dang*/ sgos su chos rje gsal bar byon nas rtsa gzigs khyed kyi nad 'di la a ru ra zhig thong gsungs pas/ nangs par a ru ra'i thang byas pas de ma thag la sos/ de nas rgyal gyi rtsibs ri la phyin te/ thugs dam byas pas shin tu bogs che bar byung nas mgur byas pa/ gnas chen rgyal gyi rtsibs ri 'dir// sngon yang grub thob bsam mi khyab// kun gyis dngos grub thob pa'i gnas// mthong ba tsam gyis ting 'dzin 'phel// da lta sgom chen grags seng nga*//

gcig pur yengs med bsgoms pa la// nyams la shar nas mgur zhig byed// ces gsungs/ yang nub cig gnas der/ rang gnyid 'od gsal du song ba'i ngang nas chos rje rin po che dang mjal/ chos rje'i lta sgom spyod gsum gyi mgur gsungs pa la/ gson dang skal ldan grags seng khyed// nam mkha' 'di la phar bltas pas// lta ba rkyen thub tur gyis dran// ces pa la sogs gsungs/ gnyid sad rting la ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ mgur de rnams blo la sa le 'dug/ phyis chos rje dang bde chen du mjal dus tshogs gral gcig tu sgom chen pa kha yar la zhal ta'i mgur zhig mdzad/ slob dpon grags seng khyed la stod bzhugs dus sngar bas ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba ci 'dra byung*/ khyed kyis kyang nyams mgur zhig gyis gsungs/ de dus sngar chos rjes mnal lam du gsungs pa'i mgur de byas pas ngas jo mo gangs su mgur byas pa de/ khyed kyis rtsibs rir thos 'dug /ngas gson dang 'dir bzhugs sgom chen rnams byas pa de/ khyed kyis skal ldan grags seng khyed bya bar go 'dug gzhan tshig rnams la khyad mi 'dug gsungs nas shin tu mnyes/ tshogs gral na yod pa rnams kyang mos par gyur te/ de rnams kyi rgyu mtshan yang*/ chos rje'i gsung nas/ rgyal ba'i phrin las gdul bya mang po la// dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig shar ba dang*// khyad par du yang grags pa seng ge la// nyams kyi snang ba rdzu 'phrul lta bur snang*// zhes gsungs so// de dus slob dpon ting 'dzin pa dpon slob dang mjal nas gdams ngag gi gsung gleng dang*/ chos phar zhu tshur zhu mang du byas/ bla ma grub chen pa'i gdan sa spu trar byon te/ bla ma mkhas btsun bsod nams 'od zer la/ grub chen pa'i bsnyen bsgrub kyi gdams pa kha yar zhus/ bla ma rin 'dab pa zhes bya ba la slob dpon ting 'dzin pa dang lhan du nyams khrid bdud rtsi thigs pa zhes bya ba zhus/ lar de dus ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/

nyams kyang shin tu dga'/ de thams cad bla ma'i sku drin du go ste/ chos rje'i drung du gsol 'debs kyi zhu yig phul ba ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas rin po che// mtshungs med dpal ldan 'gro ba'i mgon// sku drin can la gsol ba 'debs// rgyun chad med par thugs rjes zung*// zhes pa la sogs pa phul lo// de nas bal yul du phyin te/ lam na skyid grong du yod tsa na/ snang ba thams cad sbrul du song nas de la 'jigs skrag dang bcas pa zhig byung*/ de klu'i cho 'phrul yin las che snyam nas phyis chos rje la mjal dus zhus pas/ de klu'i cho 'phrul min lus kyi rtsa mthong ba yin/ 'jigs skrag de dbu mar rlung sems 'dus pa yin gsungs/ des srog rlung gi gegs las grol ba yin/ de dus mnyam par bzhag pa'i stong gzugs la/ bla ma byang sems chen po'i pur de yang yang mthong*/ de ci yin snyam pa byung nas phyir log nas jo mo nang du phyin dus/ bla ma byang sems chen po bde bar gshegs nas pur la mchod pa 'bul gyin 'dug pa dang mjal/ zla ba gcig tsam gyi bar du bsdad nas gsol ba btab/ de nas bde chen du chos rje'i drung du byon te/ thugs kyi dgongs pa la chos rje'i drung du bsdad nas gdams pa lhag ma rnams zhu zhing*/ bsgrub pa rtse gcig tu byas nas/ rje btsun mi la dang 'dra ba cig bya dgos snyam nas/ ri mi 'bab dang*/ 'dag sbyar gyis dus 'da' bar byas/ skabs skabs su chos rje'i sku rim gro yang kha yar byas/ de dus mkhan chen gzhon byang pa dang*/ slob dpon bkra shis rin chen pa gnyis la bsnyen rdzogs byas nas/ nye gnas re tsam yang rtsar bzhag /chos rje'i drung na sgom chen brgyad brgya tsam re yod pa'i nang nas rtogs pa mtho bar grags/ chos rje'i bu rgan rnams kyis kyang chos 'brel dang dbang ka mang du zhus/ de dus sgom chen zhig na ba la/ sgom chen bzang ba kha yar gdan drangs nas gtor dbang zhig zhus pas/

slob dpon lha ras kyis gtor ma 'dzin mkhan mdzad/ nged kyis ting nge 'dzin yod pas/ sgom chen de'i mgo thog na/ chos skyong ber nag can mi'i lus nyis 'gyur tsam zhig bzhugs nas zhal du sbrul zhig khyu ru ru mid pa zhig mthong*/ de nas de'i nad sos pa la tshegs ma byung*/ gzhan yang dus de nyid kyi gsal snang la chos rje pho brang du gdan 'dren pa dang*/ 'phrin las ji ltar 'byung ba dang*/ pho brang du thugs dgongs rdzogs par mdzad pa rnams shes pa 'byung nas drung du yang zhus shing*/ slob dpon g.ya' bzang ba la sogs pa'i sgom chen pa rgan pa rnams la'ang bshad/ phyis rmi lam de ka'i thog tu song gsungs/ lar de dus bde chen du nyams kyi snang ba la 'char tshul dang*/ yi dam chos skyong gi gzigs lugs mang du yod de ma bshad/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang mtshur phur nub cig gi tho rangs kar rje btsun ma rgyan dang bcas pa cig gis/ phyag g.yon pas nga'i kha bkab pa cig mthong*/ de'i rgyu mtshan phyis nyams myong gzhan la ma smra gsungs pa'i brdar 'dug ste yang bshad shor gsungs/ de'i dus su mgur bzhengs pa ni/ nyams cung zad cig na gzhan la 'chad// gzhan la mi phan rang la gnod// de phyir ma smra kha rog sdod// zhen med ngang du dge sbyor gyis//

gsungs/ lar bde chen du snga phyi thams cad dril bas lo bcu bsdad/ chos gdams ngag thams cad kyang yongs su rdzogs par zhus/ de nas sngar gyi sgom chen nam mkha' 'od kyi bzhugs gnas yin pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ mtshur phu'i dben gnas phug mo cher bzhugs te/ sgrub pa rtse gcig tu brtson par byas/ rtogs ldan nam mkha' 'od kyi skye ba yin pa yang lhag par gsal ba byung*/ de dus phug mo cher rmi lam na bu mo sngon mo dar gyi na bza' gsol pa/ phyag na mda' dar bzung ba zhig gis ra lug mang po zam pa zhig la sgrol gyin 'dug pa rmis/ de rang re'i gdul bya rnams rje btsun mas thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i brdar 'dug pas/ sgom chen kha yar la khrid dang gdams pa yang byas/ sgom chen nyams myong ldan pa kha yar byung*/ de dus slob dpon mtshungs med sku gshegs zer ba thos nas/ rje btsun ma'i gsang sgrub zla ba gcig byas pas yi dam gyi lha'i gzigs snang khyad par can byung*/ slob dpon pa'i thugs dgongs yang rdzogs par 'dug bsam/ de dus yab tu nā ro mkha' spyod la mjal du phyin pa'i lam du brag mig pa'i sgom chen pa rnams la/ rje btsun ma'i dbang bskur zhig byas pa'i dus su/ dpon slob thams cad nyams 'ur ba dang*/ chang gi rgyun 'dzad pa med pa byung*/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur byas pa 'di 'dra yin na/ dbang bskur bya rin chog par 'dug gsungs/ de nas jo mo'i drung du byon nas/ tshogs mchod bshams te gsol ba btab pas rin po che pa nyid dang*/ sgom chen pa gsum tsam gyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra dngos su thos pa byung*/ de nas gsol 'debs mdzad pa ni/ u rgyan gnas 'dir gsol ba 'debs// mkha' spyod ma yis byin gyis rlobs// nyams dga' chen por ya la la// zhes sogs gsungs/ gzhan yang de gong du byon pa la dag snang gzigs tshul khyad par can byung ba yin par 'dug/ yang nub cig phug chen gyi gnas der rmi lam bzung nas sprul bsgyur byas te/

sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i zhal lta nus pa zhig byung*/ yang tho rang gi rmi lam zhig na/ phug mo che'i gnas de sbrul nag po zhig gis bskor 'dug pa rmis/ ngas bya khyung zhig tu sprul nas/ sbrul de bar snang la khyer bas mjug ma rdzogs la khad la ston pas 'khrul 'khor byas pas gnyid sad/ sang nyin byin po 'dus nas rim gro zhig gi grab byas pas/ zul phu ba'i dge bshes shes rab seng ge rbab la lhungs nas shi/ sbrul gyi mjug ma de rdzogs na bar chad de mi yong bar 'dug pa la gsungs/ yang gnas der chos skyong gi gsol mchod drag po cig byas pas gtor rgyan gyi mar la nor bu rin po che gzugs dang me tog gi gzugs 'bur du dod pa byung*/ de'i dus su yon bdag mgon rdor tshang gi nor la god kha chen po byung nas chos skyong gi sbyin sreg zhig cis kyang zhu zer nas zhu ba drag po byung bas/ sbyin sreg byas pa'i dus su me nang na chos skyong ber nag can bzhugs pa'i zhal du sbrul zhig mid pa mthong*/ phyis khong tshang gi mi nor gyi god kha chad de/ mi nor thams cad de nas 'phel bar byung*/ yang gnas der chos rje'i gsung shog byon nas dros mo dgon par sdod gsungs pa la/ de'i nub mo rmi lam brtags pas chos skyong gis khyed rang 'gro na song*/ nga der mi 'gro gsungs pa byung*/ der phyin kyang 'phrin las mi yong bar 'dug snyam nas/ ston pa dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gdan sa la btang ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ yang de dus yon bdag bkra shis 'bum rang re la shin tu dad par 'dug zer nas/ ri pa 'od zer 'bum gyis gdan drangs te dbang bskur byas/ de nas bye lung dgon par dbang ka mang du byas te/ de dus su ngo mtshar gyi ltas dang khyad par lag mchod byas pa'i chang zho bzhin chags pa byung*/ gzhan rnams kyang ngo mtshar du gyur/ lar gnyan chen po thang lha'i lha skor de rnams rang re la shin tu dad par 'dug pas/

de'i rten 'brel gyis gnam pas rang re'i yon bdag rtsa ba byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang de yin par 'dug gsungs/ yang gnas der rje btsun ma'i lung bstan zhig byung nas/ bla ma dpal ri ba chen po la mkha' spyod ma zhur phyin pas/ nga la rmis ltas khyad par can byung gsungs nas mnyes/ de yan chad gdams ngag rnams rdzogs par mdzad cing*/ bla ma rnams la chos gsan pa ni/ thog mar snga ba la khams su bla ma seng ras la gtor dbang zhig zhus/ slob dpon blo gros grags pa la rta mgrin jo bo lugs/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa nas brgyud pa'i chos drug /bde gshegs kyis mdzad pa'i rin chen them skas/ rin chen phreng ba/ baiḍūr+ya'i them skas/ chos skyong phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan yang bde gshegs stag lung thang pa la brgyud pa'i chos skor mang du zhus/ bla ma drung rin po che ye shes seng ge la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ chos drug gi khrid yongs su rdzogs pa chos skyong ma mgon gyi rjes gnang dang bcas pa zhus/ bla ma ston byang ba la rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs kyi bka'/ rnam sras kyi rjes gnang*/ gzhan yang kaṃ tshang gi chos skor mang du zhus/ slob dpon rgya rje ston pa la rab tu byung nas bslab tshig dang bcas pa zhus/ slob dpon ju ston la bde mchog lo hi pa'i skor tshang ba zhus/ rong tsha btsun sgom la gshin rje kha thun sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ uṣ+ṇīṣa ra lugs/ gzhan yang bstan srung gi skor mang du zhus/ de nas dbus su slob dpon chen po 'jam dpal dbyangs shākra gzhon pa la byams pa'i chos lnga 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ tshad ma rnam nges/ mngon pa kun las btus pa/ jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa/ blo sbyong gi gdams pa/ sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo/ sgrol ma lha dgu'i tshe bsring ba'i sgrub thabs/

'jam dbyangs blo 'phel/ gzhan yang mtshan nyid kyi chos skor mang du zhus/ slob dpon blo gros mtshungs med la slob dpon shāka gzhon pa las gsan pa'i chos rnams dang*/ slob dpon pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud bla'i 'grel pa/ spyod 'jug gi 'grel pa/ theg chen gsal byed la sogs pa'i bstan bcos mang du zhus/ bla ma rtogs ldan ye gzhon pa la sems bskyed dbu ma lugs dang*/ zhi byed kyi ngo sprod cig zhus/ mtshur phur slob dpon ye shes rgyal mtshan pa la bde mchog gi rgyud lung dang sgrub thabs mang du zhus/ slob dpon pa de bde mchog bod du 'gyur tshad shes gsung bar 'dug phug mo cher bla ma rin dar ba la khros ma nag mo'i byin rlabs dang*/ ber nag can gyi rjes gnang zhus/ chos rje rin po che rang byung rdo rje la/ 'khor lo bde mchog dril bu pa/ dgyes rdor/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma hrīḥbaskyed bam̐m̐ bskyed/ lha mo ku ru kul+le rnams kyi dbang bskur zhus/ chos skyong gi rjes gnang zhus/ rgyud gsan pa la/ gsang ba 'dus pa la sogs pa pha rgyud kyi skor rnams dang*/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ bde mchog dgyes rdor la sogs pa ma rgyud kyi skor rnams dang*/ gzhan yang yo ga'i rgyud/ bya spyod kyi rgyud rnams rin po che zang zang pa dang stabs su zhus/ mdo sde dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang*/ mdo sde pad+ma dkar po/ dam chos pad+ma dkar po/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes rabs brgya rtsa/ byams chos lnga'i rtsa ba/ dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs kyi lung mang du zhus/ khrid kyi gdams pa la/ rdzogs chen snying thig /zab mo'i pod bzhi khrid ka dang bcas pa/ rje nā ro pa'i chos drug gi skor yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i gegs sel gzer lnga/ rje mar pa'i rlung gi de nyid bdun cu/ gegs sel zhal gdams/ chos rje rang gis mdzad pa'i rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs sel/

rnal 'byor gsum rnying gzhung 'grel khrid yig dang bcas pa/ bla ma grub chen pas mdzad pa'i bsnyen sgrub gzhung 'grel khrid yig dang bcas pa/ te phu nas brgyud pa'i chos drug /thabs bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo/ ras chung bsnyen sgrub/ te phu pa'i gegs sel chen mo/ gzhan yang ras chung pa'i chos skor mang du zhus/ a tsar dmar po zhabs nas brgyud pa'i rlung drag po seng ge 'jing bsnol gyi skor/ phyag rgya chen po'i skor la/ do ha skor gsum/ bsam gtan thun 'jog /te lo pa'i tshig bzhi/ gaṃ gā ma/ nā ro pa'i lta ba mdor bsdus thog babs/ man ngag tshig bsdus/ lde'u'i skor yi ge bzhi pa la sogs te/ phyag rgya chen po'i skor bcu gsum tsam zhus gsungs/ dam pa so chung nas brgyud pa'i zhi byed don skor lnga bcu rtsa lnga/ ma gcig nas brgyud pa'i gcod skor rnams yongs su rdzogs pa/ yang ri gang nas brgyud pa'i ni gu chos drug /phyag rgya chen po ga'u+u ma 'chi med 'khrul 'khor rnams zhus/ sgrub thabs kyi skor la/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs/ bde mchog mar do dang bu rong nas brgyud pa/ dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgu lha mo ku ru kul+le/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lhan cig skyes ma/ hrīḥbaskyed bam̐ bskyed kyi sgrub thabs/ phag mo dkar mo rje dus gsum mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i phag mo zhal bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs/ snying 'phrog dmar mo/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho rgyud gsum/ gu ru pad+ma mdzad pa'i ba mkhal ma/ rje karma pas mdzad pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho skor gsum las tshogs dang bcas pa/ chos rjes mdzad pa'i gsang sgrub/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po rnam gsum/ rnam 'joms dkar po/ thugs rje chen po dpal mo lugs/ grub thob skyer sgang pa nas brgyud pa'i gtso 'khor gsum pa/ tshe dpag med/ ras chung pa nas brgyud pa uṣ+ṇīṣa khro bcu'i srung 'khor/ chos skyong ma mgon gyi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/

sngags bdag dang skyes bu'i sgrub thabs/ gzhan yang sgrub thabs dang bstan srung gi skor mang du zhus/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rtsom chos zhus pa la/ rje mar pas mdzad pa'i chos drug /rje mi la'i bsre 'pho/ gtum mo gangs ser ma/ rje dgas pos mdzad pa'i chos bzhi/ tshogs chos/ rje dus gsam mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rnam bzhi rgyud grol/ 'brel pa bzhi ldan/ rmi lam 'brel pa gsum ldan/ rje karma pas mdzad pa'i bstan pa rgya mtsho mtha' yas kyi gzhung tshigs bcad ma chen mo/ zab gdams skor lnga/ rje rgod tshang pas mdzad pa'i ro snyoms sgang dril/ gzhan yang chos chung mang du zhus/ drung chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum rnams yongs su rdzogs pa zhus/ bla ma ku ma rā dza la rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud bcu bdun/ khros ma nag mo'i dbang bka' sgrub thabs dang bcas pa zhus/ bla ma byang sems chen po la dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang*/ dril bu pa sa lugs kyi dbang*/ sbyor ba yan lag drug /chos rje kun spangs pa nas brgyud pa yongs su rdzogs pa khrid bka' dang bcas pa/ nā ro pa'i gzer lnga/ rje karma pa nas brgyud pa'i chos drug /gur mgon lcam dral gyi rjes gnang*/ dzam lha dmar po rnams zhus/ grub thob ring mo las gsal sgron bzhi/ dus zhabs snyan brgyud/ gzhan yang sbyor drug gi gdams phran kha yar zhus/ bla ma mkhas btsun bsod nams 'od zer la/ grub chen pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi gdams phran gcig gnyis zhus/ slob dpon ting 'dzin bzang po la/ snyan brgyud jo mo lugs dang*/ gdams phran kha yar zhus/ bla ma rin 'dab pa la/ nyams khrid bdud rtsi thigs pa zhus/ bla ma lo tsā ba blo brtan la thub pa'i dgongs rgyan/ sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig /gzhan yang gdams phran gcig gnyis zhus/ bla ma snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub la/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dbang*/

bla ma pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'i dus 'khor gyi 'grel pa/ bla ma u rgyan pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi 'grel pa zhal gdams dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gdams phran mang du zhus/ mkhan chen gzhon byang pa la/ sman lha'i mdo sgrub/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i rnam 'joms/ sgrol ma rtogs pa gcig rgyud/ blo sbyong gi gdams pa rnams zhus/ slob dpon bkra shis rin chen pa la dge slong gi gdams tshigs gsan/ mtshur phu'i slob dpon tshul rin pa la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bam̐ bskyed ma las tshogs dang bcas pa/ dgyes rdor rngog lugs/ bde mchog snyan brgyud/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod gnyal sde lugs/ ma hā mā yā/ rnam sras kyi rjes gnang sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ dud sol lha mo'i sgrub thabs/ gzhan yang mes rngog nas brgyud pa'i chos skor mang du zhus/ bla ma dpal ri ba chen po la nā ro mkha' spyod ma dbang ka sgrub thabs dang bcas pa/ tshe dpag med ras chung lugs zhus/ mtshur phu'i slob dpon bsod nams seng ge la rje dus gsum mkhyen pa nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog lha lnga/ dgyes rdor lha lnga/ phag mo lha lnga/ rta mgrin lha lnga/ sgrol ma lha lnga/ dbang sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa/ phag mo dpyal gyi gzhung sgrub rab gnas kyi skor/ gzhan yang lag len skor kha yar zhus/ slob dpon rin chen grags la lha mo sna tshogs yum gyi thor srung zhig zhus/ slob dpon dbu ma pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan la/ bde dgyes gnyis dang*/ ngan song sbyong rgyud kun rig lag len gyi skor/ dbu ma'i chos skor kha yar zhus/ skyor mo lung pa'i mkhan chen dbang she la/ rnam sras kyi rgyud yid bzhin nor bu sgrub thabs lag len dang bcas pa zhus gsungs/ chos zhus tshul 'di rnams gsan yig chen mo phyag dpe'i gseb du sku 'bum nang du bzhugs tshar bas yongs su rdzogs par ma tshang na'ang*/ zhal nas gsungs pa blo la yod pa rnams bkod ces 'byung*/

de nas thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ bdag 'dzin gyi dgon pa yang mi 'dzin/ ri khrod gangs dben du dge sbyor ci 'phel byed dgos snyam na'ang*/ spre'u lo la chos rje rin po che pho brang chen por 'byon pa'i dus su mtshur phu'i gzims chung du nged kyi lag mgo la drung gi phyag gis bzung ste/ da khyed kyis dgon pa cig thob la khrid thob/ khrid ma btab na dam tshig med gsung pas/ da bla ma'i gsung bcag na mi nyan bsam pa dang*/ sgom chen kha yar la phan pa byung na bsam nas/ gnas nang gi ri khrod 'debs pa'i 'dun pa btang ste/ rta 'ug tu dgun zhig bsgoms pa'i dus su/ nub cig rmi lam na chos skyong ber nag can sha ra'i ri la sa 'ja' li byas pa gcig gi shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ste/ ri khrod 'debs pa la bar chad byed pa'i mi ma yin rnams ri dgas kyi gzugs 'dra ba mang po rlung gis ded nas song ba byung*/ de nas gzims khang 'debs sa gang bzang bsam pa'i dus su rmi lam na chos skyong mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa mang po gzim khang 'og ma btab sa der bzhugs pa dang*/ khal phog pa'i snang ba byung*/ da 'dir btab na dga' bar 'dug snyam nas/ btab pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin gsungs/ de nas bya lo zla ba dang po la gzim khang gi rmang ris byas pa'i nyin par*/ yon bdag dbang phyug bsam 'grub kyis nas bre gang khyer byung nas/ 'di la byin rlabs mdzad nas sa gzhi la rab gnas mdzad par zhu zer/ yang byis pa zhig byung ba la khyod kyi ming ci yin byas pas/ don 'grub bya ba yin zer/ yang mi gcig gis tshogs mchod khyer byung ba la/ khyed kyi ming ci yin byas pas gzhon nu bsam 'grub bya ba yin zer/ da ri khrod legs par 'grub par 'dug /rten 'brel bzang dgongs pa byung*/ de'i nyin par bya rgod mang po lding zhing bskor ba byed pa byung*/ de ring gi bya rgod 'di rnams mkha' 'gro'i sprul pa yin par 'dug gsungs te/

dgung lo lnga bcu la gnas nang gi ri khrod btab/ de dus nub cig gi rmi lam na yul de'i gzhi bdag rnams kyis dmag byas byung ba la/ nyid chos skyong ber nag can dngos yin snyam pa byung nas/ ded pas btsan rgya bo zhig zin nas 'di bsgral dgos bsam tsa na/ kho na re/ nga bsad na yul 'dir yams nad chen po yong*/ da nged rnams kyis tshogs mchod 'dren pa dang*/ mkhar lan gyi grogs dang yon bdag byed pa yin zer/ gzhi bdag de rta 'ug gi brag dmar gyi klu btsan de yin par 'dug /de dus tshogs mchod sbrel ma zla ba gcig tsam gyi bar du byung*/ de nas gnas der dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi grwa pa 'tshogs/ zas nor chos gsum char ltar du bab/ de dus sku khams cung zad ma bde ba la/ ri khrod pa la shog dang gsungs/ rang re khams bde bar yong bar 'dug gsungs/ de ci lags zhus pas/ de ring re sdings kyi thad ka'i mdun gyi nam mkha' 'di la rje btsun ma nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yu rdog gis spras pa mthong*/ rje btsun ma 'di rgyan bzang ba'i dus rang re khams bzang ba zhig yod gsungs/ yang de rting pad+ma'i sdong po zhig gi steng na/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med gsal ba zhig byung gsungs pas/ sku khams bde ba la tshegs ma byung*/

de nas gnas der mtshams dam par byas te/ dge sbyor gyis dus 'da' bar byas/ dbyar bzhugs dgun bzhugs kyi dus su bla ma gnyis kyis zhal ta byon pa'i lugs bzhin/ rje nā ro pa'i chos drug dang*/ zab lam sbyor ba yan lag drug gis thog drangs pa'i khrid ka mang du byas pas/ tshogs pa yang drug brgya re tsam byung ba la/ gzhan rnams la yang chos khrims dam du bcas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas btsun mang po yang 'tshogs/ sgom chen nyams rtogs dang ldan pa dang*/ sgrub tshugs can yang mang du thon/ yang de dus gdams ngag bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang*/ stong nyid snying rje'i rtsal sbyangs te/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i gsol 'debs drag tu byas pas/ rje btsun ma yang yang zhal mthong gnas lugs kyi don la bogs khyad par can thon/ gzim khang 'og na bzhugs dus/ tsha ba'i gral du 'dang rmi lam na shar phyogs nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po zhig shar byung ba la/ gza' ral pa can gnyis kyis bzung ba zhig rmis/ de ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar tshud pa yin las che gsungs/ de dang dus mtshungs su mgur bzhengs pa ni/ lhan skyes phyag rgya chen po 'di// rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' dang bral// bden rdzun gnyis su grub pa med// 'di don rtogs pas the tshom zad// ces gsungs/ de dus sku lus kyi srin bu thams cad chad khams 'dzag pa med par gyur/ mun pa'i nang du+u bzhugs kyang sku lus zla ba ltar dkar ba dang snub pa/ dri bzang pos gzim khang khyab par gyur/ de dang dus mnyam du dmen dor pa'i sgom chen mgon po dpal zer ba zhig gis rin po che pa tshogs gral du rje btsun ma sku mdog nag mo zhig tu mthong ba byung*/ phyis sgom chen pa de dge sbyor bzang po dang*/ shi ba'i tshe nam mkha' dngas pa dang*/ phung po la 'ja' zug pa byung*/ yang gzim khang 'og ma na bzhugs dus lan cig sku khams bsnyung ba la grwa pa rnams kyis gsol 'debs drag tu byas/

de dus rin po che pa nyid kyi nyams snang la/ gzim khang 'di rgya je che je che la song bas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dpag tu med pa zhig tu song*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs 'dug /zhing khams 'di gang yin dris pas/ pad+ma can gyi zhing khams yin zer ba byung*/ yang de nub bsnyun pa'i zug la ting nge 'dzin gtad pas/ mi dkar po zhig gis stong pa nyid bco brgyad 'bum nas gsungs pa bzhin du klog pas/ gnyid sad pa dang phal cher ma brjed par 'dug gsungs/ yang de dus rmi lam na dmyal ba'i sems can mthong bas/ de rnams la tshad med pa'i snying rje bzod glags med pa skyes nas/ de rnams 'don dgongs pa la/ dmyal srung zhig na re/ sems can rang rang gi las la spyod pa la khyod ci byed zer ba'i 'phro la gnyid sad nas spyan chab mang po byung gsungs/ yang nyin cig gzhan gyis lta ba la khams zi ba 'dra ba zhig byung ba la/ nga rang gi nyams snang la rje btsun ma sgrol mas lam sna byas te/ 'ja' tshon gyi lam la po ta lar phyin pa'i snang ba byung*/ gnas de rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ bar bar thams cad rin po che'i mchod rten dril bu g.yer khas brgyan pa mang po 'dug /dril bu'i sgra de theg pa chen po'i chos gyi sgra 'ba' zhig tu gsan/ der rje btsun ma sgrol ma dang sngar gyi bla ma rnams bzhugs 'dug pas/ nga rang yang 'dir bsdad dgos snyam tsa na/ rje btsun ma'i gsungs nas/ da lan khyod phar song*/ da bzod yong pa'i dus su rol mo dang bsu pa 'di las mang pa byed pa yin gsungs nas/ bar du yol ba zhig btang nas/ rje btsun ma gnyis kyis 'ja'i lam la 'dir bskyal ba'i 'phro la/ mi dkar po zhig gis bdud rtsi'i bum pas khrus byas pa'i snang ba byung ba la/ tshogs su dge 'dun rnams kyis rim gro'i chos ston pa'i sgra des gnyid sad pa bzhin tu byung dus/

mi ma yin 'ga' zhig gis bar chad byed par 'dug nas/ nga bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dngos su gyur nas/ zhabs g.yas g.yon bca' ra'i rgyab ri dang mdun ri la bzhag ste/ phyag na gnam lcags kyi phur bu me rab tu 'bar ba zhig thogs te/ rta skad 'tsher zhing gar byas pas mi ma yin thams cad byer nas song*/ gzhan rtsa na yod pa rnams la gar byed pa'i snang ba byung 'dug /de nas sku khams dngas pa la tshegs ma byung gsungs/ de nas yang gzim khang gong mar yos bu lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nub cig gi tho rangs kyi cha la rmi lam na/ drung chos rje sku la dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa zhig byon nas/ nga la pho brang du bar chad byung dga' ldan du 'gro ba yin gsungs/ da sku gshegs pa yin nam snyam nas phyag gis na bza' la 'jus pas 'ja' bzhin du yal nas song*/ der rmi lam du blo ma bde nas mchi ma mang po byung 'dug pa'i 'phro la gnyid sad gsungs/ de nas thugs ma bde nas yun ring po'i bar du mnyam bzhag mdzad cing gzigs pas/ nub cig 'od gsal gyi ngang du tshen dben la sogs pa'i rta pa mang po yong gin 'dug na'ang*/ drung nas mi bzhugs par gdung de gdan drangs nas/ gsag thang chen po zhig gi dkyil na yar yong gin 'dug gzhan rnams la bshad kyang bden par mi 'dzin pa dang*/ sems mi bde bar 'dug pas ma bshad pa yin gsungs/ de dus rin po che karma pa'i ma 'ongs lung bstan rtags sku la bkod pa'i lugs bzhin dbu zhwa dmar po nor bu rin po ches spras pa gsol te/ chos rje'i rgyal tshab bzhin du/ sgom chen rnams kyi mgo 'don mdzad cing*/ drung gi gsung nas kyang zhwa dmar can gnyis lung bstan 'dug pa'i gcig rang re yin snyam pa yod gsungs/ yang gzim khang gong mar lan cig ri khrod pa la/ ngas bde mchog lus dkyil 'di phyin ci ma log pa zhig da sgom shes gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/

'dang zhag bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa zhig gi sku la yul sum cu so bdun gyi lha rnams me long du gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin du gsal ba zhig byung gsungs/ yang dgongs ja'i gral zhig tu gzim khang gi nang 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i tham 'gag nam 'gag tu song ba'i gtso bo de/ drung chos rjes byas pa zhig mthong*/ yang gzim khang gong mar nub cig gi rmi lam na/ byang phyogs lcang lo can gyi gnas yin zer ba zhig tu phyin pas de na 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dang rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams bzhugs 'dug gsungs/ yang nub gcig gzim khang gong ma na bzhugs dus rmi lam na/ rje btsun ma mkha' spyod ma dngos yin snyam pa byung nas/ rus rgyan dang ḍā ma ru bsnams te/ u rgyan du phyin pas/ slob ma yang gcig gnyis tsam gyis phyi la sleb yong ba'i snang ba byung*/ zhag bdun tsam gyi bar du ting nge 'dzin 'phel ba dang*/ u rgyan gyi snang ba byung gsungs/ yang lan cig sku khams bsnyung ba la rje btsun ma sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ rje btsun ma rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pas brgyan pa shar lho mtshams su gzigs pa dang*/ nang thams cad dri bzang po'i ngad kyis khyab pa byung*/ ting 'dzin shin tu dngas pa byung ste/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'di skye ba bdun du bar mchod pa'i yi dam yin ngo shes par 'dug gsungs/ yang dus gtor zhig gtong ba'i dus su bu dgon gyi rgyab ri'i rtse mo'i thad ka la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa nam mkha'i khams gang ba tsam zhig la/ 'khor sprin phung 'thibs pa tsam zhal gzigs/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yas pa'i ral gri dang*/ ag tshom las ye shes kyi me dpung dmar 'u ru ru 'bar gin 'dug gsungs/ yang bsod nams bzang po khyod kyis rje btsun ma sgrol ma e mthong gsungs/ ma mthong lags zhus pas/ da lta mdun gyi nam mkha' 'di na rgyan cha lugs dang bcas pa bzhugs 'dug

/khyod dam tshig gtsang bas bshad pa yin gsungs/ yang dbyar zhig rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhal gzigs pa la dang po'i gtso bo de rnam par snang mdzad/ gnyis pa mi bskyod pa/ gsum pa rin chen 'byung ldan/ bzhi pa snang ba mtha' yas/ lnga pa don yod grub pas gtso byas pa la/ gzhan rigs lngas 'khor byas pa/ sku mdog ni gtso bo rnams dang mthun par 'dug gsungs/ de yin pa'i rgyu mtshan 'khor lo lnga'i pho brang du rlung sems kyi dngas ma 'dus pa'i rtags su 'dug gsungs/ yang bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong gis bskor ba gzigs/ de sprul sku'i rtsa gnas su rlung sems 'dus pa'i brdar 'dug de'i rjes la gsang sngags bla med kyi dkyil 'khor mang po gzigs gsungs/ 'di rnams rlung sems dbu mar tshud pa'i brdar 'dug gsungs/ yang byi ba lo la slob dpon g.ya' bzang pa dang mjal dus/ mdangs shar phyogs 'di nas rje btsun ma dang*/ bu mo mdzes ma mang po shon dang glu gar dpag tu med pa byed gin 'dug pa rmis/ khong dam tshig gtsang ba'i rtags su 'dug gsungs/ yang nub cig dga' ldan du byams pa dang mjal/ de na rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams bzhugs 'dug byams pa'i zhal nas bu bde bar 'ongs sam gsungs/ lha'i bu dang bu mo mang po gtad nas 'di rnams la chos ston gsungs pa rmis/ yang nub cig 'dzam bu'i gling gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dga' ldan du 'byon gyin 'dug pa rmis/ ngas kyang ḍā ma ru dang rus rgyan bsnams nas dga' ldan du phyin pa zhig rmis/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das byams pa la mos pa byas pas mi bzang po rnams der 'gro ba yin par 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs/ yang nub cig smar khams smad kyi sa cha zhig na khang pa bzang po zhig byas 'dug pa'i nang na/ chos skyong ber nag can sngar bas chas bzang ba zhig dang*/ mi dkar seng ba gcig dang gnyis 'dug pa la/

ngas de gnyis la mkhar lan 'di la dka' las chen po zhig byas/ nga gcig kyang ma red pa med byas pas/ mi dkar po de na re/ da rung dum pa yod zer/ da gcig kyang med byas/ de nas ngas de gnyis la khams su phyin na 'gro don 'phel lam/ 'dir bsdad na 'gro don 'phel byas pas/ chos skyong na re/ khams su 'gro don 'phel po yong ste/ lam la khag po yong zer/ 'o na 'dir bsdad na 'gro don 'phel lam byas pas/ sku tshe ring po mi yong zer/ ji tsam thub byas pas/ drug cu rtsa drug gam rtsa bdun/ de la bar chad ma byung na brgyad cu/ de la bar chad ma byung na dgu bcu thub zer/ lar rmi lam la tig pa med de/ lo gcig tsam khams bzang por yong gsungs te/ lo gcig sku khams bzang bar byung*/ lar nga khams bzang dus kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal 'di rnams bshad na gzhan gyi blor mi shong gsungs/ gzhan yang yi dam dang chos skyong dang zhing khams gzigs tshul/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi dge mi dge dang gzhan gyi sems shes pa la sogs mang du gsungs te/ mdor bsdus tsam yi ger bkod ces 'byung*/ bla ma rin po che nyid kyis 'od gsal dang ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang nas srid pa bar do'i lus gzigs tshul ni/ bde chen na bzhugs pa'i dus nang par tho rangs 'od gsal gyi ngang nas gsang phu ba'i khams pa dge bshes phar tshad gnyis shes pa zhig yod pa de/ spyil po'i nang du rgyang ste byung*/ 'di mtshams khang du yong ba ci yin snyam pa la/ de ma thag tu bar do'i rnam shes yin par ngo shes nas/ kho'i rnam shes de ting nge 'dzin gyis bzung nas/ chos bshad dang gdams pa btab pas/ kho na re/ khyed nga ma bzung nga las kyi dbang gis skad cig kyang sdod sa med zer/ da 'o na khyod rang yang phar phyin la sogs pa shes pa yin mod/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon po yid la gyis/ ngas kyang ting nge 'dzin gtad byas pa yin te/ sngar bal yul du tshong la phyin pa'i bag chags kyis bal po phyogs la song pa 'dra ba zhig byung gsungs/

yang phug mo cher bsgom pa'i dus su/ sgom chen rgyal mtshan dpal bya ba shi nas/ rnam shes nga'i thugs kar 'pho nus pa byung*/ ngas gdams ngag btab pas gnam stod kyis char mi lus zhig thob gsungs/ yang gnas nang du gnyan gog pa'i pha jo dgos rin pa'i dus su/ ngas pha jo de la phan thogs par yod pa gsungs/ de ci lags zhus pas/ mdangs pa mtshur phu'i sku 'bum gnyis po'i steng na rus rgyan dang ḍā' ma ru dang bcas nas gar byed cing ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong gin 'dug pa'i dus su*/ mi rgad po ral pa can zhig gis nga'i rkang pa la reg reg pa zhig byung gsungs/ de kho shi khar nga la mos pa'i rten 'brel du 'dug gsungs/ yang gzim khang gong ma na bzhugs dus bye lung pa'i dge slong rin bla gum pas kho'i rnam shes nga'i rtsar byung*/ ngas 'chi dus bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang ma bral bar byas zer/ de'i rten 'brel gyis gnam smad kyi sa char bu zhig tu skyes gsungs/ pak+shi rgyal mtshan 'bum gyi bu/ 'bum skyabs de yon bdag bkra shis 'bum gyi skye ba yin par 'dug /mi lus thob pa de 'chi khar nga la dbang bskur zhig thob pa de'i phan yon du 'dug gsungs/ yang gnas nang du yon bdag khro bo 'bum shi dus kho'i rnam shes nga'i rtsa ru byung ba la/ gdams ngag btab pas dga' ba gdong gi mngar mi lus thob snyam pa zhig byung*/ yang khram ras gum dus kho'i rnam shes nga'i rtsar byung ba la khong de dus lam log pa zhig la 'gro la khad 'dug pa la/ ngas chos bshad cing gdams pa btab pas/ khams kyi kho rang gis cha'i khang pa sgo skya tha le ba zhig tu song ste/ mi lus zhig thob snyam pa byung gsungs/ lar de la sogs pa'i bar do'i rnam shes mang du gzigs/ bla ma grub thob chen po de nyid kyis/ zhing khams 'di'i gdul bya 'brel ba can rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod de/ sems can rtag 'dzin can rnams la mi rtag pa ston pa'i phyir dang*/

le lo can rnams brtson 'grus la bskul ba dang*/ chos nyid sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong ba dang*/ sems can smin grol mdzad pa'i ched du/ rdo rje'i sku la 'das grongs mi mnga' na yang*/ glang lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes lnga drug nas sku khams cung zad ma bde ba'i tshul bstan/ bu slob rnams kyis kyang gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ sku'i rim gro zhag nyi shu tsam gyi bar du rgyun ma chad par byas/ slob dpon g.ya' bzang ba la sogs pa'i sman pa mkhas pas kyang gso dpyad mang du byas na yang*/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi gdul bya rnams skal pa dman pa la brten nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan khar ri khrod pa sogs bu slob rgan pa kha yar dang*/ nye gnas gnyis la sogs pa rnams la zhal ta byon pa ni/ rang re yang sngar gyi rmi ltas la sku tshe 'di las ring tsam thub snyam pa yod na'ang*/ da lan nad bu 'dis gtugs byung bas/ e thon yang mi shes par 'dug pas/ gal te gshegs na gshegs khar gzhan gyi gsol 'debs dgos pa de nga min/ pur la dbang bskur dang cho ga bdun tshigs dgos pa de nga min/ pur 'di la zhag gsum du ma reg par cam me zhog /de nas pur chas legs po zhig gyis/ dar dmar po'i na bza' zhig gsol/ /de'i steng du rus rgyan gsol la khri'i steng du bzhugs su chug la/ khyed dam tshig gtsang ba bcu lhag cig gis mchod pa phul la gsol ba thob/ nga dag pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro ba yin pas mya ngan dang ngu 'bod ma byed par nyin mtshan med par bla ma la gsol ba thob/ skye med kyi ngang du 'gag med kyi rtsal sbyong gyis thams cad 'chi ba min pa 'gro sa med pa yin pas/ da phyin chad slob dpon dge slong la nga ji ltar 'khur ba bzhin khur/ khyed rnams ri khrod 'dir sdod la/ rab rnams kyis mtshams lo gsum gsum gyis/ 'bring rnams kyis ri mi 'bab lo gsum gsum gyis/ tha ma rnams kyis kyang dbyar bzhugs dgun bzhugs ma chag par gyis la dge sbyor la 'bungs/

de ltar byas na bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa yin/ pha la bu skyes pa yin gsungs/ nga'i pur 'di yang ma bzhu bar gzim khang 'og ma'i nub phyogs su mchod khang ka bzhi ma zhig gi nang du/ dngul gyi 'bum pa chung ngu zhig gyis la de'i bum pa'i nang du bzhugs la zhal shar du ston/ dar dmar po'i na bza'i steng du rus rgyan gsol/ mdun du dam tshig gi rdo rje dril bu ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba dang ḍā ma ru/ sham bu'i thad kar mkha' spyod ma'i sku bzhugs/ de'i rten 'brel ni smar khams smad la sogs pa'i sa cha dben pa zhig tu phyin nas sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byas na/ skye ba 'di la mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob pa yi dam lha'i lung bstan pa yod pa yin te/ da lan bar chad cig byung bas de'i thog tu ma song na'ang*/ bar dor mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob nges par 'dug pas de bzhin gyis/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob pa'i gang zag de dang 'brel tshad don ldan du 'gro ba yin gsungs/

gzhan yang thugs dam gyi rten dang phyag dpe rnams bzhugs su chug /sku 'bum de yang gang gis mthong ba dang*/ thos pa dang*/ mos pa thams cad ngas 'dren pa'i smon lam btab yod pa yin/ gzhan phyi rten nang rten la sogs pa gang yang ma bzhengs/ gal te bzhengs na dam tshig med gsungs/ phyag rdzas kyi dngos po dam dum yod pa 'di rnams la tshogs gal che bas gyis/ ngas zhal ta byas pa 'di rnams byas na shul du dag bar 'dug cing*/ nga rang dngos bzhugs pa dang 'dra gsungs/ gzhan yang de dus drung na yod pa rnams kyis thugs dam gyi ltas ji 'dra gda' zhus pas/ mdangs zhag sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po jo bo'i sku tshad tsam zhig la sman bla dpag tu med pas bskor ba zhig gziḍa gsungs/ yang nyin cig shar phyogs 'di na 'od dkar po zhig byung ba dang*/ de'i mod la de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus tham 'gag nam 'gag tu song gsungs/ yang de'i rjes la ngas ri dkar po zhig gi rtse mor phyin pa dang*/ de na rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang zhig 'dug / de'i nang du phyin pa dang bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon po dang*/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams bzhugs 'dug gsungs/ yang de ring sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas rnams gzigs gsungs// yang de'i rjes la nub cig rmi lam na/ tshe dpag med gtso bo gnyis 'gyur tsam zhig la tshe dpag med bsam gyis mi khyab bas bskor ba zhig gzigs gsungs/ de la sogs pa rje btsun ma sgrol ma dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong bsam gyis mi khyab pa gzigs pa thams cad shin tu rgyan bzang bar 'dug /sngar yid dam chos skyong rnams rgyan bzang na khams bzang ba zhig yod pa yin te/ da lan rgyan bzang ba 'di 'chi khar phyin pa'i bsu bar 'dug gsungs/ de dus zla ba gcig tsam gyi bar du nam mkha' la 'ja' kha dog lnga rgyun ma chad par byung*/ 'ja' tshon 'di rnams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'od zer du 'dug gsungs/

gzhan yang sgra dang sa g.yo ba la sogs pa dang phyi na yod pa rnams kyis kyang dri bzang po'i ngad kun gyis tshor ba dang*/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ngo*// yang de'i rjes su dgongs ja kha tsam na da 'chi khar phyin pas nyams dga'/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'thib 'thib byon phyag rgya chen po nam mkha' ltar song gsungs/ yang de'i rjes tho rangs kyi cha la sleb pa dang*/ spyan bar snang la hrig ge gzigs nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar byon gsungs/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi thang sku dang*/ mkha' spyod ma'i thang sku gnyis zhal kheb sol mchod pa zhig shoms gsungs/ de nas dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun la 'byung ba 'khrugs pa la sogs pa'i skyon gyis gnod pa med par sa mo glang gi lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyi ma shar dros tsam la sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor bsdus te chos kyi dbyings su gshegs so// de nas bu slob rnams kyis sngar gyi zhal ta 'byon pa'i lugs bzhin du gdung gi drung du mos gus rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas mchod pa bshams shing gsol ba btab/ nyi shu gsum gyi nyin par gdung 'dab byas dus/ nam mkha' shin tu dngas pa la 'ja' kha dog sna lnga yod pa'i nang nas me tog gi char pa 'dab ma lnga pa dang brgyad pa la sogs kha dog sna tshogs pa bab pa gral na yod pa thams cad kyis mthong bar gyur/ gzhan yang ting nge 'dzin yod pa rnams de dus lhag par dngas pa dang*/ med pa rnams la'ang dge sbyor skyes pa byung*/ de nas zla ba gcig gi bar du gdung la gsol ba btab pa la/ de dus zla ba bzhi pa'i tshad pa'i sgang yin kyang pur la dri nga ba'i skyon med par dri bzang po'i ngad dang bcas te/ sku sha'i mdog ma 'gyur bar kun gyis mthong bas ya mtshan du gyur/ de nas zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin par dpal ldan 'bras spungs gser gyi mchod rten nor bu rin po ches spras pa'i nang du pur gdan drangs te bzhugs pa'i dus su/
