nam mkha' la 'ja' kha dog lnga pa dar 'then pa 'dra ba dang*/ 'od chen po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba 'dra ba nam mkha' khengs pa dang*/ de dus sgom chen zhig gis gsol ba btab pas/ sku 'bum gyi nang na rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i snying po di ri ri grags pa thos pa byung*/ gzhan yang ltas khyad par can mang du byung*/ de nas zla ba gcig dang zhag nyi shu'i bar du mchod pa rgyun ma chad par phul/ gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu la bu slob bzang ba rnams 'tshogs te/ rab tu gnas pa byas pa'i dus su/ snang ba dag pa rnams kyis rin po che pa'i sku mthong ba dang*/ ḍā' ma ru'i sgra thos pa dang*/ la las nam mkha' las 'od byung ste/ sku 'bum la thim pa mthong ba la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung ngo*/ /gser gyi mchod rten chen po de yang gang gis mthong ba thams cad snang ba 'gyur ba dang*/ mos gus can rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i dus su dge sbyor khyad par can shar ba dang*/ de la sogs pa'i byin rlabs dang ldan par gyur to// bla ma rin po che pa nyid zhing khams gang du bzhud zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon po'i drung na/ sngar gyi dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams bzhugs 'dug pas/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa la chos zhu ba dang*/ bla ma gong ma rnams la mjal ba dang*/ sngar gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis der 'gro ba yin/ khyed rnams kyang der smon lam thob gsungs/ der bcom ldan 'das byams pa mgon po mnyes par byed cing*/ ting nge 'dzin rtsal sbyong pa dang*/ lha'i tshogs rnams la chos ston pa yin gsungs/ de'i rjes su shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams na bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i drung du/ de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad nas ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal sbyong pa yin gsungs/ de nas bzung ste skyes rabs thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams sbyong zhing*/

gdul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god pa yin gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ deng nas bzung ste sangs rgyas ma thob bar// 'jam dpal dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs la sogs// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// 'gro ba ma lus 'dren pa'i bla mar shog/ ces gsungs pas so// de ltar chos kyi rje grags pa seng ge'i rnam par thar pa 'di ni/ rje nyid kyi slob ma'i thu bo ri khrod pa dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis rje gshegs pa'i lo de nyid la gnas nang du mdzad pa'i rnam thar nyid bar skabs kyi tshig sna cung zad bsdus pa las/ 'di tsho bla ma'i gsung sgros gyu ru lugs yin pas gzhan gyis bcos slad ma byed gsung ba 'dug pa bzhin bcos slad med par sor bzhag tu bris pa'o// // ༈¿¿rje 'di la slob ma'i tshogs kyang mang du byung mod kyi phal cher rje rang byung ba dang dpon slob thun mong gi slob ma yin la/ de las mchog bzhir grags pa ni/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba/ 'jam dbyangs chos rdo rab/ g.yag sde pan chen/ mkhas grub dar rgyal ba rnams so// ༈¿¿rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs pa rtogs ldan bsam gtan rin chen ni/ bu chen rnams kyi nang nas rtogs pa mtho bar grags shing rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ nga bas lhag pa bsam rin yin/ /ces gsungs pa'i lo rgyus kyang 'dug /thang lha'i lha phur bzhugs nas rim gnyis kyi thugs dam la gzhol ba'i skabs su gtum mo'i drod kyis gangs kyi rtse zhu ste thang lhas bdag gi gnas mi gzhig par zhu zhes gnas gzhan phul zhing rang gzhan gyi rtsa rlung thig le thams cad gzigs/ sngags kyi phyag len zin bris kyang 'ga' zhig mdzad/ gnas de nyid du phyi rabs la dgongs pa'i rten ngo mtshar can bzhag nas mya ngan 'das zhes grags/ ༈¿¿rgyal ba ri khrod dar ma rgyal mtshan ni/ thang lha'i nye logs su yab bsod nams mgon dang*/ yum bkra shis kyi ming can gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs te/

yum gyi rmi lam du rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa gcer bu dar dkar gyi ang ga rag dang cod pan can gser gyi rna rgyan dang ldan pa/ thod pa bdud rtsis bkang bas phyag mtshan pa zhig bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa lnga brgya tsam gyis bskor nas gan du byon nas dbang bskur chos bstan/ rdzu 'phrul kyang bstan nas 'khor rnams gcig la gcig thim ste mthar rnal 'byor pa gcig pur gyur nas rang gi smin mtshams su thim pa rmis pas nyams bzang po rkyen gyis mi gnod pa zhag bdun du byung zhing*/ gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung*/ sku gzhon nu nyid nas dad pa dang snying rje che ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten la dga' ba/ dge 'dun la gus pa/ rang sdig pa mi spyod par ma zad gzhan byed pa mthong na'ang bzod glags med pas bzlog par mdzad pa la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa zhig go/ dgung lo drug bdun la yig klog la mkhas par gyur/ yum rgyas 'bring la sogs gzigs pas tshig dang don rtags rim par thugs la byon/ bla ma rmug sangs rin chen bla ma la sogs bsten/ nyin cig byis pa zla bo du ma dang bcas nas me tog 'thu zhing rtsed mo la byon pas lus brdabs te/ bsnad pa'i sdug bsngal gyis rkyen byas nas skyabs sangs rgyas kho nar nges pa'i nges pa shes pas sangs rgyas la skyabs su song zhing tshe rabs dran pa'i skyo ba skyes/ glu blangs pas la la dag ngo mtshar du 'dzin zhing*/ la la dag gdon gyis byin gyis brlabs par 'dzin/ de dang nye bar chos rje rang byung rdo rje dang mjal bas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su mthong*/ dad pa drag po skyes nas phyags phyir bde chen steng du byon/ chos rjes mkhan po dang*/ mkhan chen gzhon nu byang chub pas slob dpon mdzad de/ dgung lo bcu dgu la rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ snye mdo ba kun dga' don 'grub/ bla ma tshul rin/ chos rje grags pa seng ge/

rgya brag chos rje/ mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod rin/ byang chub mgon po/ bsod nams seng ge la sogs pa'i mkhas pa dang grub pa dang*/ btsun pa'i bla ma mang du bsten nas mdo rgyud bstan bcos du ma'i gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ khyad par man ngag gtso bor mdzad nas sgrub pa la thugs gzhol bar mdzad nas/ ri khrod dben pa rnams su g.yeng ba rnam par bcad nas bsgoms pas thams cad kyang gus par gyur/ dbu sngas la mi 'jog pa/ rgyab stan la mi brten pa/ chu dang rdo'i dka' thub/ rlung sbyor zab mos dus 'da' ba rnams kyis bsgrub pas nyams myong mang du skyes/ khyad par rtsub nyams kyis shig nad drag po lo gsum/ thugs rlung lo gnyis/ 'dzag gegs lo gcig rnams byung ba la thugs dam kho nas nyams de dag las grol nas nyams rtogs mchog tu gyur pa 'khrungs/ rang nyid mi g.yo ba dang*/ gshin rje gshed dang*/ rnam 'joms la sogs par gsal bas bgegs btul ba dang*/ mgon pos pus mo btsugs te phrin las sgrub par khas len pa dang*/ tshe dpag med dang shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i dag pa'i snang ba mang po dang gzhan dag gi yul dang rigs dang spyod pa dang sems kyi rnam 'gyur rnams me long la shar ba bzhin gsal bar gzigs pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal phun sum tshogs pa la 'bad pa med par rang nyams su spyod pa dang*/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje dang rin po che zang zang ne rings pa dri mol mdzad pa na sa ra har gzigs pa dang*/ bde mchog gi dbang zhus pa'i tshe he ru ka rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang bcas par gzigs pa dang*/ snye mdo ba la zhi byed brgyud pa phyi ma gsan dus dam pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba gzigs pa dang*/ rtogs ldan ye gzhon pa la sems bskyed zhus pas smra seng du gzigs pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod/ thang lha'i ri khrod la sogs su'ang yun ring du bzhugs/

de nas phug mo che'i ri khrod du/ chos rje grags pa seng ge'i zhabs la gtugs/ phyags phyir 'brangs/ grub thob chu sgom gyi bzhugs gnas bde chen steng*/ gnas nang la sogs su phyags phyir 'brangs te/ bsnyen sgrub dang*/ snying thig dang*/ mkha' spyod bsnyen sgrub la sogs pa'i gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan/ rnal lam gyi rtsal 'byangs nas/ u rgyan zhag re la theng bcu gsum tsam gzigs nus pa la sogs pa brjod pa las 'das par gyur/ zab mo'i dbang zhus pa'i tshe/ bla ma lhag pa'i lhar gzigs/ gnyan khrod kyang mang du 'grim nas/ cho 'phrul du ma snang ba rnams kyang rtogs pas zil gyis mnan to// chos rje grags seng ba la slob ma mang yang*/ ri khrod pa 'di nyid brgyud 'dzin gyi sras dam par gzigs nas/ man ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang*/ gnas nang gi gdan sar bskos/ 'gro don skyongs shig par gdams pa la brten nas/ nā ro'i chos drug dang*/ sbyor drug la sogs pas gdul bya yang dag par bskyangs te/ smin grol la bkod/ byams snying rje stobs rgyas pas/ sdug phongs dang*/ nad pa dang*/ snyigs dus kyi skye bo log par spyod pa rnams la lhag par phan 'dogs par mdzad/ phyis mya ngan las 'da' bar nye ba na/ nga dang po na so gzhon dus brtson 'grus drag pos lus srog chos phyogs su btang pas/ tshe stod la dka' thub dang sgrub pa dang du blangs pas/ gegs skyon mang du byung na'ang*/ thabs gzhan ma btsal bar dge sbyor gcig pus bsal/ nyams rtogs yon tan gyi cha yang ci rigs skyes/ mi tshe bya bral la bskyal/ sgrub pa kho na mthar son nas/ tshe 'di phyi'i bar lag 'gyel ba zhig bya bsam na'ang*/ bla mas 'gro don gyis shig par gdams/ gsung bcag par ma spobs/ 'on kyang bla ma'i bka' bsgrubs pas 'gyod pa med/ blo bde tshe yang 'di tsam thub bsam pa med de bla ma'i phyag phreng gi rten 'brel zhig mthong ba de'i steng du song*/

mi yul du yang yun ring po song*/ sems can la phan pa'ang en tsam byas/ da ni bde ba can du tshe dpag med kyi drung du the tshom dang*/ soms nyi med gsung pa la sogs pa'i zhal ta mang du gnang*/ glang lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyer gsum gyi tho rangs gshegs/ gdung sbyangs pas sku dang*/ ring srel dang*/ yig 'bru dang*/ phyag mtshan sogs dpag tu med pa byon/ me tog gi char bab bo/ /sku skye ba snga ma zhig lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du tshong pa'i rigs kyi rnal 'byor par 'khrungs/ brag gser gyi bya skyibs can du/ in+d+ra bud+dhi tha ma'i slob ma kam+pa las rjes su bzung bar bzhed do// ༈¿¿mkhas grub dar rgyal ba'i rjes su gnas nang gi gdan sa rtogs ldan ye shes dpal gyis bskyangs shing*/ de rjes dam pa de gnyis ka'i slob ma bla ma bsod nams 'bum gyis sku tshe hril por gdan sa bskyangs pas bstan pa'i zhabs tog dang phrin las che bar byung ngo*// ༈¿¿la stod pa chung ba rtogs ldan mgon po rgyal mtshan ni/ thugs dam spang rtogs kyi rtsal rdzogs nas/ kong por nags mda'i dgon pa bzung*/ der gzhan phan gyi phrin las zla med pa byung*/ bka' brgyud kyi chos skor phal mo che thams cad mkhyen pa rol pa'i rdo rje la phul nas brgyud pa 'dir bka' drin mchog tu gyur/ phyis dgon pa de nyid du gshegs par grags/

༈¿¿khu yor rtogs ldan gyis tshur rin chen gling du bzhugs nas dgon pa bskyangs/ ༈¿¿shwa sgom gyi sprul pa rtogs ldan khrag skyugs ni/ rkyen drag po la thog 'gel nus pa'i snying stobs can/ sog zam kha'i dge bsnyen dngos su khrid pa sogs kyi brtul zhugs can grub thob rtsod med du grags/ phyis nags phu'i gdan sa mdzad cing*/ 'dis dbon brgyud rnams kyis rim par bzung*/ nyang kong brag gsum gyi chos sde phal cher gyi bdag gnyer byed pa byung*/ ༈¿¿rtogs ldan kre bo ni/ mngon shes dang ldan pa zhig ste/ dbus gtsang gi mtshams kyi lam 'phrang du bzhugs nas/ gtsang na byang sems zla rgyal gyi skye ba rgyal sras thogs med pa sogs bzhugs pa la zhal mjal gyis/ zhes 'grul pa rnams la bskul ma mdzad par grags/ ༈¿¿hor rtogs ldan ni/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dus dus su 'tsho ba 'dren pa la dngos su longs spyod pa'i ngo mtshar can zhig yod par grags/ ༈¿¿rdza ras byang chub rin chen ni/ bde chen gyi rdza khrod nas lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs/ ༈¿¿rdza ras gcig lho rgyud du byon nas mi ma yin gdug pa can btul bar grags/ ༈¿¿rtogs ldan ye rgyal ba ni/ nyams rtogs kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan zhing*/ nyang kong brag gsum du phrin las che/ slob ma rtogs ldan 'ga' zhig tshar/ ༈¿¿lha gzher rtogs ldan dbang phyug bzang po ni/ rtogs ldan rtsod med du grags shing*/ de'i slob brgyud la lha gzher gyi ban sgar rnams byung ngo*// ༈¿¿rtogs ldan mgon po ye shes ni/ sgo mo ba skyes mchog chos rje'i slob ma ste/ spyir bla ma brgyar nye ba zhig bsten/ gdams ngag mang po'i bang mdzod du gyur/ rje rang byung zhabs las mkha' 'gro snying thig sogs kyi chos ka rnams gsan/ 'bri gung stag lung ba rwa sgreng ba la sogs pa'i chen po mang po'i bla mar gyur pa zhig go/ ༈¿¿nye gnas rngad mda' ba ye shes rgyal mtshan ni/

sog tsan+dan dgon du bzhugs shing*/ rdzogs chen snying thig gi bstan pa spel bar mdzad/ ༈¿¿stag zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan ni/ stag tsha'i nang tshan ge yag gi bon po'i brgyud yin zhing*/ rje rang byung ba las gdams ngag thob pas rtogs pa khyad par can 'khrungs/ phyis lho rong du sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs/ de nyid la phrin las cher ma byung yang dbon po rnams kyis jo gdan byang chub bzang po la gtugs nas phrin las cher byung zhing dgon pa'ang yod/ ༈¿¿nags mgo rin 'byung ba ni/ rje rang byung zhabs dang*/ bla ma shar pa las dbang khrid rnams gsan te/ lha steng gi mdun ri nags mgor lo mang du sgrub pa mdzad pas gnas de'i ming mtshan du thogs shing*/ ri mag ba yang zer/ thugs dam spang rtogs kyi rtsal cher rdzogs pas/ skye ba brgya phrag dran pa sogs ngo mtshar dpag tu med/ yon bdag rnams kyi ngor chu bar gyi dgon pa btab/ gdams ngag gis bskyangs pas/ rtogs ldan mang du tshar zhing phrin las che bar byung*/ der sku gshegs pa'i rjes su dgon pa khag gnyis su gyes nas gcig lha steng du bsten/ gcig la gong gnas thang du spos nas dgon pa byas zhes grags/ ༈¿¿mkhas pa shes rab rin chen ni/ kong por rje rang byung ba'i zhabs la thug cing phyis lha steng du bzhugs nas rje'i rnam thar mdzad pa po de'o// ༈¿¿rdzogs chen pa tshul blo ni/ dbur stod krogs nang du dgon pa mdzad nas rdzogs chen gyi phrin las cher skyong ba zhig go/ ༈¿¿ldong ston gzhon nu 'bum gyis/ lha steng gi gdan sa mdzad/ dgon pa'i dar rgyas phrin las che bar byung*/ de nas rim bzhin slob brgyud kyis gdan sa bzung bas dge 'dun kyang mang du bzhugs shing*/ phyi mtha'i bar mi nyams pa'i 'dzin spras legs par byung ngo*/ / ༈¿¿spyan snga rdor rin pa ni/ mgon po ber gyi skor la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes par grags/ ༈¿¿zha lu ba che ba dharma pas/

kar shod ba te 'od gsal phug tu bzhugs nas phrin las bskyangs/ ༈¿¿rdza bar ba kun dga' 'od zer gyis/ grā shar dgon btab cing de dang mtshur phur bzhugs nas 'gro don bskyangs/ ༈¿¿mkhan chen gro mo pa ni/ grub thob chen por bzhugs shing*/ slob ma'ang mang du tshar/ khyad par gyi bu chen gnyis las 'gos rtogs ldan gyis gnyag rong du/ 'gom sgang gi dgon pa btab/ rgya bla mas gla li na 'gel tshe dgon pa btab/ dgon de gnyis la phyi mo'i bar du dar rgyas byung bar 'dug/ ༈¿¿bla ma shes rab don grub kyis nang brtag dang*/ chos chung rnams la bshad thabs kyi zin bris mdzad/ ༈¿¿rgyal sras kun dga' byams pa ni/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags thob pa sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan zhing*/ hor rgyal pos gdan drangs/ lung bzang po gnang*/ phrin las che bar byung nas gong du gshegs/ bu slob kyang mang du byung*/ ༈¿¿go shrī kun dga' rgyal po nags phu'i gdan sa mdzad cing*/ rje'i drung gi bstan bcos rnams kho na la/ bshad sgrub lhur blangs/ phrin las rgya chen po byung*/ ༈¿¿tshal pa'i drung chen smon lam rdo rje ni/ rje rang byung zhabs las/ rab byung bsnyen rdzogs mdzad de/ dge ba'i blo gros su mtshan gsol/ /sngon nas rje 'di nyid rtsa ba'i bla mar bzung ste/ lung rtogs kyi rtsal rdzogs/ rab byung mdzad ma thag nas/ dge bshes chen po rnams 'bel gtam gyis zil gyis non/ sku 'khor ba rnams kyis rab byung mdzad ma thag nas/ 'di lta bu'i mkhyen pa ngo mtshar che zhus pas/ 'di 'dra sngon nas shes pa yin gsungs/ 'o na sngon 'bel gtam gtan mi mdzad pa ci lags zhus pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtags kyis che ba yin/ nged rang mi nag pas dge 'dun la chos skad byas na/ dkon mchog la brnyas par 'gro ba yin/ da rtags dang bslab pa mtshungs pa yin pas byas chog pa yin gsungs/ de lta bu'i si tu thams cad mkhyen pa des/

hor yul du phyi ma bzhugs dus phul ba'i zhu yig dngos rje dpa' bos gzigs pa na/ 'di nas thegs kar zla ba re re'i tshes gcig byung ngo cog gi tho rengs/ 'od gsal gyi ngang du byon nas bdag la dbang bskur gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes pa/ de lo gnyis zla ba gnyis gsum gyi bar du zhal bzhes ji lta bar yid shin tu ches par byung*/ de phyin zla ba re gnyis nas gnang ma byung ba bar du mos gus rtsol ba chung pa'ang*/ thugs brtse ma gtad pa'am/ ji ltar lags zhes snang ste/ de lta bu'i dpon slob yod par snang*/ ༈¿¿rgya ston kun dga' brtson 'grus ni/ gzhi sa lugs kyi grub mthar zhugs shing*/ chos rgyun sna tshogs 'dzin pa zhig ste/ dwags po'i slob ma gtsang bzher sgom pa la/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mos thug nas/ dwags po'i chos skor 'ga' zhig gsan pa'i rgyun yang 'di la yod par snang ngo*// ༈¿¿ne ring rin po che shākya mgon po ni/ rje rgod tshang ba'i slob ma ne ring pa bde legs rgyal mtshan gyi dbon po ste/ zang zang ne ring gi dgon pa gdung brgyud kyis bskyangs zhing*/ phrin las che ba zhig go/ ༈¿¿g.yag sde paṇa chen ni/ g.yag sde bye mar yab a mi dkon mchog dpal dang*/ yum skya rgyal chos skyid gnyis kyi sras su sa mo phag la 'khrungs/ bu ston rin po ches lo dgu bzhes pa'i phag de yin/ lo lnga lon pa la 'ban po chos dbang la/ ngan song spyod rgyud thun gcig gsan/ rtogs ldan rin smon dang*/ jo stan dar brtson la klog yig bslabs shing*/ phyis 'dul mngon yang gsan/ mkhan chen chos dpal ba la/ dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung mdzad/ 'dul ba tshar 'ga' gsan/ ras ston bsod nams rin chen la dge tshul mdzad/ 'dul ba'ang gsan/ mkhan chen 'od 'byung dang*/ zha chen rin 'byung la bsnyen par rdzogs/ gsang phu ba blo gros mtshungs med la rnam nges dang*/ byams chos lnga/ spyod 'jug tshad ma bsdus pa/

snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khri shing rnams zhus/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje la/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ phag mo/ bde mchog 'jigs byed/ gdan bzhi rnams kyi dbang*/ sbyor drug nā ro chos drug lhan cig skyes sbyor/ sku gsum ngo sprod rnams kyi khrid/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ brtag gnyis/ do ha/ zab mo'i nang don/ skyes rabs snga phyi gnyis rnams kyi bshad pa/ bsnyen bsgrub/ ras chung snyan brgyud/ bcud len phreng ba la sogs zhus/ 'ban po btsun shākra la/ gnyan lo'i zhal bzhi pa'i skor rnams gsan/ rtogs ldan grags seng ba la/ nā ro pa'i chos drug dang*/ sbyor drug dang*/ lhan skyes jo mo'i byin rlabs dang*/ phyag rdor gtum po ras chung lugs dang*/ gegs sel la sogs mang du zhus/ la stod dbang rgyal la/ sbyor drug dang*/ dbang mdor bstan dang*/ nyi zla sgrub pa dang*/ sbas pa mig 'byed la sogs pa zhus/ rig 'dzin ku mā ra rā dza'i drung du/ rdzogs chen snying thig gi skor rnams zhus/ kun spang chos grags dpal la/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa dang*/ gshed dmar gyi dbang dang*/ rdo rje snying 'grel dang*/ bde mchog stod 'grel dang*/ dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma rnams gsan/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa la/ rdo rje rtse mo dang*/ sa sde lnga dang*/ mngon pa kun las btus pa dang*/ thub pa dgongs rgyan dang*/ snyan ngag me long dang*/ mtshan brjod la sogs pa mang du zhus/ g.yung ston pa la ye shes gsang rdzogs gyi rgyud gdams pa dang bcas pa/ gsang snying dbang dang bcas pa/ a ro'i gdams pa dpung skor dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dbang khrid lung dang bcas pa/ a ro'i rgyud chung gi lung*/ tsa mi 'gyur gyi dus 'khor 'grel gyi lung dbang dang bcas pa/ gshin rje gshed kyi lung*/ mdo dgong 'dus/ sems sde ma bu bco brgyad la sogs pa zhus/ bu ston pa la dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur/ rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa/

gsang 'dus kyi dbang dang*/ man ngag gi khrid/ rgyud kyi bshad pa/ spyod bsdus/ grub pa sde bdun/ phar phyin/ rnam nges rnams dang*/ gshed dmar rdzogs rim sogs mang du gsan/ 'chim blo bzang grags pa la bslab btus dang*/ dbu ma 'jug pa sogs zhus/ kun mkhyen dol po pa la/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa/ mchog dbang*/ sbyor drug gi khrid/ nges don rgya mtsho sogs mang du gsan/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang*/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ lam 'bras la sogs gsan/ spyir bla ma brgya rtsa brgyad bsten zhing*/ la lar chos thun re tsam dang*/ la lar sgrub thabs cha re tsam re/ la lar mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel rgya chen po gsan/ sku tshe'i stod la yo byad srab pa byung ba la/ skyes mchog bsam gtan dpal ba la gdams pa zhur byon pas/ khong gis longs spyod kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pas legs par 'grigs te/ na ning bar nga'i khas skyo po ma rnyed/ da ni skyo pos nga'i kha mi rnyed par 'dug gsungs/ de ltar rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas/ e wam̐ gyi dgon pa btab/ mngon par shes pa dang ldan pas gzhan don rgya cher mdzad/ slob ma'ang mkhas shing zab mo'i thugs dam la mnga' brnyes pa/ ri khrod pa mgon po ye shes dang*/ gdan sa ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs chos mgon pa dang*/ mkhas grub byang chub rgyal mtshan dang*/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas blo gros pa la sogs pa mang du byon zhing*/ nyin cig chos thun re tsam gsan pa rnams la kha zas dang*/ gnang sbyin la sogs pa'i sgo nas rten 'brel bsgrigs pas/ 'gro ba mang po la phan 'dogs nus pa'i bshes gnyen chen po'ang mang du byon/ dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa sa pho rta'i lo la zhi bar gshegs/ de rjes e wam̐ na yang phyis bar du/ de'i chos kyi tshul rgyun ma chad par yod do/ /ri khrod pa mgon po ye shes kyis paṇa chen gshegs rjes e wam̐ gyi gdan sar yun mi ring ba zhig bzhugs nas/

wal sna'i dgon pa btab/ chos khrims shin tu dam zhing*/ dge 'dun kyang mang du 'dus/ gzhan don rgya cher bskyangs/ mkhan chen sangs blo bas/ tshogs kyi mkhan po mdzad/ de rjes sa stod smad mang por bzhugs nas/ khrid kyis gzhan don mang du bskyangs pas/ slob ma mkhan chen rin po che rgyal bzang ba la sogs byon/ phyis yol rin chen gling btab nas 'gro don mdzad/ chos rje byad rgyal bas chos 'khor gling du/ yun ring bzhugs nas/ phyi zhig na chu mig dgon sar du bzhugs te/ gzhan don bskyangs pa'i slob ma/ slob dpon nam mkha' grags pa la sogs pa yin/ 'jam dbyangs chos mgon pas/ ewam̐ du gdan sa bzung nas gzhan don mdzad pa dang*/ 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba dang*/ rkyang chen pa shākya shrī la sogs pa slob ma'ang mang du thon no//
